Политик: Неуправляемый активист → Стажер → Борец за социальную справедливость → Организатор работы с общественностью

Политик: Государственный служащий → Государственный представитель → Консул → Представитель → Заслуженный государственный деятель → Руководитель государства

Организатор благотворительного фонда: Дружелюбный лоббист → Эксперт по сбору средств → Организатор благотворительных акций → Директор некоммерческой организации → Лидер кампании в поддержку общественной цели → Идол мира благотворительности

careers:careers_Adult_CivilDesigner.label: Строительный инженер
careers:careers_Adult_CivilDesigner.description: Став строительным инженером, займитесь планированием и дизайном решений для различных экологических проблем и обсуждайте с другими персонажами, как сделать ваш мир лучше.
careers:careers_Adult_CivilDesigner.careerDetails:
Строительный инженер: Младший чертежник → Стажер архитектора → Техник-строитель

Экотехнолог: Стажер-настройщик → Дизайнер-гуру → Инженер-механик → Разработчик экотехнологий → Даровитый механик → Умелый изготовитель → Опытный изобретатель

Градостроитель: Консультант ЖКХ → Городской инспектор → Разработчик внутренних политик → Муниципальный секретарь → Специалист по благоустройству → Муниципальный инженер → Главный градостроитель

careers:careers_Adult_Conservationist.label: Эколог
careers:careers_Adult_Conservationist.description: Вы посмотрели все документальные фильмы о природе и знаете, в какой опасности находится планета. Просвещая общественность и проводя дополнительные изучения, вы хотите изменить плачевную ситуацию. Ничто не изменится за одну ночь, поэтому продолжайте свои изыскания, чтобы улучшить экосистему!
careers:careers_Adult_Conservationist.careerDetails:
Эколог: Любитель дикой природы → Полевой сотрудник → Земельный инспектор → Специалист по дикой природе → Природный историк → Директор фонда охраны природы

Менеджер по вопросам экологии: Охранник природы → Специалист по экоустойчивости → Представитель окружающей среды → Директор по устойчивому развитию

Океанолог: Океановед → Специалист по рыболовству → Морской эколог → Доктор морских наук

careers:careers_Adult_CorporateWorker.label: Сарариман
careers:careers_Adult_CorporateWorker.description: Посвятить свою жизнь корпорации "Данные будущего" и поставить ее интересы превыше всего — обязательный первый шаг в карьере сараримана. Вас ждут стабильность, уважение и бесконечные рабочие часы. Дослужитесь до должности руководителя или эксперта в своей области, добираясь до работы каждое утро и проводя в караоке каждый вечер.
careers:careers_Adult_CorporateWorker.careerDetails:
Сарариман: Стажер → Канцелярская крыса → Исполнительный секретарь → Офисный менеджер

Эксперт: Укротитель данных → Вычислительная машина → Знаток электронных таблиц → Господин массивов данных → Повелитель формул → Гуру облачных данных

Руководитель: Ценный работник → Руководитель группы → Квалифицированный руководитель → Лучший специалист по планированию → Корпоративный оракул → Руководитель отдела

careers:careers_Adult_Critic.label: Критик
careers:careers_Adult_Critic.description: У каждого есть свое мнение. Но не каждому платят за это мнение! Персонажи, которые думают, что обладают отменным чувством критицизма, могут податься в критики. Будь то еда или произведения искусства, ваш персонаж найдет, что сказать, а другие будут обязаны выслушать.
careers:careers_Adult_Critic.careerDetails:
Критик: Разносчик газет → Специалист по сбору и анализу данных → Специализированный журналист

Художественный критик: Высокомерный критикан → Посетитель выставок → Утонченный критик → Знаток культуры → Главный критик → Синдицированный обозреватель → Ведущий художественный критик

Ресторанный критик: Охотник за закуской → Частый посетитель киосков с едой → Ресторанный эксперт → Местный гурман → Гедонист-эксперт → Кошмар на кухне → Куратор изящных вкусов

careers:careers_Adult_Education.label: Преподаватель
careers:careers_Adult_Education.description: Формируйте умы будущего, выбрав карьеру в сфере образования. Эта работа непростая, но очень результативная.
careers:careers_Adult_Education.careerDetails:
Преподаватель: Учитель на замене → Помощник учителя → Учитель → Наставник → Декан

Администратор: Заведующий отделом по делам студентов → Председатель приемной комиссии → Проректор по учебной работе → Первый проректор → Старший ректор

Профессор: Продвинутый преподаватель → Главный лектор → Приглашенный преподаватель → Штатный профессор → Старший профессор

careers:careers_Adult_Engineer.label: Инженер
careers:careers_Adult_Engineer.description: В мире много проблем, для решения которых требуется современный и творческий подход. Воспользуйтесь своей любовью к технологиям и начните карьеру инженера, чтобы решить мировые проблемы с помощью компьютеров и механических устройств!
careers:careers_Adult_Engineer.careerDetails:
Инженер: Специалист техподдержки → Стажер инженерного отдела → Адепт алгоритмов → Винтик в механизме → Технический инженер → Опытный инженер

Компьютерный инженер: Изготовитель компьютеров → Обработчик процессоров → Компьютерный специалист → Талантливый компьютерщик

Инженер-механик: Изобретатель механизмов → Автор аппаратов → Гениальный механик → Двигатель прогресса

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Модный Фотограф
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description: Внештатные модные фотографы принимают заказы на работу и делают фотографии для клиентов в модных, рекламных или научных целях. Развивайте навыки фотографа и заслужите хорошую репутацию, чтобы начать работать с законодателями стиля, которые сотрудничают с лучшими брендами.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Внештатный производитель
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description:
Отрасль: внештатный производитель.

Вы регулярно покупаете товары в магазине и думаете, что могли бы сами сделать лучше? Тогда начните карьеру внештатного производителя и создавайте товары ручной работы, которые так ценятся во всем мире.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Паранормальный сыщик
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description: Если ночью начинают происходить странные вещи, звонят именно паранормальным сыщикам. И хотя большая часть работы приходится на ночь, заказов всегда хоть отбавляй. Чем сложнее заказ, тем выше вознаграждение, но, с другой стороны, можно сильно испугаться.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Внештатный Программист
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description:
Отрасль: Внештатный Программист

Хотите узнать небольшой секрет? Чтобы стать отличным внештатным работником, необязательно знать все про компьютеры! Вам понадобится компьютер, поисковая система и железная воля — чтобы вести дела с "творческими людьми". Но лучше, конечно, знать все про компьютеры.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Внештатный Корреспондент
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description:
Отрасль: Внештатный Корреспондент

На нас часто показывают пальцами на улице и кричат вслед: "С этими без слов не разобраться!" Ладно, это неправда. Может, когда-нибудь так будет. Мы занимаемся всем от вычитки текста до написания мемуаров известных людей. Хватайте клавиатуру, включайте любимый редактор и присоединяйтесь!

careers:careers_Adult_Gardener.label: Садовод
careers:careers_Adult_Gardener.description: Вы всегда были хорошим садоводом, а теперь даже сможете заработать на этом симолеоны. Сначала вам предстоит заниматься исключительно садоводством, но со временем вы сможете добиться успеха в науке или флористике.
careers:careers_Adult_Gardener.careerDetails:
Садовод: Грязеискатель → Фильтратор почвы → Сеятель семян → Укротитель листьев

Ботаник: Знаток растений → Исследователь пестиков и тычинок → Специалист по скрещиванию → Знаток цветов → Букетный биолог → Кандидат наук в области опыления

Флорист: Заместитель лепестков → Укротитель стеблей → Дизайнер тычинок → Цветочных дел мастер → Гениальный специалист по листве → Специалист по вазам

careers:careers_Adult_InteriorDecorator.label: Дизайнер интерьеров
careers:careers_Adult_InteriorDecorator.description:
Самое главное в работе дизайнера интерьеров:знать толк в дизайне,иметь хорошие отношения с клиентами.
От навыков работы с людьми и художественного видения зависит ваше будущее и профессиональное признание. Начните с небольших проектов по ремонту домов. Усердно работая, со временем вы сможете привлечь крупных клиентов и получить грандиозные проекты, которые помогут вам добиться заслуженного признания!
careers:careers_Adult_InteriorDecorator.careerDetails: Дизайнер интерьеров: Консультант по цветовым схемам интерьеров → Специалист по оформлению интерьеров → Менеджер помещений → Консультант по декорированию → Проектировщик помещений → Организатор быта → Дизайнер жилых помещений → Дизайнер деловых интерьеров → Декоратор помещений → Дипломированный дизайнер помещений

careers:careers_Adult_Law.label: Юрист
careers:careers_Adult_Law.description: Персонажи, выбравшие карьеру юриста, могут предоставлять юридическую помощь другим персонажам, отстаивать их интересы и работать на благо общества. Неплохая зарплата тоже никогда не помешает!
careers:careers_Adult_Law.careerDetails:
Юрист: Судебный пристав → Работник архива → Юридический секретарь → Помощник юриста → Начинающий адвокат → Опытный адвокат → Перспективный прокурор

Судья: Властелин молотка → Почетный арбитр → Главный судья

Частный адвокат: Ведущий адвокат → Дотошный юрист → Первый партнер

careers:careers_Adult_Military.label: Военная Служба
careers:careers_Adult_Military.description: Физическая подготовка и дисциплина — ключевые факторы успеха в военной карьере. Повысить ранг будет непросто, если вы не сможете продемонстрировать физическое превосходство, умение вербовать и талант лидера. Вы мечтаете стать главнокомандующим, или же вас больше привлекают тайные операции и раскрытие секретов других?
careers:careers_Adult_Military.careerDetails:
Военная Служба: Новобранец → Рядовой четвертого класса → Почти сержант → Самый младший сержант → Офицер запаса

Офицер: Четвертый лейтенант → Отважный капитан → Подполковник → Бригадный генерал → Главнокомандующий

Спецагент: Истребитель улик → Искоренитель теорий заговора → Подпольный специалист → [УДАЛЕНО] → Сим в черном

careers:careers_Adult_Mortician.label: Ритуальный агент
careers:careers_Adult_Mortician.description: Без представителей этой профессии не обойтись ни живым, ни мертвым! Специалисты похоронной индустрии берут на себя такие задачи, как выкапывание могил и бальзамирование тела, обеспечивая персонажам достойный уход в мир иной, а также профессионально обсуждают ритуальные услуги и размышляют о жизни и смерти. Лучшие из них удостаиваются маски чумного доктора, бюста и почетной таблички.
careers:careers_Adult_Mortician.careerDetails:
Ритуальный агент: Могильщик → Хранитель тел → Смотритель могил → Специалист по устранению останков

Патологоанатом: Специалист по уборке места смерти → Исследователь бактериальной активности → Специалист по кремации → Бальзамировщик → Младший патологоанатом → Патологоанатом

Распорядитель похорон: Администратор → Специалист по прощаниям → Консультант по погребению → Менеджер → Младший распорядитель → Распорядитель похорон

careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Handypers.label: Мастер разных дел
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Handypers.description: Если вы умеете орудовать гаечным ключом, эта карьера отлично вам подойдет! Делайте ремонт или халтурьте прямо под носом у владельца жилья и получайте за это симолеоны!
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Handypers.careerDetails: Мастер разных дел: Способный чинильщик → Незаменимый помощник → Идеальный ремонтник

careers:careers_Adult_RomanceConsultant.label: Консультант по романтическим отношениям
careers:careers_Adult_RomanceConsultant.description: Вы хорошо считываете чужие эмоции, любите романтику и хотели бы помогать другим найти счастье в любви? Возможно, сама судьба подталкивает вас к профессии консультанта по романтическим отношениям!
careers:careers_Adult_RomanceConsultant.careerDetails:
Консультант по романтическим отношениям: Новичок в мире любви → Стажер по вопросам страсти → Арбитр любовных дел → Доцент романтических наук → Консультант по эмоциональному благополучию → Эксперт по языку любви → Специалист по здоровым отношениям

Психолог по отношениям: Коуч по отношениям → Специалист по отношениям в паре → Лицензированный психолог по отношениям в паре

Специалист по подбору пары: Специалист по формированию близости → Эксперт по романтической совместимости → Сертифицированный специалист по свиданиям

careers:careers_Adult_SocialMedia.label: Социальные сети
careers:careers_Adult_SocialMedia.description:
Что сейчас популярно? Где подают лучшую еду в городе? Какая знаменитость интереснее?
Начните карьеру в соцсетях и станьте тем, кто отвечает на эти вопросы. Ведите блог и отмечайтесь в заведениях, чтобы подписчики не скучали.
careers:careers_Adult_SocialMedia.careerDetails:
Социальные сети: Стажер СМИ → На побегушках → Автор завлекающих статей

Интернет-знаменитость: Аналитик Симстаграмма → Автор роликов про кошек → Узкоспециализированный комментатор → Автор интернет-мемов → Звезда Интернета → Участник реалити-шоу → Суперзвезда Интернета

Связи с общественностью: Координатор пиар-отдела → Комьюнити-менеджер → Пресс-секретарь → Менеджер по работе с клиентами → Директор по связям с общественностью → Вице-президент пиар-отдела → Король пиара

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_CheerTe.label: Участник группы поддержки
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_CheerTe.description: Вперед, "Летающий Вомп Вомп Коппердейла"! Вступайте в группу поддержки, чтобы улучшить свой навык фитнеса и научиться эффектным танцевальным движениям. Тренируйтесь вместе с товарищами и участвуйте в соревнованиях групп поддержки раз в неделю. Для начала вам потребуется коврик для поддержки, а по достижении звания капитана вы получите золотой коврик для поддержки, флаг группы поддержки и приз.
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_CheerTe.careerDetails: Участник группы поддержки: Новичок в группе поддержки → Участник группы поддержки → Капитан группы поддержки

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_ChessTe.label: Член шахматного клуба
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_ChessTe.description: Вступайте в школьный шахматный клуб! Испытайте свои навыки логики в деле, оттачивая шахматное мастерство в играх с товарищами по клубу. Это внеклассное занятие позволит вам посещать школьную научную выставку, где вы сможете принять участие в разгадывании шахматной головоломки с другими посетителями. Достигните звания капитана, чтобы получить особый шахматный столик, флаг клуба и приз!
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_ChessTe.careerDetails: Член шахматного клуба: Новичок в шахматном клубе → Участник шахматного клуба → Капитан шахматного клуба

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Compute.label: Член компьютерного клуба
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Compute.description: Доставайте клавиатуру с разноцветной подсветкой и вступайте в школьный компьютерный клуб! Пишите код на своем компьютере, оттачивая искусство программирования. Это внеклассное занятие позволит вам посещать школьную научную выставку, где вы сможете участвовать в игровом джеме, соревнуясь с другими посетителями! Достигните наивысшего уровня в клубе, чтобы заработать золотой ноутбук, флаг клуба и приз!
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Compute.careerDetails: Член компьютерного клуба: Новичок в компьютерном клубе → Участник компьютерного клуба → Капитан компьютерного клуба

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Footbal.label: Игрок футбольной команды
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Footbal.description: Вступайте в команду по американскому футболу и достигните нового уровня физической подготовки! Вы сможете участвовать в тренировках, бросая и ловя мяч, чтобы продемонстрировать эти навыки во время Дня спорта. Помимо тренировок, вы сможете достигнуть звания капитана и получить золотой мяч, флаг команды и приз!
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Footbal.careerDetails: Игрок футбольной команды: Новичок в команде → Участник команды по американскому футболу → Капитан команды по американскому футболу

careers:careers_Volunteer_SoccerTeam.label: Игрок футбольной команды
careers:careers_Volunteer_SoccerTeam.description: Хотите играть в студенческий футбол? Получить "командный" опыт? Красивую форму? Впечатляющие футбольные навыки? Ждем вашу анкету! Зачем смотреть матчи по пятницам и субботам, если можно в них участвовать?
careers:careers_Volunteer_SoccerTeam.careerDetails: Игрок футбольной команды: Ученик → Вечно запасной → Основной состав → Плеймейкер

careers:detectiveCareer_1.label: Детектив
careers:detectiveCareer_1.description: Вы хотите стать полицейским, который всегда работает? Если да, то эта работа именно для вас, и мы даже вознаградим вас за такое нездоровое отношение к службе! Получите доступ к такой одежде, как полицейская форма, которую можно носить вместо пижамы. Преподайте ценный урок подросткам - оденьте их в комбинезоны арестантов и превратите их комнаты в тюремную камеру, добавив стены с решетками и декоративную камеру слежения. И в качестве бонуса вы даже можете следить за ними через одностороннее зеркало.
careers:detectiveCareer_1.careerDetails: Детектив: Курсант → Офицер → Младший сержант → Детектив → Старший детектив → Сержант → Лейтенант → Капитан → Полковник → Начальник

careers:workFromHomeCareer_Naturopath.label: Натуропат
careers:workFromHomeCareer_Naturopath.description: Натуропаты помогают своим клиентам восстановить и укрепить здоровье природными средствами. Для этого они активно готовят эликсиры и занимаются собирательством. Прекрасная работа для тех, кто интересуется вопросами здоровья и гармонии! Эта карьера открывает доступ к 3 нарядам, новым действиям, таким как "Просвещать на тему гармонии", возможности принимать клиентов на дому, чертам характера и предметам для оформления кабинета, например коллекции декора "Мудрость Вековой чащи".
careers:workFromHomeCareer_Naturopath.careerDetails:
Натуропат: Начинающий натуропат → Стажер знахаря → Новичок в жизни на природе → Младший специалист по холистическому подходу → Холистический диагност

Фитотерапевт: Штатный собиратель → Агротехник → Специалист по эликсирам → Фитоцелитель → Знаток знахарства

Лайфстайл-коуч: Организатор курсов → Инструктор по собирательству → Специалист по жизни на природе → Эксперт по гармонизации → Дипломированный лайфстайл-коуч

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Beetle.label: Смерть от жуков
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Beetle.description: Смерть пришла к этому персонажу в форме коктейля из жуков. Этот факт располагает к тому, чтобы упокоиться в доме с призраками.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Overheat.label: Смерть от перегрева
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Overheat.description: Персонаж умер от долгого нахождения в жаре.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Laugher.label: Смерть от смеха
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Laugher.description: Этот персонаж умер от чрезмерного хихиканья и до сих пор время от времени посмеивается.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Steam.label: Смерть от пара
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Steam.description: Этот персонаж умер от воздействия пара, и теперь ему все время жарко и хочется пить.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Fire.label: Смерть в пожаре
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Fire.description: Жизнь этого персонажа унес пожар. Языки пламени танцуют и по сей день.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_ClimbingRoute.label: Смерть от падения с высоты
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_ClimbingRoute.description: Этот персонаж погиб от падения с большой высоты.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.label: Смерть из-за атаки курицы
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.description: Считайте это платой за плохое обращение с курицей.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MurphyBed.label: Смерть из-за складной кровати
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MurphyBed.description: Этот персонаж был обречен на смерть мстительной складной кроватью.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_BrokenHeart.label: Смерть от разбитого сердца
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_BrokenHeart.description: Любовь бывает жестокой. Этот персонаж умирает от разбитого сердца.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Frozen.label: Смерть от переохлаждения
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Frozen.description: Персонаж умер от долгого нахождения на холоде.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Cowplant.label: Смерть в желудке жвачного растения
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Cowplant.description: Этот персонаж был съеден жвачным растением и до сих пор сторонится всех растений.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_EmotionalStarvat.label: Смерть от эмоционального голода
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_EmotionalStarvat.description: Этот персонаж умер от эмоционального голода и продолжает мучиться от него в загробной жизни.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_DeathFlower.label: Смерть из-за цветов
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_DeathFlower.description: Этому персонажу подписала приговор цветочная композиция с запахом смерти. От такого подарка невозможно отказаться, но последствия фатальны.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Hunger.label: Смерть от голода
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Hunger.description: Этот персонаж умер от голода и продолжает мучиться голодными спазмами в загробной жизни.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_VendingMachine.label: Смерть из-за торгового автомата
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_VendingMachine.description: Этот персонаж не выдержал разрушительной силы торгового автомата и скончался.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MotherPlant.label: Жертва зверского аппетита материнского растения
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MotherPlant.description: Этот персонаж пал жертвой зверского аппетита материнского растения и может навсегда забыть про удовлетворение потребностей.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_WitchOverload.label: Смерть из-за избыточного волшебного заряда
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_WitchOverload.description: Заряженные призраки станут отличными объектами для дуэлей, заклинаний и других волшебных действий.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Anger.label: Смерть от гнева
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Anger.description: Причиной смерти этого персонажа стал инсульт — отсюда некоторая раздражительность.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MoldSystem.label: Смерть от плесени
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MoldSystem.description: Погибнув от плесени, этот персонаж становится ее воплощением... если такое можно сказать о бесплотном призраке! Но будет ли невероятная сила плесени использована во благо?

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.label: Смерть из-за атаки кролика-убийцы
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.description: Этот персонаж спровоцировал кролика-убийцу и жестоко поплатился за это.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_PetCrow.label: Накарканная смерть
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_PetCrow.description: Этот персонаж навлек на себя гнев Лиги ворон и в результате лишился жизни.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Flies.label: Смерть от роя мух
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Flies.description: Этот персонаж был обречен на смерть роем разгневанных мух.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Embarrassment.label: Смерть от смущения
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Embarrassment.description: Этот персонаж унижен и умирает от смущения. Буквально.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_SecretPassageway.label: Смерть от неисправной кукушки
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_SecretPassageway.description: Любопытство сгубило кошку! Смерть настигла этого персонажа в обличье неожиданно опасных часов с кукушкой.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Rodent_Disease.label: Смерть от лихорадки "Бешеный грызун"
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Rodent_Disease.description:
Этот персонаж погиб от мышиного бешенства и распространяет страх заболевания и эпидемии в загробной жизни.
В режиме жизни он обречен все время носить огромный костюм жуткой мыши!

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Lightning.label: Смерть от молнии
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Lightning.description: В этого персонажа слишком часто попадали молнии.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_OldAge.label: Смерть от старости
deathCauses:trait_ghost_OldAge.description: Печалиться не о чем: таков итог долгой жизни.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Vampire_Sun.label: Смерть от солнечного света
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Vampire_Sun.description: Персонаж умер после длительного воздействия вредных ультрафиолетовых лучей!

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Drown.label: Утопление
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Drown.description: Этот персонаж однажды тонул и теперь боится воды.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Electrocution.label: Смерть от электрического тока
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Electrocution.description: Этого персонажа убил удар током. Настоящий шок.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Pufferfish.label: Смерть после поедания фугу
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Pufferfish.description: Персонаж взял жизнь за жабры и съел ядовитую рыбу.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_ElderExhaustion.label: Смерть от чрезмерного усердия
deathCauses:trait_ghost_ElderExhaustion.description: Похоже, можно очень сильно перестараться. Этот персонаж умер от чрезмерного усердия.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_UrbanMyth_EP12De.label: Смерть после встречи с городской легендой
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_UrbanMyth_EP12De.description: Причиной гибели этого персонажа оказалась встреча с городской легендой. Попытка опровергнуть слухи обошлась очень дорого... Кто-то скажет, что смерть была вызвана страхом, но есть и те, кто знает правду.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_StinkBomb.label: Смерть от зловонной капсулы
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_StinkBomb.description: Историю этого персонажа оборвал взрыв зловонной капсулы. Ее пары оказались непригодны для дыхания. Неприятная смерть!

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Meteorite.label: Смерть от метеорита
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Meteorite.description: В этого персонажа недавно попал открытый метеорит, вызвавший небывалый ажиотаж в научных кругах и одну нелепую смерть.

traits:trait_Mean.label: Mean
traits:trait_Mean.description: These Sims become Happy when being Mean or Mischievous to other Sims and become Confident after winning a fight.

traits:trait_EssenceOfFlavor.label: Essence of Flavor
traits:trait_EssenceOfFlavor.description: Sims with the Essence of Flavor make higher quality food and drink.

traits:trait_Cheerful.label: Cheerful
traits:trait_Cheerful.description: These Sims tend to be Happier than other Sims.

traits:trait_PotionMaster.label: Potion Master
traits:trait_PotionMaster.description: Potion Masters can mix potent drinks which can sway the drinker's emotions.

traits:trait_TheKnack.label: Handy
traits:trait_TheKnack.description: Handy Sims can instantly Fix and Upgrade any object.

traits:trait_Bookworm.label: Bookworm
traits:trait_Bookworm.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from analyzing Books and can Discuss Books in unique ways.

traits:trait_Gloomy.label: Gloomy
traits:trait_Gloomy.description: These Sims tend to be Sad, can Share Melancholy Thoughts to other Sims, and while sad, gain a boost to their Creative Skill.

traits:trait_Bro.label: Bro
traits:trait_Bro.description: These Sims can Bro Hug other Bros, gain Confidence around other Bros, and become Confident from Watching Sports.

traits:trait_Creative.label: Creative
traits:trait_Creative.description: These Sims tend to be Inspired, can Share Creative Ideas with other Sims, and may become upset if they're not creative for a period of time.

traits:trait_NeverWeary.label: Never Weary
traits:trait_NeverWeary.description: Never Weary Sims never need sleep.

traits:trait_Sincere.label: Sincere
traits:trait_Sincere.description: Sincere Sims have more success with Apologies and Compliments.

traits:trait_SuperGreenThumb.label: Super Green Thumb
traits:trait_SuperGreenThumb.description: Super Green Thumbs will find that the plants they garden have amazing vitality!

traits:trait_WebMaster.label: Webmaster
traits:trait_WebMaster.description: Webmasters get the most out of their computers, unlocking extremely useful ways to use them.

traits:trait_ProfessionalSlacker.label: Professional Slacker
traits:trait_ProfessionalSlacker.description: Professional Slackers have no fear of being demoted or fired.

traits:trait_Materialistic.label: Materialistic
traits:trait_Materialistic.description: These Sims can Admire and Brag about Possessions and become Sad when they haven't purchased a new item for a period of time.

traits:trait_AlwaysWelcome.label: Always Welcome
traits:trait_AlwaysWelcome.description: Always Welcome Sims will act more at home when at others' residences, and the hosts won't mind at all!

traits:trait_LivingVicariously.label: Vicarious
traits:trait_LivingVicariously.description: By being Vicarious, your Children's skill gains can contribute to your own!

traits:trait_Muser.label: Muser
traits:trait_Muser.description: Musers get better boosts to their skills when they're inspired.

traits:trait_SpeedCleaner.label: Speed Cleaner
traits:trait_SpeedCleaner.description: Speed Cleaners tidy up much faster!

traits:trait_Perfectionist.label: Perfectionist
traits:trait_Perfectionist.description: These Sims take longer to craft items but tend to make them higher quality, gain powerful Moodlets after crafting a high quality item, and gain negative Moodlets after crafting a low quality item.

traits:trait_Glutton.label: Glutton
traits:trait_Glutton.description: These Sims have a greater negative reaction to Hunger, always enjoy eating (no matter the food's quality), can eat Spoiled Food, and can Rummage for Food in garbage.

traits:trait_Business_Savvy.label: Business Savvy
traits:trait_Business_Savvy.description: Business Savvy Sims earn more than the standard rate from careers.

traits:trait_Piper.label: Piper
traits:trait_Piper.description: Pipers know an arsenal of songs that have significant power over others.

traits:trait_Snob.label: Snob
traits:trait_Snob.description: These Sims can Critique Work on low quality items, are bored by "low brow" television, and gain Confidence around other Snob Sims.

traits:trait_CreativeVisionary.label: Creative Visionary
traits:trait_CreativeVisionary.description: Creative Visionaries have a higher chance of painting and writing masterworks.

traits:trait_FreshChef.label: Fresh Chef
traits:trait_FreshChef.description: Fresh Chefs always make the highest quality food, and it never spoils!

traits:trait_Loner.label: Loner
traits:trait_Loner.description: These Sims become Happy when alone, do not receive negative Moodlets when their Social Need is low, become Tense around strangers, and become Embarrassed more often by social rejection.

traits:trait_Expressionistic.label: Expressionistic
traits:trait_Expressionistic.description: Expressionistic Sims have captured the essence of feeling, and can create highly emotional works of art regardless of their actual mood!

traits:trait_Hilarious.label: Hilarious
traits:trait_Hilarious.description: Hilarious Sims can never go wrong with a joke, and have a few extra-special ones up their sleeve.

traits:trait_Foodie.label: Foodie
traits:trait_Foodie.description: These Sims become Happy and have Fun when eating good food, become Uncomfortable when eating bad food, and can Watch Cooking Shows for ideas.

traits:trait_FamilyOriented.label: Family Oriented
traits:trait_FamilyOriented.description: These Sims become Happy around family members, become Sad if they don't interact with family for a period of time, and can Boast about Family.

traits:trait_Good.label: Good
traits:trait_Good.description: These Sims become Happy around Sims with positive Moodlets, can Donate to Charity, become Sad when interacting with Evil Sims, and can Discuss World Peace.

traits:trait_FreeServices.label: Free Services
traits:trait_FreeServices.description: All single-use service requests are free.

traits:trait_Appraiser.label: Appraiser
traits:trait_Appraiser.description: Appraisers can sell collectibles like Metals, Crystals, Elements, and Fossils to the Simsonian Museum for extra money.

traits:trait_Goofball.label: Goofball
traits:trait_Goofball.description: These Sims tend to be Playful.

traits:trait_AnglersTranquility.label: Angler's Tranquility
traits:trait_AnglersTranquility.description: Sims with Angler's Tranquility will find that all of their problems seem to melt away while they are fishing.

traits:trait_NightOwl.label: Night Owl
traits:trait_NightOwl.description: Night Owls build extra skill at night.

traits:trait_Independent.label: Independent
traits:trait_Independent.description: Independent Sims' Social Needs decay slower.

traits:trait_Observant.label: Observant
traits:trait_Observant.description: Observant Sims learn the traits of others just by meeting them.

traits:trait_Geek.label: Geek
traits:trait_Geek.description: These Sims become Happy when Reading Sci Fi or Playing Video Games, may become Tense if they haven't played much, are better at finding Collectibles, and can Discuss Geek Things with other Geek Sims.

traits:trait_PaMatriarch.label: Patriarch / Matriarch
traits:trait_PaMatriarch.description: Patriarchs provide skill boosts whenever they are around their children.

traits:trait_Fertile.label: Fertile
traits:trait_Fertile.description: Fertile Sims have an easier time when trying for a baby, and a higher chance of twins or triplets.

traits:trait_GreatKisser.label: Great Kisser
traits:trait_GreatKisser.description: Great Kissers have amazing success with kissing, and increase Charisma with every kiss!

traits:trait_Mentor.label: Super Mentor
traits:trait_Mentor.description: Super Mentors draw on their experience as well as innovative teaching techniques to make their skill mentoring even more efficient than normal. They also earn more Simoleons with Paid Mentoring. Mentoring interactions become available at level 5 of certain skills.

traits:trait_Mastermind.label: Mastermind
traits:trait_Mastermind.description: Masterminds know just the right things to say to cause anger, sadness, and jealousy in their opponents.

traits:trait_Slob.label: Slob
traits:trait_Slob.description: These Sims are not affected by dirty surroundings and make household items dirtier faster.

traits:trait_Antiseptic.label: Antiseptic
traits:trait_Antiseptic.description: Antiseptic Sims' Hygiene Need decays much slower.

traits:trait_Genius.label: Genius
traits:trait_Genius.description: These Sims tend to be Focused, can Share Ideas with other Sims, and may become upset if they haven't improved their Mental Skills for some time.

traits:trait_ValuedCustomer.label: Thrifty
traits:trait_ValuedCustomer.description: Thrifty Sims receive a 10% rebate on all Build Mode purchases made each week. Rebates will be directly applied to Household Funds.

traits:trait_EternalBond.label: Companion
traits:trait_EternalBond.description: Sims with a Companion have special interactions with their spouse that help ease the trials of life.

traits:trait_Quick_Learner.label: Quick Learner
traits:trait_Quick_Learner.description: Quick Learners build all skills a little bit faster!

traits:trait_Frugal.label: Frugal
traits:trait_Frugal.description: A Frugal Sim's household has reduced bills.

traits:trait_ArtLover.label: Art Lover
traits:trait_ArtLover.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from Viewing works of art and can Admire Art and discuss art in unique ways.

traits:trait_SpeedReader.label: Speed Reader
traits:trait_SpeedReader.description: Speed Readers read books faster than your average Sim.

traits:trait_PhysicallyGifted.label: Physically Gifted
traits:trait_PhysicallyGifted.description: Physically Gifted Sims build adult physical skills faster.

traits:trait_FamilySim.label: Domestic
traits:trait_FamilySim.description: Domestic Sims will see their familial relationships grow stronger faster.

traits:trait_Marketable.label: Marketable
traits:trait_Marketable.description: Marketable Sims sell items they've crafted for more Simoleons!

traits:trait_CommitmentIssues.label: Noncommittal
traits:trait_CommitmentIssues.description: These Sims become Tense after a while in the same job or relationship, become Happy when they Quit a Job or Break Off a relationship, take longer to Propose, and can Discuss their Fear of Commitment.

traits:trait_Gregarious.label: Gregarious
traits:trait_Gregarious.description: Gregarious Sims build friendly relationships faster.

traits:trait_MentallyGifted.label: Mentally Gifted
traits:trait_MentallyGifted.description: Mentally Gifted Sims build adult mental skills faster.

traits:trait_Invested.label: Shrewd
traits:trait_Invested.description: Shrewd Sims receive a direct deposit each week based on their Household Funds.

traits:trait_Savant.label: Savant
traits:trait_Savant.description: Savants gain all skills much faster!

traits:trait_active.label: Active
traits:trait_active.description: These Sims tend to be Energized, can Pump Up other Sims, and may become upset if they don't exercise for a period of time.

traits:trait_OneWithNature.label: Naturalist
traits:trait_OneWithNature.description: Sims that are Naturalists don't need to fear fire; it won't touch them, and they can extinguish it with ease.

traits:trait_Entrepreneurial.label: Entrepreneurial
traits:trait_Entrepreneurial.description: Entrepreneurial Sims are more likely to get promoted in their Career.

traits:Trait_Romantic.label: Romantic
traits:Trait_Romantic.description: These Sims tend to be Flirty and may become Sad if they don't have any Romantic social interactions for a period of time.

traits:trait_Collector.label: Collector
traits:trait_Collector.description: Collectors can find rare collectibles more often!

traits:trait_Longevity.label: Long Lived
traits:trait_Longevity.description: Long Lived lets Sims live longer lives, barring any accidents.

traits:trait_PerfectHost.label: Perfect Host
traits:trait_PerfectHost.description: Perfect Hosts get a boost to the score of any social event they throw.

traits:trait_Clumsy.label: Clumsy
traits:trait_Clumsy.description: These Sims tend to fail more often at physical activities and tend to laugh at failure instead of becoming upset.

traits:trait_Alluring.label: Alluring
traits:trait_Alluring.description: Alluring Sims are more successful at romance than others.

traits:trait_Outgoing.label: Outgoing
traits:trait_Outgoing.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from Friendly socialization, have their Social Need decay quickly, and gain more negative Moodlets when their Social Need is low.

traits:trait_Bane.label: Tormentor
traits:trait_Bane.description: Tormentors can sabotage almost anything, be it an object or another Sim's best efforts.

traits:trait_GymRat.label: Gym Rat
traits:trait_GymRat.description: Gym Rats build Fun and don't lose Hygiene while exercising!

traits:trait_Chronicler.label: Professorial
traits:trait_Chronicler.description: Professorial Sims can write helpful manuals about any skill they're well-versed in.

traits:trait_Beguiling.label: Beguiling
traits:trait_Beguiling.description: Beguiling Sims can put anyone in a Flirty mood with just one look.

traits:trait_CreativelyGifted.label: Creatively Gifted
traits:trait_CreativelyGifted.description: Creatively Gifted Sims build adult creative skills faster.

traits:trait_SelfAssured.label: Self-Assured
traits:trait_SelfAssured.description: These Sims tend to be Confident.

traits:trait_Player.label: Player
traits:trait_Player.description: Players will never cause other Sims to get jealous, no matter what they do

traits:trait_Carefree.label: Carefree
traits:trait_Carefree.description: Carefree Sims will never get Tense.

traits:trait_MusicLover.label: Music Lover
traits:trait_MusicLover.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets and boost their Fun Need when Listening to Music and become Happy when playing instruments.

traits:trait_SociallyGifted.label: Socially Gifted
traits:trait_SociallyGifted.description: Socially Gifted Sims build adult social skills faster.

traits:trait_EpicPoet.label: Poetic
traits:trait_EpicPoet.description: Poetic Sims can capture life itself in a book, and wield it to bring back someone they've lost.

traits:trait_HardlyHungry.label: Hardly Hungry
traits:trait_HardlyHungry.description: Some Sims just don't have much of an appetite.

traits:trait_Childish.label: Childish
traits:trait_Childish.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from watching the Kids Network, become Playful when playing with Children, and become Happy when playing with Children's toys.

traits:trait_Shameless.label: Shameless
traits:trait_Shameless.description: Shameless Sims will never get Embarrassed!

traits:trait_Ambitious.label: Ambitious
traits:trait_Ambitious.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from career success, gain negative Moodlets from career failure, and may become upset if not promoted.

traits:trait_HotHeaded.label: Hot-Headed
traits:trait_HotHeaded.description: These Sims tend to be Angry, can Rile up other Sims, and become Angry when targeted with Mischief.

traits:trait_Dastardly.label: Dastardly
traits:trait_Dastardly.description: Dastardly Sims perform stronger and more successful mean interactions.

traits:trait_Evil.label: Evil
traits:trait_Evil.description: These Sims become Happy around Sims with negative Moodlets, can Laugh Maniacally and Discuss Evil Plans, and become Angry when interacting with Good Sims.

traits:trait_MorningPerson.label: Morning Sim
traits:trait_MorningPerson.description: Morning Sims build extra skill in the morning.

traits:trait_HatesChildren.label: Hates Children
traits:trait_HatesChildren.description: These Sims become Angry around Children, become Tense after Try for a Baby, and can be Mean to Children.

traits:trait_Neat.label: Neat
traits:trait_Neat.description: These Sims become Happy and have Fun when performing household chores, can have a Cleaning Frenzy, and become really Uncomfortable in dirty surroundings.

traits:trait_Insane.label: Erratic
traits:trait_Insane.description: These Sims can Talk to themselves and have unpredictable Emotions.

traits:trait_Legendary.label: Beloved
traits:trait_Legendary.description: Everyone remembers a Beloved Sim!  Their relationships never fade.

traits:trait_Connections.label: Connections
traits:trait_Connections.description: Sims with Connections start all Careers several levels ahead!

traits:trait_Lazy.label: Lazy
traits:trait_Lazy.description: These Sims gain powerful Moodlets from Watching TV or Napping as well as from Comfortable furniture, become Fatigued more quickly from exercise, and grow Tense when performing household chores.

traits:trait_SteelBladder.label: Steel Bladder
traits:trait_SteelBladder.description: Sims with a Steel Bladder rarely have to pay attention to their Bladder Need.

traits:trait_LovesOutdoors.label: Loves Outdoors
traits:trait_LovesOutdoors.description: These Sims can Enthuse about Nature to other Sims and become Happy when Outdoors.

traits:trait_DanceMachine.label: Dance Machine
traits:trait_DanceMachine.description:
These Sims can't wait to get down, boogie, and party all night! When at venues like Bars, Nightclubs, and Lounges, these Sims can get a burst of energy with the Party Time interaction.

Dance Machines also receive a happy Moodlet when arriving at social venues.

traits:trait_Insider.label: Insider
traits:trait_Insider.description: These Sims love being in Clubs, and tend to be happiest when surrounded by their friends.

traits:trait_ClubPresident.label: Natural Leader
traits:trait_ClubPresident.description: Sims that are Natural Leaders will earn Club points much faster, and they will be able to overthrow other leaders with ease.

traits:trait_ChopstickSavvy.label: Chopstick Savvy
traits:trait_ChopstickSavvy.description: From slippery noodles to tiny peas, these Sims have mastered the art of eating with Chopsticks.

traits:trait_Unflirty.label: Unflirty
traits:trait_Unflirty.description: These Sims get Tense around Flirty Sims and seldom get Flirty themselves. It's difficult for them to be Romantic in public.

traits:trait_SpiceHound.label: Spice Hound
traits:trait_SpiceHound.description: Spice Hounds never find any food too Spicy, and feel Happy for hours after eating a Spicy Meal.

traits:trait_HomeTurf.label: Home Turf
traits:trait_HomeTurf.description: These Sims become Happy when they are in their home neighborhood.

traits:trait_Vegetarian.label: Vegetarian
traits:trait_Vegetarian.description: These Sims will actively avoid eating foods that contain meat products and can become sick if they eat such foods.

traits:trait_InTheKnow.label: In the Know
traits:trait_InTheKnow.description: Sims who are In the Know can get a massive discount on market stall purchases if they Haggle with vendors.

traits:trait_Pet_Smart_Dog.label: Smart
traits:trait_Pet_Smart_Dog.description: These bright dogs are easier to train and pick up tricks quickly. They might even understand Simlish!

traits:trait_Pet_Independent_Cat.label: Aloof
traits:trait_Pet_Independent_Cat.description: These cats don't really need owners, they're just here for the free food.

traits:trait_Pet_Wanderlust_Dog.label: Adventurous
traits:trait_Pet_Wanderlust_Dog.description: These dogs will sometimes leave the house to go on solo adventures, but are also happy to go on an adventure with their owner.

traits:trait_Pet_Naughty_Dog.label: Troublemaker
traits:trait_Pet_Naughty_Dog.description: These dogs are always up to nothing good. They will often misbehave and can even be encouraged to do so.

traits:trait_Pet_Vocal_Cat.label: Talkative
traits:trait_Pet_Vocal_Cat.description: These cats love to yowl along with other Sims. They'll even try to sing upon request!

traits:trait_Pet_Hunter_Dog.label: Hunter
traits:trait_Pet_Hunter_Dog.description: These dogs are natural hunters. Send them off into the world and they'll hunt and dig for things.

traits:trait_Pet_Hairy_Dog.label: Hairy
traits:trait_Pet_Hairy_Dog.description: These dogs will leave hair piles laying around. Brush their fur to keep things tidy!

traits:trait_Pet_Friendly_Cat.label: Friendly
traits:trait_Pet_Friendly_Cat.description: These pets tend to be Friendly to other Sims, and will happily greet other Sims around them.

traits:trait_Pet_Loyal_Cat.label: Affectionate

traits:trait_Pet_Stubborn_Cat.label: Spoiled

traits:trait_Pet_Lazy_Dog.label: Couch Potato

traits:trait_Pet_Naughty_Cat.label: Mischievous
traits:trait_Pet_Naughty_Cat.description: These cats are always up to no good! They will often misbehave and can even be encouraged to do so.

traits:trait_Pet_Friendly_Dog.label: Friendly

traits:trait_Pet_Hunter_Cat.label: Prowler
traits:trait_Pet_Hunter_Cat.description: These cats enjoy prowling around the neighborhood. Send them out and they might come back with something they've found.

traits:trait_Pet_Playful_Dog.label: Playful
traits:trait_Pet_Playful_Dog.description: These pets love toys and want to play all the time, even when they're not excited.

traits:trait_CatLover.label: Cat Lover

traits:trait_Pet_Loyal_Dog.label: Loyal

traits:trait_HolidayTradition_FatherWint.label: Father Winter's Baby
traits:trait_HolidayTradition_FatherWint.description: Wow! Father Winter is actually {0.SimFirstName}'s Dad! That's amazing! Wonder if he gets any magical abilities?

traits:trait_Temperature_IceMan.label: Iceproof

traits:trait_UnstoppableFame.label: Unstoppable Fame
traits:trait_UnstoppableFame.description: Sims with Unstoppable Fame are immortalized celebrities, incapable of experiencing fame decay over time. They’re so comfortable in the limelight they’ll never react poorly towards those pesky paparazzi. They also receive an extra Fame Perk point.

traits:trait_SelfAbsorbed.label: Self-Absorbed
traits:trait_SelfAbsorbed.description: These sims are all about themselves! They can Fish for Compliments, are more excited when receiving a present, and may become tense when they haven't gotten enough attention. The celebrity spotlight is something they generally relish. After all, everyone else should love them as much as they do themselves, right?

traits:trait_WorldRenownedActor.label: World-Renowned Actor

traits:trait_IslandAncestors.label: Child of the Islands
traits:trait_IslandAncestors.description: These Sims experience a spiritual connection to islands of Sulani. Honor the islands by partaking in their culture, summon powerful elementals and reap the rewards of their blessings—or the consequences of their disfavor.

traits:trait_NaturalSpeaker.label: Natural Speaker
traits:trait_NaturalSpeaker.description: Sims that are Natural Speakers have been empowered by nature with instinctive charisma. Being friendly is second nature. These Sims find it easy to Enthuse and Spread Awareness of their cause to other Sims, and find that their grant applications tend to get accepted.

traits:trait_ChildoftheOcean.label: Child of the Ocean

traits:trait_Fizzyhead.description: Afizzionados become focused while creating better products from the Juice Fizzer, as well as recovering from becoming Overbucha’d faster.

traits:trait_entrepreneur.label: Entrepreneur
traits:trait_entrepreneur.description: This Sim is the Neighborhood Entrepreneur! They like to take chances with investments and will not refuse handouts.

traits:trait_MasterMaker.label: Master Maker
traits:trait_MasterMaker.description: Master Makers have learned all the tricks necessary to fabricate items at a reduced cost.

traits:trait_makerNPC.label: Master Crafter
traits:trait_makerNPC.description: This Sim is the neighborhood Master Crafter! They can inspire Fabrication recipes in other Sims.

traits:trait_Maker.label: Maker
traits:trait_Maker.description: These Sims become happy when making things. They become sad when it's been too long since completing a project on a Fabricator, Candlemaking Station, Juice Fizzer, or Woodworking Table. They do not receive negative effects from crafting or repair failures.

traits:trait_eco_master.label: Eco Master
traits:trait_eco_master.description: This Sim is the neighborhood Eco Master! They can inspire other Sims to be eco-conscious.

traits:trait_RecycleDisciple.label: Recycle Disciple
traits:trait_RecycleDisciple.description: These Sims are rabid recyclers that benefit from recycling and rummaging for bits and pieces, but should they go too long without indulging in their hobby...

traits:trait_EcoEngineer.label: Eco-Engineer
traits:trait_EcoEngineer.description: An Eco-Engineer will find Eco-Upgrades to objects are completed more quickly and always get Eco-Upgrade Parts from recycling.

traits:trait_ChampionOfThePeople.label: Champion of the People
traits:trait_ChampionOfThePeople.description: A Champion of the People always gains extra Influence, extra Satisfaction Points when gaining Influence, and will find themselves the recipient of more gifts from other Sims.

traits:trait_GreenFiend.label: Green Fiend
traits:trait_GreenFiend.description: These Sims are happiest when living on a green street and will continuously work towards making their environment more eco-friendly.

traits:trait_Nature_InfluentialIndividua.label: Influential Individual
traits:trait_Nature_InfluentialIndividua.description: When Influential Individuals speak, everyone listens. They can get the community to cheer on a local hero, or cancel them on a whim.

traits:trait_Freegan.label: Freegan
traits:trait_Freegan.description: These Sims reject consumerism and prefer to reduce wasteful spending by any means. They enjoy finding re-used or thrown away goods and foods. In fact, they have the best luck at finding the highest-quality treasures in Dumpsters! They may become tense or uncomfortable if they spend too much time earning or spending Simoleons.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Workaholic.label: Workaholic
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Workaholic.description:
Sims living a Workaholic Lifestyle tend to fixate on their careers by working extra hard and rarely taking breaks. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, pursue promotions, Work Hard while at work, complete Daily Tasks, and abstain from taking days off.

Lifestyle Effects
Needs decay slower while at workIncreased work performance gainDifficulty in keeping long term relationshipsCan "Go to Work on Off Hours" and "Demand Promotion from Boss"Receives extra work-related benefits when in the Corporate Worker careerTense when neglecting work duties or without a job

traits:trait_Excursion_Mountaineer_Rank1.label: Middling Mountaineer
traits:trait_Excursion_Mountaineer_Rank1.description: These Sims have passing knowledge of the climbing route up Mount Komorebi. This may give small improvement their odds of success on a future excursion.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_CoffeeFanatic.label: Coffee Fanatic
traits:trait_Lifestyles_CoffeeFanatic.description:
Sims who live a Coffee Fanatic Lifestyle want nothing more than another cup of java in order to reap its benefits. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, drink a lot of coffee.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits after drinking coffeeWill make and drink more coffee than other SimsBrewed Coffee is always Outstanding QualityIncreased Skill gain in all Skills after drinking coffeeCan "Talk about Benefits of Coffee" or "Lament the Detriments of Coffee" depending on caffeinated statusCan "Work Caffeinated Shift" while at workIncreased work performance after drinking coffeeUncomfortable after going too long without drinking coffee

traits:trait_Lifestyles_HealthFoodNut.label: Health Food Nut
traits:trait_Lifestyles_HealthFoodNut.description:
Sims who live a Health Food Nut Lifestyle are devoted to eating nutrient-filled foods! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, eat healthy foods and harvestables while avoiding Quick Meals, desserts, or anything that may seem unhealthy!

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when eating healthy foodPrefers to cook and eat healthy foodCan "Cook Healthy Meal" to make alternative healthy recipe optionsIncreased Weight Loss and Fitness Gain while working out after eating a meal made by "Cook Healthy Meal"Can "Evangelize Benefits of Health Food" to other SimsDispleased by eating junk food and tense when going too long without eating healthy food

traits:trait_Lifestyles_JunkFoodDevourer.label: Junk Food Fiend
traits:trait_Lifestyles_JunkFoodDevourer.description:
Sims who live a Junk Food Fiend Lifestyle crave snacks and sweets and are enthusiasts of spicing food up with sugar and bacon! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, eat Quick Meals, desserts, or anything that may seem unhealthy as a rule. Just be sure to avoid eating healthy!

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when eating junk foodPrefers to eat junk foodCan "Add Sugar" or "Add Bacon" to food, turning it into junk foodCan "Evangelize Benefits of Junk Food" to other SimsDispleased by eating healthy and tense when going too long without eating junk food

traits:trait_CorporateWorker_Charismatic.label: Charismatic Crooner
traits:trait_CorporateWorker_Charismatic.description: These sims have mastered charismatic vocal tones that help them get along better with co-workers. Those tones may even help with their singing ability.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_FrequentTraveler.label: Frequent Traveler
traits:trait_Lifestyles_FrequentTraveler.description:
Frequent Travelers make a habit of visiting new and exciting places and want to experience everything these locales have to offer! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, travel for vacations, visit exotic hidden destinations, and seek out new experiences while traveling.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when traveling to another world or when taking a vacationIncreased Skill gain in all Skills while on vacation specificallyIncreased work performance and other benefits after returning from a vacationCan "Ask about Home Region" on locals to gather destination suggestions while travelingCan "Share Travel Stories" after a vacationBored after having gone too long without travel

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Networker.label: People Person
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Networker.description:
Sims living a People Person Lifestyle have an easier time building and maintaining a large friend group, sometimes at the cost of connecting with those friends. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, a Sim should have four or more friends.

Lifestyle Effects
Keeps lower relationship level Friends easier but struggles to keep Good Friends or higherVarious benefits when interacting with three or more friends at a time or when making a new friendLess likely to gain Long Term Sentiments with friendsGreater need to be socialTense when friend group contains fewer than four Sims

traits:trait_Proper.label: Proper
traits:trait_Proper.description: These Sims tend to disapprove of other Sims improper behavior such as Mean or Mischievous socials, but find themselves happier in Formal Outfits and have a much easier time with Friendly and Romantic socials.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Techie.label: Techie
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Techie.description:
Live a life immersed in technology! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, interact regularly with electronics and technology or join a tech-related career.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when interacting with technologyPrefers to use technology over non-electronic objectsIncreased Skill gain in Programming and Rocket ScienceCan apply the Overclocked Upgrade to computers and then "Enthuse about Processing Power" with other SimsImproved success when repairing and upgrading electronicsIncreased work performance in tech-related careersTense when on a lot without Power or when going without technology for too long

traits:trait_Lifestyles_NoNeedForRomance.label: Single and Lovin' It
traits:trait_Lifestyles_NoNeedForRomance.description:
Sims living a Single and Lovin' It Lifestyle happily enjoy the 'single life' and savor their independence. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, avoid being in a committed romantic relationship and romantic media. 

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when singleIncreased Skill gain in all Skills when singleLess likely to acquire romantic SentimentsFinds romantic media somewhat unrealisticIncreased Work Performance when singleTense when in a new committed romantic relationship

traits:trait_WorldlyKnowledge.label: Worldly Knowledge
traits:trait_WorldlyKnowledge.description: These Sims are better at socializing during Social Events and enjoy ordering food from market stalls. They also can "Negotiate a Discount" at market stalls, which gives them an advantage over other bargaining techniques.

traits:trait_SurvivalInstinct.label: Survival Instinct
traits:trait_SurvivalInstinct.description: These Sims will always escape wildlife attacks unscathed, manage to avoid injury from Skiing, Snowboarding, and Rock Climbing more often than other Sims, and have a natural resistance to inclement weather.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Outdoorsy.label: Outdoorsy
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Outdoorsy.description:
Sims living an Outdoorsy Lifestyle prefer to be outside, taking in the fresh air. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, prioritize doing activities outdoors rather than indoors.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when doing outdoor activitiesPrefers to be outdoorsIncreased work performance in outdoor careersTense when spending too much time inside rather than outside

traits:trait_Lifestyles_AdrenalineSeeker.label: Adrenaline Seeker
traits:trait_Lifestyles_AdrenalineSeeker.description:
Adrenaline Seeker is a Lifestyle for Sims who seek out danger, adventure, and sometimes even drama to ride the wave of an adrenaline rush! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, explore dangerous locales, get into fights, woohoo outside, work in a dangerous career, and seek out excitement in all its forms! Just be sure to avoid the mundane.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when thrill-seeking Avoids boring conversationsDoes not panic during fire and finds it excitingIncreased work performance in dangerous careersCan "Talk about New Adventure" and "Enthuse about Thrill-Seeking" with other SimsCan "Fight for the Rush!" after having gone too long without a thrillBored when performing mundane interactions and socialsTense when going too long without excitement

traits:trait_Adventurous.label: Adventurous
traits:trait_Adventurous.description: These Sims seek out new and unique experiences!

traits:trait_Excursion_Mountaineer_Rank3.label: Expert Mountaineer
traits:trait_Excursion_Mountaineer_Rank3.description: These Sims are experts of the climbing route up Mount Komorebi. This will improve their odds of success rock climbing, on future excursions, and in other outdoor activities.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Indoorsy.label: Indoorsy
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Indoorsy.description:
Sims living an Indoorsy Lifestyle prefer to be within the confines of an indoor space. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, prioritize doing activities indoors rather than outdoors.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when doing indoor activitiesPrefers to be indoorsDecreased work performance in outdoor careersTense when spending too much time outside rather than inside

traits:trait_Lifestyles_CloseKnit.label: Close-Knit
traits:trait_Lifestyles_CloseKnit.description:
Sims living a Close-Knit Lifestyle prefer to form deep connections with a small circle of friends. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, a Sim should keep their friend count between one and three Sims while seeking to deepen the relationships they do have.

Lifestyle Effects
Keeps Good Friends longer but has a harder time staying friends with Sims at lower relationship levelsMore likely to gain Long Term Sentiments with friendsCan "Ask to Be Confidant" and gains unique flavor socials with ConfidantTense when without friends or when friend group grows to four or more

traits:trait_Lifestyles_HungryForLove.label: Hungry for Love
traits:trait_Lifestyles_HungryForLove.description:
Sims living a Hungry for Love Lifestyle have a strong desire to be in a relationship and struggle to deal with life without one. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, engage with romantic media or attempt to romance other Sims. 

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when in a romantic relationshipPrefers romantic behavior and is more likely to succeed when being romanticAcquires romantic Sentiments more easilyEnjoys romantic mediaIncreased Work Performance when in a romantic relationshipTense when not in a romantic relationship

traits:trait_CorporateWorker_LegendarySt.label: Legendary Stamina
traits:trait_CorporateWorker_LegendarySt.description: These sims have learned how to keep their energy up when the office coffeepot is empty. Their energy will drain more slowly than other sims.

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Sedentary.label: Sedentary
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Sedentary.description:
Sims who live a Sedentary Lifestyle favor relaxing and lounging in all its forms, and prefer to avoid exerting themselves. To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, pursue low-energy activities that allow a Sim to relax, sit, and lounge around or join a low-energy career.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when performing low-energy activitiesPrefers to perform low-energy activitiesIncreased work performance in low-energy careersDecreased work performance in high-energy careersTense when performing high-energy activities or when going too long without doing relaxing activities

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Energetic.label: Energetic
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Energetic.description:
Sims who live an Energetic Lifestyle love to stay active and keep moving! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, seek out athletic and sporty activities or join a high-energy career.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits when performing high-energy activitiesPrefers to perform high-energy activitiesIncreased work performance in high-energy careersDecreased work performance in low-energy careersDislikes low-energy activities and becomes tense when going without activity for too long

traits:trait_Lifestyles_Technophobe.label: Technophobe
traits:trait_Lifestyles_Technophobe.description:
A Lifestyle dedicated to the avoidance of technology! To acquire or maintain this Lifestyle, a Sim should pursue a livelihood without Power or technology, even going so far as to sabotage or break electronics from time to time.

Lifestyle Effects
Various benefits relating to broken electronics, when on a lot without Power, or when on a lot using the Off-the-Grid Lot TraitPrefers to avoid using technologyCan intentionally "Sabotage" electronicsDecreased work performance in tech-related careersTense when using technology

traits:trait_Excursion_Mountaineer_Rank2.label: Capable Mountaineer
traits:trait_Excursion_Mountaineer_Rank2.description: These Sims have good working knowledge of climbing routes up Mount Komorebi. This will slightly improve their odds of success when rock climbing, completing goals on their next excursion, and in other outdoor activities.

traits:trait_Nature_CountryCaretaker_Nat.label: Nature Conversationalist
traits:trait_Nature_CountryCaretaker_Nat.description: Nature Conversationalist Sims have improved relationships with animals, allowing their animals to live longer, happier lives. Rabbits and birds will bring them more gifts. And they can interact with plants in unique ways, receiving more yield from harvests. They will also receive free grocery delivery, and, when residing in Henford-on-Bagley, a discount on their bills.

traits:Trait_AnimalEnthusiast.label: Animal Enthusiast
traits:Trait_AnimalEnthusiast.description: These Sims are obsessed with animals, and will seek their company often. They will have an easier time caring for animals and getting closer to them.

traits:trait_LactoseIntolerant.label: Lactose Intolerant
traits:trait_LactoseIntolerant.description: These Sims will become sick if they eat dairy, but will feel great if they have avoided it for a while.

traits:trait_Dauntless.label: Dauntless
traits:trait_Dauntless.description: Dauntless Sims always live life to the fullest, and the Grim Reaper has a soft spot for dauntless pleas during matters of life and death. Risky fun sure has its perks.

traits:Trait_Fear_DisappointingParents.label: Fear of Disappointing Parents
traits:Trait_Fear_DisappointingParents.description: Oh no. What are they going to think? {0.SimFirstName} will not be able to relax and will have difficulty living up to his parent's expectations.

traits:trait_SociallyAwkward.label: Socially Awkward
traits:trait_SociallyAwkward.description: These Sims tend to struggle in social situations and build charisma more slowly, but gain powerful Moodlets and Sentiments when they are able to overcome their awkwardness and accompanying nervousness to form close friendships.

traits:trait_Untroubled.label: Untroubled
traits:trait_Untroubled.description: Untroubled Sims always bounce back. Being a Drama Llama can leave relationships rocky. Nothing says carefree like moving on and letting go.

traits:trait_TeenPranks_Prankster.label: Authentic Prankster
traits:trait_TeenPranks_Prankster.description: {0.SimFirstName} has reached peak Mischievousness at such a young age that he can reap the reward. {0.SimFirstName} can now continue Teen pranks even after growing up, no longer gets caught pranking, and has an easier time doing funny or mischief socials.

traits:trait_Entrepreneur_TheKnowledge.label: The Knowledge
traits:trait_Entrepreneur_TheKnowledge.description: Sims with this trait get salary boosts as well as more receptive responses when chatting to other Sims.

traits:trait_Iconic.label: Iconic
traits:trait_Iconic.description: Iconic Sims are the ones everyone wants to follow. They've earned the admiration of their peers, and can now set their sights anywhere on the world wide web.

traits:trait_Highflier.label: Highflier
traits:trait_Highflier.description: Highflier Sims have the potential to be more successful, especially in business.

traits:trait_PartyAnimal.label: Party Animal
traits:trait_PartyAnimal.description: These Sims tend to enjoy parties and letting every other Sim know by hyping up a crowd and performing party tricks.

traits:Trait_Fear_Failing_Class.label: Fear of Failing Classes
traits:Trait_Fear_Failing_Class.description: {0.SimFirstName} is feeling the pressure of passing his classes. {0.SimFirstName} will occasionally have trouble focusing in class due to the pressure.

traits:Trait_Fear_Homework.label: Fear of Homework
traits:Trait_Fear_Homework.description: {0.SimFirstName} didn't realize until now that homework is not just a suggestion but a requirement to get good grades and learn! {0.SimFirstName} will occasionally tense up when thinking about finishing his homework.

traits:Trait_Fear_Failing_AfterSchoolAct.label: Fear of Failing After-School Activities
traits:Trait_Fear_Failing_AfterSchoolAct.description: {0.SimFirstName} will occasionally relive his moment of failure and all of the emotions that came with it!

traits:trait_Relatable.label: Relatable
traits:trait_Relatable.description: Relatable Sims build friendly relationships with fellow teens faster.

traits:trait_Overachiever.label: Overachiever
traits:trait_Overachiever.description: These Sims tend to raise their skills faster and are happy when they finish work tasks but are a little harder to get along with as friends.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Hates Wakeup Time
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler rarely wakes up in a good mood. Toddlers with this Quirk are more likely to behave like grumpy bunnies when they wake up from a nap or sleep.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Hates Bedtime
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler hates bedtime and naptime. Toddlers with this Quirk tend to wake up shortly after falling asleep and will often ask their caregiver for various things to avoid sleeping.

traits:trait_reward_Child_Confidence_Low.label: Low Self-Esteem
traits:trait_reward_Child_Confidence_Low.description: These Sims become tense when they fail to gain skills or don't succeed in their career. They are also at high risk of developing a fear of failure.

traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_PackAnimal.label: Pack Animal
traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_PackAnimal.description: These Sims love improving themselves and others together. They have faster relationship and skill gain when training with friends!

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_GoodAp.label: Good Appetite
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_GoodAp.description: This Infant loves to eat. Infants with this Quirk will always accept the opportunity to feed, and they'll finish almost any food, regardless of how hungry they are.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_SelfSo.label: Self-Soother
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_SelfSo.description: This Infant will often try to self-soothe {0.SimPronounReflexive}. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to place their fingers and toes in their mouths to calm themselves when sad or angry, and especially when crying.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Loves Sounds
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler loves anything that makes sounds. Toddlers with this Quirk tend to be fascinated with radios, TVs, and toys that make sounds.

traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_IdeaPerson.label: Idea Person
traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_IdeaPerson.description: These Sims focused on a combination of mental and creativity skills during their childhood. Due to their efforts they can now paint, write, program, and write songs faster. Any writer's block will also vanish much more quickly!

traits:trait_ChildConfidence_High.label: High Confidence
traits:trait_ChildConfidence_High.description:
Sims with High Confidence have learned to believe in themselves. They become confident more easily, even when learning from mistakes. However, they can still be hurt when criticized. High Confidence becomes High Self-Esteem when aging into a teen.

A child Sim's confidence level can increase or decrease depending on skill gain, school performance, positive and negative socialization, succeeding or failing or skill-based activities, confident or embarrassed moods, and more. Caregivers criticizing or praising a child's behavior also impacts their confidence levels.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Obsess.label: Loves Sounds
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Obsess.description: This Infant loves to hear sounds. Infants with this Quirk love to do anything that makes a sound, and they're more likely to wiggle when music is playing nearby.

traits:trait_Fear_Inferior.label: Fear of Being Inferior
traits:trait_Fear_Inferior.description: {0.SimFirstName} is afraid that {0.SimPronounSubjective} will never measure up and struggles with confidence. When losing confidence {0.SimPronounSubjective} will become tense. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} will also become easily embarrassed when criticized or energized when their effort is praised.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Good Appetite
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is always ready for food. Toddlers with this Quirk love to eat, which can make mealtime easier. But be careful! These little ones have been known to eat food off of the floor... even if it's spoiled.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Loves Being Carried
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler loves to be held. Toddlers with this Quirk love to be carried and especially love it when their Caregivers are the ones doing so. They're also more likely to ask to be picked up when they haven't been carried in a while.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Destructive
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is often destructive. Uh oh! Toddlers with this Quirk often behave like little monsters who take pleasure in the chaos they leave behind in their wake!

traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_PraticedHo.label: Practiced Host
traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_PraticedHo.description: These Sims are some of the best event hosts. Their friendly and funny socials during parties will always succeed.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Freque.label: Frequently Sneezes
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Freque.description: This Infant is always sneezing. Infants with this Quirk clear their little noses of particles and germs more frequently. It's perfectly normal and healthy!

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_PeesDu.label: Free-Air Tinkler
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_PeesDu.description: This Infant often pees during diaper changes. Infants with this Quirk are more sensitive to the air temperature in the room during diaper changes, which results in them peeing frequently during them. Watch out!

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Freque.label: Frequently Hiccups
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Freque.description: This Infant hiccups all the time. Infants with this Quirk have more gas in their tummy and hiccup more frequently.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_LovesW.label: Loves Wakeup Time
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_LovesW.description: This Infant is often bright and sunny upon awaking. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to be happy when they wake up.

traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_Headstrong.label: Headstrong
traits:trait_ChildSkillReward_Headstrong.description: These Sims have learned to discipline their body and minds. Their Focused and Confident moodlets will last longer!

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Wanderer
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler frequent wanders off. Toddlers with this Quirk are quick to run away after they're put down.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Loves Water
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler loves to play in and around water. Toddlers with this Quirk are more likely to do things like splash in toilets, ask to take baths, and seek out other activities involving water.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Little Singer
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler loves to sing. Toddlers with this Quirk enjoy singing and tend to sing at random times throughout the day.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Messy Eater
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is a little extra-messy around food time. Toddlers with this Quirk are more likely to cause messes when eating their food.

traits:trait_ChildConfidence_Low.label: Low Confidence
traits:trait_ChildConfidence_Low.description:
Sims with Low Confidence are at higher risk of receiving a Fear of Being Inferior, they get stressed when losing confidence, and they become embarrassed when a caregiver criticizes them. Support means everything to these Sims. If not addressed, Low Confidence becomes Low Self-Esteem when aging into a teen.

A child Sim's confidence level can increase or decrease depending on skill gain, school performance, positive and negative socialization, succeeding or failing or skill-based activities, confident or embarrassed moods, and more. Caregivers criticizing or praising a child's behavior also impacts their confidence levels.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is very particular about food. Toddlers with this Quirk regularly refuse food that's given to them and will even toss it from time-to-time. What a mess!

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_PeesDu.label: Feeding Tinkler
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_PeesDu.description: This Infant often pees while being fed. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to use their diaper during feedings.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_LovesB.label: Loves Being Held
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_LovesB.description: This Infant loves to be held. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to react positively when they're picked up or carried and upset when they're put down.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_RisesW.label: Early Riser
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_RisesW.description: This Infant prefers to rise with the sun. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to wake up when the sun comes up.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Aggressive
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is a little more aggressive than most. Toddlers with this Quirk like to roughhouse and are quick to hit, bite, or kick Sims (so long as they aren't good friends). They don't even have to be angry. Watch out!

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_HatesW.label: Hates Wakeup Time
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_HatesW.description: This Infant rarely wakes up in a good mood. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to behave like grumpy bunnies when they wake up from a nap or sleep.

traits:trait_reward_Child_Confidence_Hig.label: High Self-Esteem
traits:trait_reward_Child_Confidence_Hig.description: These Sims regularly become confident, even when failing to gain skills or succeed at work. They are also less likely to develop a fear of failure.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Heavy Sleeper
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is a heavy sleeper. Toddlers with this Quirk won't wake up from surrounding noises, are less likely to wake up from nightmares, and have an easier time getting good rest.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Light Sleeper
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is a light sleeper. Toddlers who are light sleepers have a tendency to wake up randomly when sleeping and will need to be put back to sleep if they're still tired.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Hates Being Carried
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler hates to be carried! Toddlers with this Quirk can manage on their own, thank you very much. Caregivers should be careful picking this toddler up as it will likely put the toddler in a bad mood.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_HatesB.label: Hates Being Held
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_HatesB.description: This Infant doesn't like to be held. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to get upset when they're picked up and happier to be set down.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Loves Books
