traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler loves books. Toddlers with this Quirk enjoy playing around bookshelves and are more likely to do book-related activities when able.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_HappyS.label: Happy Spitter
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_HappyS.description: This Infant is prone to spitting up while they feed. Infants with this Quirk are perfectly normal—their digestive systems are just still maturing.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_OnlySl.label: Snuggly Sleeper
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_OnlySl.description: This Infant only likes to fall asleep when they're being held. Infants with this Quirk cry when they're put down to sleep, even if they've been soothed. They prefer to sleep while being held or in a back carrier.

traits:trait_ChildConfidence_Neutral.label: Neutral Confidence
traits:trait_ChildConfidence_Neutral.description:
Sims with Neutral Confidence are still figuring out how they feel about their own capabilities. They can be easily encouraged or discouraged when gaining or losing confidence. A Sim with Neutral Confidence will have neither High nor Low Self-Esteem when aging into a teen.

A child Sim's confidence level can increase or decrease depending on skill gain, school performance, positive and negative socialization, succeeding or failing or skill-based activities, confident or embarrassed moods, and more. Caregivers criticizing or praising a child's behavior also impacts their confidence levels.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_MessyE.label: Messy Eater
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_MessyE.description: This Infant is extra messy around food time. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to get food all over themselves and the High Chair.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Gassy.label: Gassy
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Gassy.description: This Infant has tummy issues. Infants with this Quirk will be gassier and fussier.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Talker.label: Little Babbler
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_Talker.description: This Infant is very talkative. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to coo and babble both to themselves and others.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Loves Wakeup Time
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler is often bright and sunny upon awaking. Toddlers with this Quirk are more likely to be happy when they wake up compared to other Toddlers.

traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.label: Early Riser
traits:trait_Human_ToddlerPersonalityUpd.description: This Toddler prefers to rise with the sun. Toddlers with this Quirk are more likely to wake up when the sun comes up.

traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_PickyE.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_Human_Infant_Element_PickyE.description: This Infant is very particular about food. Infants with this Quirk are more likely to reject feedings unless they're hungry. They also aren't likely to finish their food unless they love it, regardless of how hungry they are.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Defiant.label: Defiant
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Defiant.description: These Horses tend to be more ornery when it comes to training and will develop skills more slowly. They also have a higher likelihood of failing Horse Jumps and Barrels.

traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_RewardTrait_.label: Well-Mannered Foal
traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_RewardTrait_.description: {0.SimFirstName} got a good head start on Temperament skill as a Foal, {0.SimPronounSubjective} is primed to learn more skills.

traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_Resilient.label: Hardy
traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_Resilient.description: These horses are born to run! They can train for long periods of time without getting fatigued, and work up a horse-sized appetite.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Aggressiv.label: Aggressive
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Aggressiv.description: These Horses are cranky! They act meaner towards other Sims and are more difficult to train.

traits:trait_MasterTrainer.label: Grand Champ Trainer
traits:trait_MasterTrainer.description: These Sims train Horse Skills faster, sell Horses for higher prices, have more confidence when riding and training, and almost always have a good time when riding. In fact, they are so good with Horses that even Horses have more fun when being ridden by them! They also can Give Competition Advice to aspiring riders.

traits:trait_NectarKnowItAll.label: Nectar Know-It-All
traits:trait_NectarKnowItAll.description: These Sims can craft pre-aged Nectar, have an iron bladder when it comes to drinking Nectar, and their negative emotions have less influence on their current mood.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_FreeSpiri.label: Free Spirit
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_FreeSpiri.description: These Horses thrive in the open outdoors and will become sad if left inside for too long.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Brave.label: Brave
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Brave.description: These Horses tend to be stout of heart, unfazed by bad weather or danger. They also have a higher chance of succeeding when using Horse Jumps and Barrels.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Friendly.label: Friendly
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Friendly.description: These Horses love all things social! They are more likely to have positive social interactions.

traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_EquestrianCe.label: Champion Horse
traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_EquestrianCe.description: A champion through and through! This Horse's Foals will gain Skills and that fighting spirit faster and have higher value.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Intellige.label: Intelligent
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Intellige.description: These Horses are all-around rapid learners, giving them an increased gain of all skills. As an added bonus, they're also brilliant conversationalists!

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Energetic.label: Energetic
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Energetic.description: These Horses are full of energy! They gain athletic skills faster but are slower to gain the Temperament Skill.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Independe.label: Independent
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Independe.description: These Horses are content on their own and don't need as much attention.

traits:trait_Rancher.label: Rancher
traits:trait_Rancher.description: These Sims excel at ranch life and take pride in their work. They enjoy ranch chores and caring for their Livestock.

traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_Playful.label: Playful
traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_Playful.description: These Horses love playing with toys and other Sims!

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Mellow.label: Mellow
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Mellow.description: These horses prefer relaxing over everything else! Because of their laid-back nature, they are quick to gain the Temperament skill and slow to gain athletic skills.

traits:trait_Fear_Horses.label: Fear of Horses
traits:trait_Fear_Horses.description: What a massive creature! One wrong move and everything could go wrong. {0.SimFirstName} won't be able to interact with horses until {0.SimPronounSubjective} Confronts the Fear.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Fearful.label: Fearful
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Fearful.description: These horses are scared of everything and will often become spooked. Due to their fearful nature, it will take them longer to gain Temperament Skill.

traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_Curious.label: Curious
traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_Curious.description: These Horses are naturally more curious and enjoy exploring objects and using Horse Jumps and Barrels.

traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Needy.label: Needy
traits:trait_Horse_Personality_Needy.description: These Horses need social interaction often. They will frequently approach Sims in the hopes of getting their attention.

traits:trait_HorseLover.label: Horse Lover
traits:trait_HorseLover.description: These Sims share a strong bond with Horses. They have an easier time socializing with and caring for Horses than other Sims.

traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_HorseBreedin.label: Champion Genes
traits:trait_Horse_Gameplay_HorseBreedin.description: Horses with Champion Genes have winner’s blood coursing through their veins! As a result, these horses will gain skills faster and hold a higher Simoleon value than the average horse.

traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Seeker.label: Pry of the Tiger
traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Seeker.description: {0.SimFirstName} is more successful when rummaging and sorting through junk mail. Best of all, {0.SimPronounSubjective} have the perfect alibi when caught breaking into someone's home: a Tiger Inspector Badge!

traits:trait_Handyperson_GoldenWrench.label: Resourceful Repairer
traits:trait_Handyperson_GoldenWrench.description: With a little ingenuity, scrap can be found even when fixing up small or damaged parts.

traits:trait_Snooping_Menace.label: Public Menace
traits:trait_Snooping_Menace.description: Public Menace Sims gain greater Social from Mean or Mischief Socials and don't care about other opinions when Breaking into homes.

traits:trait_Snooping_SafeKeeper.label: Safe Keeper
traits:trait_Snooping_SafeKeeper.description: Safe Keeper Sims make friends easier which also helps them find Secrets easier as well.

traits:trait_Fear_Eviction.label: Fear of Eviction
traits:trait_Fear_Eviction.description: {0.SimFirstName} is terrified that an Eviction is right around the corner. Every phone call, every knock on the door could be the Property Owner ready to finally kick {0.SimPronounObjective} out of {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} home.

traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Legend.label: Home Manager Maven
traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Legend.description: {0.SimFirstName} is more successful solving Tenants' Emergency and Maintenance Events, builds stronger relationships with Tenants, and has increased ratings on owned Residential Rentals.

traits:trait_MultiUnitGuide_Knowledgeabl.label: Knowledgeable Leaser
traits:trait_MultiUnitGuide_Knowledgeabl.description: This Sim has researched the ways of becoming a Residential Rental Property Owner, making {0.SimPronounObjective} better at increasing their Unit's Rating!

traits:trait_Wise.label: Wise
traits:trait_Wise.description: A Sim who’s experienced enough of life to know what really matters. These Sims enjoy reminiscing and sharing life’s wisdom, making them excellent Mentors for those willing to listen. Their years of experience allow them to naturally learn new Skills with ease, and their emotional intelligence reduces their angry and uncomfortable thoughts.

traits:trait_Generous.label: Generous
traits:trait_Generous.description: Caring, empathetic, and patient. These Sims are happiest when offering their time and money to help others. Everyone loves Generous Sims, but they can be a little too brazen with their donations.

traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Founta.label: Tomarang Expert
traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Founta.description: {0.SimFirstName} is better at cooking Tomarani Cuisine, finding Tassels, getting along with Sims with the Child of the Village trait, and will be more successful when exploring the Sulea Tiger Sanctuary and the cave at Beard Beard Cove.

traits:trait_Cringe.label: Cringe
traits:trait_Cringe.description: Sims who are obnoxiously oblivious and oftentimes met with polarizing reactions. Cringe Sims can be socially unaware of their surroundings at times, but have an adorable enthusiasm for life.

traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Discer.label: Neighborly
traits:trait_MultiUnit_Aspiration_Discer.description: Sims with this trait are better at negotiating Rent forgiveness, getting along with neighbors, won't have their belongings repossessed by their Property Owner, and host better Events.

traits:trait_Nosy.label: Nosy
traits:trait_Nosy.description: Sims who thrive on gossip, snooping, and spying. They have incredibly poor boundaries and don’t quite understand what personal space is, but they will discover secrets by any means necessary.

traits:trait_ChildoftheSEA.label: Child of the Village
traits:trait_ChildoftheSEA.description: These Sims love feeling anchored to their community and Tomarani culture. Keeping in touch with loved ones and engaging in activities that remind them of home is important for being Happy.

traits:love_Poly.label: Affection Aficionado
traits:love_Poly.description: Affection Aficionado Sims have slower Romantic Satisfaction loss in relationships with other Sims.

traits:trait_LoveStruck.label: Lovebug
traits:trait_LoveStruck.description: Sims with this trait are constantly swept up in the whirlwind of romance. They fall in love easily, often wearing their hearts on their sleeves.

traits:trait_RomanticallyReserved.label: Romantically Reserved
traits:trait_RomanticallyReserved.description: These Sims often tread carefully in the realm of love, preferring to take their time and build solid emotional connections before jumping headfirst into romance.

traits:trait_HeartToHeart.label: Heart to Heart
traits:trait_HeartToHeart.description: Having perfected the art of romance and love, these Sims are able to feel the bliss of satisfied couples and get an extra dose of happiness when around them.

traits:trait_Fear_Intimacy.label: Fear of Intimacy
traits:trait_Fear_Intimacy.description: {0.SimFirstName} struggles with physical and emotional connections. {0.SimPronounSubjective} find it difficult to trust people, be vulnerable, and create genuinely meaningful relationships.

traits:trait_RomanticSage.label: Romantic Sage
traits:trait_RomanticSage.description: Sims with the Romantic Sage trait have a learned optimistic and thoughtful outlook on romantic relationships. Their Romantic Satisfaction decreases slightly slower than other Sims, and when they receive a negative moodlet related to a romantic experience, they are able to Remember Positive Romantic Experiences to help ground themselves.

traits:love_Explorer.label: Seasoned Romantic
traits:love_Explorer.description: Seasoned Romantic Sims find their romantic relationships with other Sims grows faster. They also get over embarrassment faster since they know that you don't need to be embarrassed when it comes to love.

traits:trait_Fear_BeingAlone.label: Fear of Being Alone
traits:trait_Fear_BeingAlone.description: {0.SimFirstName} is experiencing intense anxiety and fear due to decreased romantic satisfaction in their relationship. If left alone, {0.SimPronounSubjective} will become tense and sad as their satisfaction decreases.

traits:trait_GhostWhisperer.label: Ghost Whisperer
traits:trait_GhostWhisperer.description: Ghost Whisperers make friends (and more) with Ghosts more easily. They will also get particularly excited while encountering ghosts of all kinds, Grim, and even Crows!

traits:trait_GrimRework_GrimBorn.label: Grimborn
traits:trait_GrimRework_GrimBorn.description: The offspring of the Grim Reaper carry an air of mystique. A scythe-shaped birthmark on their neck serves as a haunting reminder of their otherworldly lineage and their inevitable connection to the cycle of life and death.

traits:trait_ReaperCareer_DeathReward.label: Grim's Right Hand
traits:trait_ReaperCareer_DeathReward.description: Sims with this trait have achieved an understanding of what exists beyond the veil. They hold a different feeling about death and can handle grief with better coping skills. Having formed a personal (and professional) relationship with Grim, these Sims can avoid an untimely end knowing there's more to death than life.

traits:trait_Grief_Denial.label: Denial Grief
traits:trait_Grief_Denial.description: Sims with this Grief Type gain Bored and Fine moods as they turn away from processing their emotions while grieving. Sims can Cope Positively by Attending Grief Counseling, Gardening, Painting, Writing, Cooking, or Playing Instruments. If this Sim stays in Denial, their Grief can evolve into Anger or Blues Grief Types, prolonging their Grief.

traits:trait_Skeptical.label: Skeptical
traits:trait_Skeptical.description: Not entirely trusting of the majority of things you see or hear? Skeptical Sims like to challenge the universe to provide concrete proof that something is indeed as it might appear.

traits:trait_ChasedByDeath.label: Chased by Death
traits:trait_ChasedByDeath.description: Chased by Death Sims know that death follows their every move. While risky and dangerous behaviors may have deadly consequences, frequent near-death experiences give these Sims a desire to live each day to the fullest and progress along their soul's journey faster. Keenly aware of their own mortality, these Sims feel best when they are achieving something meaningful with their limited time left.

traits:trait_Grief_Anger.label: Anger Grief
traits:trait_Grief_Anger.description: Sims with this Grief Type often have intense frustration and frequent Angry Emotions, leading to outbursts and mean interactions. Sims can Cope Positively by Attending Grief Counseling, working out those frustrations in the gym (or at home) by Exercising or channeling {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} emotions through Playing Instruments. These activities can be a great outlet for all of that pent-up anger.

traits:trait_Grief_HoldTogether.label: Holding It Together
traits:trait_Grief_HoldTogether.description: Sims with this Grief Type manage their Grief with a positive outlook on life. They try to project Confident Emotions during the day to day, however sometimes Sad Emotions are able to slip their way in. Sims can cope with their Grief by Attending Grief Counseling and any other positive activities that enrich life. While Holding It Together is admirable, this Sim may find that their Grief transitions into Anger or Blues Grief Types, prolonging their Grief.

traits:trait_GrimRework_GrimDescendant.label: Grim Descendant
traits:trait_GrimRework_GrimDescendant.description: Offspring from a Grimborn Sims carry on the legacy of the Reaper!

traits:trait_MovingOn_PerspectivesOnDeat.label: Perspectives on Death
traits:trait_MovingOn_PerspectivesOnDeat.description: Someone in {0.SimFirstName}'s household Moved onto the Great Beyond and now new reflections of life, death, and everything in between stir within {0.SimPronounObjective}. These profound insights enhance {0.SimFirstName}'s ability to manage grief, making {0.SimPronounObjective} more resilient and likely to remain confident through difficult times. Additionally, it provides a boost to all Soul’s Journey gains, inspiring {0.SimFirstName} to enrich {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} own journey with newfound clarity and purpose.

traits:trait_EP17World_WellOfSouls_Coura.label: Courage of Edith
traits:trait_EP17World_WellOfSouls_Coura.description: These Sims are more successful when interacting with Edith, who can be found at the Well of Longing and Regret in Ravenwood. They can also use the Unnerving Stare on other Sims.

traits:trait_MovingOn_Reincarnated.label: Reborn
traits:trait_MovingOn_Reincarnated.description: This Sim has been reborn! Reborn Sims have special connections with Sims they once knew in their previous life and may have some somber feelings when visiting their old gravestones. Take this extra chance to live life to its fullest!

traits:trait_MovingOn_BurningSoul.label: Burning Soul
traits:trait_MovingOn_BurningSoul.description:
{0.SimFirstName}'s soul burns bright!

As a ghost, {0.SimFirstName} receives extra benefits to {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Ghost Mastery stamina, enabling {0.SimPronounObjective} to perform abilities more frequently.

The Burning Soul trait persists beyond death, accompanying {0.SimFirstName} into {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} next life after Rebirth. {0.SimFirstName} can retain one personality trait from {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} previous life with the Recall Past Life self-interaction, along with certain other traits by using the Peer Into Soul interaction available on mirrors.

If {0.SimFirstName} is reborn as a younger Sim, certain developmental skills will be immediately unlocked. As an added bonus, young adults and older get the extraordinary ability to defy the boundaries of life and death, enabling Transcendent WooHoo as a living Sim.

This trait is a one-time blessing, accompanying {0.SimFirstName} into {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} next life only once.

traits:trait_Macabre.label: Macabre
traits:trait_Macabre.description: Embrace your inner darkness - and your occasional intrusions of light. Macabre Sims are all about being their best, unique Sim self while still reveling in all that life (and the afterlife) has to offer.

traits:trait_MovingOn_BurningSoul_Reinca.label: Burning Soul
traits:trait_MovingOn_BurningSoul_Reinca.description:
{0.SimFirstName}'s soul burns bright!

As a ghost, {0.SimFirstName} receives extra benefits to {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Ghost Mastery stamina, enabling {0.SimPronounObjective} to perform abilities more frequently.

The Burning Soul trait persists beyond death, accompanying {0.SimFirstName} into {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} next life after Rebirth. {0.SimFirstName} can retain one personality trait from {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} previous life with the Recall Past Life self-interaction, along with certain other traits by using the Peer Into Soul interaction available on mirrors.

If {0.SimFirstName} is reborn as a younger Sim, certain developmental skills will be immediately unlocked. As an added bonus, young adults and older get the extraordinary ability to defy the boundaries of life and death, enabling Transcendent WooHoo as a living Sim.

This trait is a one-time blessing, accompanying {0.SimFirstName} into {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} next life only once.

traits:trait_Grief_Depression.label: Blues Grief
traits:trait_Grief_Depression.description: Sims with this Grief Type frequently experience Sad Emotions and are prone to gloomy interactions. Sims can Cope Positively by Attending Grief Counseling, Reading, Painting, improving their Logic Skill, practicing Wellness, or Playing Instruments. These activities can help lift their spirits and provide a healthy outlet for their emotions.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_SecretSpice.label: Secret Spice
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_SecretSpice.description:
{0.SimFirstName}’s experience allows {0.SimPronounObjective} to increase the quality of food and drink with just a dash of spice.

Unlocks Add Secret Spice on consumables.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_InTheZone.label: In the Zone
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_InTheZone.description: Skill building is {0.SimFirstName}’s jam, and {0.SimPronounSubjective} can enter moments of serious focus where {0.SimPronounSubjective} won’t have to worry about motives.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_SecondWind.label: Second Wind
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_SecondWind.description: {0.SimFirstName} can get revitalized while exercising, so {0.SimPronounSubjective} can keep going, going, going!

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PowerfulPerform.label: Powerful Performer
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PowerfulPerform.description: {0.SimFirstName}’s a talented performer, no matter the skill. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} builds relationships with {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} audience and makes spectators’ negative emotions melt away.

traits:trait_MotivatingSpeaker.label: Motivational Speaker
traits:trait_MotivatingSpeaker.description: Motivational Speakers motivate others through motivating speeches. A motivating speech provides a boost to skill gain, a higher chance for skill perk discovery, and a happiness mood boost.

traits:trait_SmallBusiness_Reputation_Co.label: Utopian Advocate
traits:trait_SmallBusiness_Reputation_Co.description: {0.SimFirstName} feels internal satisfaction or conflict depending on how {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Personality Traits align with running a Dreamer Small Business. {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} family and friends might feel the sense of shame or pride, and the customers either praise or argue with {0.SimFirstName} from time to time. This trait will remain even after selling {0.SimFirstName}'s Small Business, but it will disappear if {0.SimPronounSubjective} decides to Rebrand {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Small Business or run a Schemer Small Business.

traits:trait_Idealist.label: Idealist
traits:trait_Idealist.description: These Sims hold high moral standards and strive for a better world guided by their values and principles. They are committed to doing what they believe is right, even when it's challenging.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedCrea.label: Pigeonholed
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedCrea.description: {0.SimFirstName} focused on creative skills. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} builds creative skills much faster but has a harder time with other skills.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AspirationalCre.label: Aspirational Creator
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AspirationalCre.description: {0.SimFirstName} is greatly fulfilled by {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} craft. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} earns Satisfaction Points from crafting excellent quality objects.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedSoci.label: Pigeonholed
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedSoci.description: {0.SimFirstName} focused on social skills. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} builds social skills much faster but has a harder time with other skills.

traits:trait_SmallBusiness_Reputation_Co.label: Supreme Trickster
traits:trait_SmallBusiness_Reputation_Co.description: {0.SimFirstName} feels internal satisfaction or conflict depending on how {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Personality Traits align with running a Schemer Small Business. {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} family and friends might feel the sense of shame or pride, and the customers either praise or argue with {0.SimFirstName} from time to time. This trait will remain even after selling {0.SimFirstName}'s Small Business, but it will disappear if {0.SimPronounSubjective} decides to Rebrand {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Small Business or run a Dreamer Small Business.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AspirationalThi.label: Aspirational Thinker
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AspirationalThi.description: {0.SimFirstName} enjoys a good think! So much so that {0.SimPronounSubjective} earns Satisfaction Points as {0.SimPronounSubjective} spends time with mental skills.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_Spacebender.label: Spacebender
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_Spacebender.description:
{0.SimFirstName}’s mental pursuits brought {0.SimPronounObjective} a glimmer of true understanding. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} can now bend the fabric of space and time to teleport.

Unlocks Spacebend Here on terrain.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AuraMental.label: Mental Aura
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AuraMental.description:
Truly, a leader of thought. {0.SimFirstName} can channel {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} experience into an aura that helps nearby Sims build mental skills faster.

Unlocks Activate Mental Aura on self.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_SkillfulSleep.label: Skillful Sleep
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_SkillfulSleep.description:
An experienced Sim like {0.SimFirstName} can build skills in {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} sleep, literally! {0.SimFirstName}’s projection can use most skill-building objects while {0.SimPronounSubjective} rests.

Unlocks Skillful Sleep on beds.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_FinalTouch.label: Final Touch
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_FinalTouch.description:
{0.SimFirstName}’s experience allows {0.SimPronounObjective} to increase the quality of objects with just one touch.

Unlocks Add Final Touch on crafted objects.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AuraActive.label: Active Aura
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AuraActive.description:
Is it time to start coaching? {0.SimFirstName} can channel {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} experience into an aura that helps nearby Sims build active skills faster.

Unlocks Activate Active Aura on self.

traits:trait_BelovedBrand.label: Beloved Brand
traits:trait_BelovedBrand.description: These Sims form a brand that is beloved by everyone, leading to more successful Small Businesses. Any Small Business they run will automatically have more positive reviews, and customers will leave with a positive relationship bonus if they had a good time.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_StrongerWithAge.label: Stellar Stamina
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_StrongerWithAge.description: {0.SimFirstName}'s persistence granted {0.SimPronounObjective} improved stamina. {0.SimFirstName} is very slow to lose energy and will never get Dangerously Tired.

traits:trait_Fear_BeingCanceled.label: Fear of Being Exposed
traits:trait_Fear_BeingCanceled.description: {0.SimFirstName} suspects those whispers seem to be about {0.SimPronounObjective} and feel uneasy about it!

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_MentalExercise.label: Mental Muscles
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_MentalExercise.description: {0.SimFirstName} can build muscle with brain power! However, if {0.SimPronounSubjective} neglects {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} mental skills, {0.SimFirstName} will eventually lose muscle definition.

traits:trait_Shady.label: Shady
traits:trait_Shady.description: These Sims excel at exploiting situations and bending rules for personal gain, often without regard for conventional ethics or fairness. They thrive in mischievous activities and can influence others to adopt their way of living.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedMent.label: Pigeonholed
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedMent.description: {0.SimFirstName} focused on mental skills. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} builds mental skills much faster but has a harder time with other skills.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AuraCreative.label: Creative Aura
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_AuraCreative.description:
What an inspiring presence! {0.SimFirstName} can channel {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} experience into an aura that helps nearby Sims build creative skills faster.

Unlocks Activate Creative Aura on self.

traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedActi.label: Pigeonholed
traits:trait_MasteryPerk_PigeonholedActi.description: {0.SimFirstName} focused on active skills. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} builds active skills much faster but has a harder time with other skills.

traits:trait_FairyStories_Initiation_Fay.label: Fairy Influence
traits:trait_FairyStories_Initiation_Fay.description: These Sims seem to leave a big impact! Relationship fluctuations are bigger when socializing with Fairy Sims and Gnomes—for better or worse.

traits:trait_FairyStories_LightPath_Ligh.label: Happily Harmonious
traits:trait_FairyStories_LightPath_Ligh.description: Harmonious Fairies know how to have Fun—sharing the Fairy Journey with others, as well as lending a helping hand to Sims and plants alike!

traits:trait_PlantLover.label: Plant Lover
traits:trait_PlantLover.description: Plant Lover Sims treat each and every plant like the little Sim they are. Being a friend to plants is not always easy on a Plant Lover's emotions, but luckily these Sims don't need any skill to share their special interest, just a big heart!

traits:trait_BohemianStyle_NaturesBestBu.label: Nature's Best Bud
traits:trait_BohemianStyle_NaturesBestBu.description: Sims with this trait find their Balance out in the natural world, and have a little extra fun when they run into the Garden Pal of Innisgreen.

traits:trait_EP19Quests_GreatGnome.label: Now You Gnome
traits:trait_EP19Quests_GreatGnome.description: Sims in the gnome can now receive The Great Gnome's gifts, a connection most Sims would kick for! If they can appease the Gnome's timely desires, goodies shall be granted! However, The Great Gnome can be fickle and the wrong choice may yield an ailing outcome.

traits:trait_HolisticHealer.label: Holistic Healer
traits:trait_HolisticHealer.description: Sims with this trait will no longer receive Ailments when socializing with Sims who have one. Their dedication to natural medicines provides a certain level of immunity, though they're still susceptible if they become Very Imbalanced or are subject to a Fairy Ability!

traits:trait_FairyStories_Initiation_Int.label: Into the Everdew
traits:trait_FairyStories_Initiation_Int.description: These Sims dive headlong into the Fairy Journey and have a headstart on climbing through the Fairy Ranks, while having a bit of extra fun while doing it.

traits:trait_Mystical.label: Mystical
traits:trait_Mystical.description: Feeling a strong affinity for both the natural and supernatural, Mystical Sims see higher purpose in living harmoniously in each world and sharing that with other Sims. These Sims learn Apothecary and Gardening Skills faster and have an easier time building friendships with Occult Sims. Mystical Sims can offer to Grant a Sacred Blessing to other Sims, which increases Balance for both Sims if accepted.

traits:trait_OccultFairy_HighFaeLineage.label: High Fae Lineage
traits:trait_OccultFairy_HighFaeLineage.description: Having Fairy Parents has brought a magical lineage that gives a Sim additional Fairy Experience gain from all sources.

traits:trait_Rogue.label: Disruptive
traits:trait_Rogue.description: Disruptive Sims are driven to interact with the world by messing with it. They can spread interpersonal chaos by Giving Bad Balance Advice or stick it to nature by Disrupting Plants. Disruptive Sims build Mischief Skill faster but are slower to regain Balance than most Sims.

traits:trait_ProblemFairy.label: Problem Fairy
traits:trait_ProblemFairy.description:
Sims who are seen using {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} Fairy Abilities in the Coast of Adhmor are labelled "Problem Fairies" by the Fairy Council.

Sims can appeal to have this status removed at the Mossveil Fairy Hub or by speaking to the local Fairy Liaison.

As long as {0.SimPronounSubjective} has this status, {0.SimFirstName} can't Collect Daily Fairy Dust Ration at the Mossveil Fairy Hub.

traits:trait_NaturalMeds_HealsWithPills.label: Well-Balanced Practitioner
traits:trait_NaturalMeds_HealsWithPills.description: These Sims have mastered the craft of healing and gain Balance while mixing Elixirs, Curing Ailments, or helping others in the Naturopath Career.

traits:trait_FairyStories_DarkPath_DarkP.label: Delightfully Discordant
traits:trait_FairyStories_DarkPath_DarkP.description: These Fairies delight in wreaking havoc on the lives of other Sims, regaining Balance and Fun when negatively impacting others with Fairy Abilities.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Formed Bonds Away from Home
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim got kind of homesick while on a Getaway. They had to work through it and made a new friend along the way! As an Adult, they'll build friendly relationships with Sims more quickly.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Super Sibling
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time hanging out with their siblings. As an Adult, they will gain Friendship with their family Sims more quickly.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Good Student
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim really wanted to get good grades and be the best student they could be in school! As an Adult, they'll remain Inspired longer when becoming Inspired. They'll also advance more quickly in the Education Career and finish their University homework more quickly. (Discover University)

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Had an Evil Best Imaginary Friend
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They formed a special relationship and did some questionable things. It was said their Imaginary Friend was kind of...Evil. As an Adult, their Mean Socials will succeed more easily.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_ArtMusic.label: Artfully Enriched
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_ArtMusic.description: {0.SimFirstName} returned from a Getaway brimming with creative inspiration! With the Remember Artistic Getaway Memories self-interaction unlocked, {0.SimPronounSubjective} can enjoy a skill boost while practicing Painting or playing Musical Instruments, and won’t lose Bladder or Hunger needs as quickly!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Childhood of Crime
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim liked to swipe things and dreamed of a glamorous future in crime! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Criminal Career.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Action-Packed Childhood
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was very active and challenged themselves to do different athletic activities! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Athlete Career.

traits:trait_SpecialNPCs_Cryptid_FormerC.label: Previously a Peculiar Plumbird
traits:trait_SpecialNPCs_Cryptid_FormerC.description: Less of a Plumbird, but still peculiar.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Honorary Childhood Swim Team Member
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim found a lost Swim Team Scrapbook and thought it was pretty inspirational. They spent time trying to follow in the Swim Team's footsteps. As an Adult, they'll lose less Energy Need when swimming.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Danger Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to push themselves and live dangerously, prove to the world how rough and tumble they were! As an Adult, they've acquired a resistance to food poisoning from spoiled food, won't get scared as easily, and they can better endure Extreme Heat and Cold (Seasons). Guess that risky behavior paid off this time!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Explorer Extraordinaire
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to see the whole world, and they traveled a lot. They learned a lot along the way and made some amazing memories. As an Adult, they'll remain Energized longer when becoming Energized.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Had a Creative Best Imaginary Friend
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They formed a special relationship and spent a lot of time doing arts and crafts. As an Adult, this Sim will build creative Skills more quickly.

traits:trait_Human_EP20_IF_BuddingEvilPe.label: Budding Evil Persona
traits:trait_Human_EP20_IF_BuddingEvilPe.description: These Sims have had terrific time with their Evil Imaginary Friends. When they become Young Adults, they can evolve this into the Evil trait as a bonus Personality Trait!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Had a Green Thumb as a Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim learned about plant needs and how to care for them. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Gardening Skill.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Into Archery as a Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to become a master Archer, just like their heroes! They actually won some competitions and learned a lot about honing in on a target. As an Adult, they'll remain Focused longer when becoming Focused.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Childhood Ocean Explorer
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to explore the whole ocean! Obviously, that was a little impossible to do, but they spent a lot of time in it swimming and Kayaking. As an Adult, they'll be invigorated while on the water and lose less Energy Need while on a watercraft vehicle.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Fisher-kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to catch Rare Fish, and they did! It wasn't easy either. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Fishing Skill. They'll also advance more quickly in the Fishing Part Time Career. (Island Living)

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Crafty Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time making things. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Papercraft Skill, as well as in the Painter and Art Critic Careers.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Mischief.label: Clever Rogue
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Mischief.description: {0.SimFirstName} came back from a Getaway with tricks up {0.SimPronounPossessiveDependent} sleeve! Unlocking the Remember Mischievous Getaway Memories self-interaction gives {0.SimPronounObjective} a temporary boost to Mischief skill, extra Social and Fun when pulling off Mean socials, and the ability to sabotage objects. Plus, prank socials will always land when on a Getaway.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Everyone's Little Helper
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to be extra useful and helped out with cleaning and caring for the house! As they get older, they'll advance more quickly in Teen and Adult Part-Time Careers.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Child Caregiver
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim loved dolls and infants! They spent time really caring for them and playing caretaker. As an Adult, they'll build relationships with Infants and Toddlers more easily.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Established Image as a Child
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim challenged themselves to establish their own image in fashion! As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Style Influencer Career.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Social.label: Suave Speaker
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Social.description: {0.SimFirstName} returned from a Getaway with charm to spare! Unlocking the Remember Social Getaway Memories self-interaction gives {0.SimPronounObjective} a temporary boost to Charisma, Romance, and Comedy skills, slows Bladder and Hunger decay while socializing, and guarantees success on Getaway-specific socials. Introductions now spark extra-friendly connections, making {0.SimFirstName} unforgettable!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Aspiring Author
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time reading and writing. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Writer Career.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Had a Goofball Best Imaginary Friend
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They formed a special relationship and spent a lot of time being Goofballs together. As an Adult, their pranks will succeed more often.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Center of Attention
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was such a ham! They wanted everyone to watch them, and they loved to entertain. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Entertainer Career.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_FoodDrink.label: Taste Refined
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_FoodDrink.description: {0.SimFirstName} returned from a Getaway with a sharpened palate and a love for the culinary! With the Remember Tasty Getaway Memories self-interaction unlocked, {0.SimPronounSubjective} gains a skill boost while Cooking, Baking, mixing drinks, or repairing objects, and occasionally won’t lose Hunger or Bladder Needs as quickly!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Childhood Collector
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim started their own collection and had dreams of expanding it in future! As an Adult, they'll have a better chance at winning collectibles from Buddy Scoop, the Collector Kid.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Inspired Childhood Artist
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim found a lost Scrapbook and thought the art was amazing. They were inspired to make their own art! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Painting Skill, increase value for paintings sold, and perform better at the Freelancer career.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Outdoor.label: Rooted Wanderer
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Outdoor.description: {0.SimFirstName} returned from a Getaway feeling deeply connected to the great outdoors! With the Remember Outdoorsy Getaway Memories self-interaction unlocked, {0.SimPronounSubjective} gains a skill boost while Fishing, Gardening, or exploring nature, and won’t lose Hunger or Hygiene motives as quickly when outside!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Had a Competitive Best Imaginary Friend
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim imagined up an Imaginary friend out of their ImagineMe! Doll! They had a lot of challenging adventure together and also competed a lot! As an Adult, they'll remain Confident longer when becoming Confident.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Child Scientist
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was very interested in science! They studied the world around them and did scientific experiments. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Astronaut and Scientist Careers. They'll also perform better when working as an Engineer. (Discover University)

traits:trait_Nature_EP20_Asp_CritterHunt.label: Critter Enthusiast
traits:trait_Nature_EP20_Asp_CritterHunt.description: These Sims can chat with butterflies, as well as fish in fish bowls or aquariums. They can also Enthuse About Critters to other Sims! They have also learned the mystical mating ritual of butterflies, allowing them to be able to perform unique butterfly-themed Romantic interactions on other Sims.

traits:trait_SpecialNPCs_CryptidBaby.label: Fowl Offspring of Former Peculiar Plumbird
traits:trait_SpecialNPCs_CryptidBaby.description: Fowl Offspring of Former Peculiar Plumbird

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Natural Survivalist
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was always chasing danger, adventure, and muddy footprints. Whether it was camping in the backyard or exploring the deepest woods they could find, there was always preparing for the wildest life. As an Adult, they will gain more Energy when replenishing the Need outdoor.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Hobbies.label: Hobbyist
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_Hobbies.description: {0.SimFirstName} returned from a Getaway with a spark for all things creative and hands-on! Unlocking the Remember Crafty Getaway Memories self-interaction gives {0.SimPronounObjective} a temporary boost to hobby-related skills. While working on these, {0.SimPronounSubjective} won't lose Hygiene and Hunger needs as quickly!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Getaway Champion
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to experience true independence and challenged themselves to set out on their own away from home! As an Adult, they'll remain Confident longer when becoming Confident.

traits:trait_Aspiration_EP20_Asp_CoolKid.label: Coolest Kid
traits:trait_Aspiration_EP20_Asp_CoolKid.description: This Sim is officially the coolest kid on the block! They are a pro at socializing and know how to "own" other Sims when competing, as this Trait gives a win advantage when playing multiplayer video games or other games like Hide and Seek, or Rock Paper Scissors. They understand what "cool" means and all the other children are a bunch of Wannabes when near them.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Childhood Naturalist
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim really wanted to go on adventures and explore nature! As an Adult, they will enjoy time by themselves, and, as a result, their Social Need will decay slower.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Learned from the Past
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim really wanted to learn from the past, and they decided to do it by befriending a Ghost! The ghost actually knew a lot about life and passed that knowledge onto the future generation. As an Adult, this Sim will succeed more often when interacting with other Sims.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Practically a Fish
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim loved being in the water. They spent so much time in it they got wrinkled and also really good at Diving and playing around in water. As an Adult, they'll lose less Energy Need when swimming.

traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_KidActvities.label: Growth Kindled
traits:trait_Getaway_Reward_KidActvities.description: {0.SimFirstName} returned from a Getaway with a heart full of joy and a mind ready to grow! Unlocking the Remember Fun Getaway Memories self-interaction gives {0.SimPronounObjective} a temporary boost to skills like Video Gaming, and Archery. Playtime lasts longer before Bladder or Hunger Needs kick in, homework gets zipped through in no time, and friendships with children Sims bloom like magic!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Honorary Childhood Touring Musician
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim found an On Tour Scrapbook and wanted to follow in those Sims' footsteps and make their own music! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in Guitar, Piano, Singing and Violin Skills. They'll also receive more tips!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Little Enthusiast
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim decided to embrace being an Enthusiast and invested in their interests! As an Adult, they'll be Bored for a shorter period of time when Bored. There's so much to think about!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Business-kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to be a little Business Sim, and they did it! They sold things, made a good amount of money (for a kid), and got hands-on practice running a "business." As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Business Career, as well as in the Salaryperson Career. (Snowy Escape)

traits:trait_Competitive.label: Competitive
traits:trait_Competitive.description: Competitive Sims have to be the best at anything they put their sweaty focus on, especially games and physical activities. They're all about winning, so they take losing really personally. Depending on how they manage their Competitive Spirit, these Sims can either become an inspiration for Sim excellence or bask in the toxic pits of the abyss and become the ultimate sore loser!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Fed Myself as a Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to prove that they were independent and able to feed themselves! They learned a lot about making food along the way. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Culinary Career and the Barista and Fast Food Part-Time Careers.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Rough'n Tumble Childhood
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim wanted to be a rugged outdoor survivalist, and they spent a lot of time outside learning about nature! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Fitness Skill.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Expanded Taste Buds
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was very interested in trying food from all over the world! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Gourmet Cooking Skill.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Miniature Photographer
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim really wanted to be a successful Photographer. They even made some money doing it! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Freelance Fashion Photographer Career.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Annoyed Everyone and Everything
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was sort of...annoying. They sure did love a good prank! But hey, they had fun. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Mischief Skill.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityCreativ.label: Strong Creative Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityCreativ.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Moderate Creative Affinity trait. They will have stronger improved skill gain in Creative Skills and produce better results when using Creative Skills.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityPhysica.label: Strong Physical Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityPhysica.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Moderate Physical Affinity trait. They will have stronger improved skill gain in Physical Skills and produce better results when using Physical Skills.

traits:trait_NobleCareer_Promised.label: Promised Noble Inheritance
traits:trait_NobleCareer_Promised.description: This Sim has been promised by a Noble family member to take over their Career if they abdicate or pass away. Promised Sims won't be eligible if they leave the Noble Career, move Kingdoms or someone else is promised instead.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityPhysica.label: Moderate Physical Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityPhysica.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Mild Physical Affinity trait. They will have moderately improved skill gain in Physical Skills and produce better results when using Physical Skills.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityMental2.label: Moderate Mental Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityMental2.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Mild Mental Affinity trait. They will have moderately improved skill gain in Mental Skills and produce better results when using Mental Skills.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityCreativ.label: Moderate Creative Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityCreativ.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Mild Creative Affinity trait. They will have moderately improved skill gain in Creative Skills and produce better results when using Creative Skills.

traits:trait_NobleCareer_RegalRomancer.label: Regal Romancer
traits:trait_NobleCareer_RegalRomancer.description: These Noble Sims know the value of seduction and can use their charm to enhance their Romantic interactions with other Noble Sims. They can also seduce rivals into abdicating the throne!

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinitySocial1.label: Mild Social Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinitySocial1.description: This Sim was born into a Dynasty with the Social Affinity Perk. They will have slightly improved skill gain in Social Skills.

traits:trait_NobleCareer_BlueBlood.label: Blue Blood
traits:trait_NobleCareer_BlueBlood.description: These Sims have nobility flowing through their veins. Socializing with other Nobles and building Charisma comes naturally to them.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityPhysica.label: Mild Physical Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityPhysica.description: This Sim was born into a Dynasty with the Physical Affinity Perk. They will have slightly improved skill gain in Physical Skills.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityCreativ.label: Mild Creative Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityCreativ.description: This Sim was born into a Dynasty with the Creative Affinity Perk. They will have slightly improved skill gain in Creative Skills.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityMental3.label: Strong Mental Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityMental3.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Moderate Mental Affinity trait. They will have stronger improved skill gain in Mental Skills and produce better results when using Mental Skills.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinitySocial2.label: Moderate Social Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinitySocial2.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Mild Social Affinity trait. They will have moderately improved skill gain in Social Skills and experience better results when using Social Skills.

traits:trait_Threadshifter.label: Threadshifter
traits:trait_Threadshifter.description: These Sims proved themselves to Anansi and were rewarded with the ability to shift their Noble Favor as they desire.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityMental1.label: Mild Mental Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinityMental1.description: This Sim was born into a Dynasty with the Mental Affinity Perk. They will have slightly improved skill gain in Mental Skills.

traits:trait_Whistleblower.label: Ironclad Reputation
traits:trait_Whistleblower.description: With an Ironclad Reputation, {0.SimFirstName} need no longer fear being extorted by other Sims! If {0.SimPronounSubjective} somehow ends up in a scandal anyway, {0.SimPronounSubjective} will have a much easier time apologizing for, or denying, it. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} will also find other Sims much more likely to co-operate when {0.SimPronounSubjective} tries to Extort them.

traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinitySocial3.label: Strong Social Affinity
traits:trait_DynastyPerk_AffinitySocial3.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had the Moderate Social Affinity trait. They will have stronger improved skill gain in Social Skills and experience better results when using Social Skills.

traits:trait_NobleCareer_ExRank.label: Former Noble Hustler
traits:trait_NobleCareer_ExRank.description: These Sims were previously in the Noble Career; they still know a thing or two about the quirks of high society.

traits:trait_Survivalist.label: Survivalist
traits:trait_Survivalist.description: Survivalists are most comfortable using camping equipment and living off the land.

traits:trait_IncrediblyFriendly.label: Incredibly Friendly
traits:trait_IncrediblyFriendly.description: Incredibly Friendly Sims are immediately liked when met with a nice introduction.

traits:trait_GreatStoryteller.label: Great Storyteller
traits:trait_GreatStoryteller.description: Great Storytellers always succeed at telling bigger and better stories!

traits:trait_Squeamish.label: Squeamish
traits:trait_Squeamish.description: Squeamish Sims are nauseated by the sight of creepy crawlies, vomiting, violence and death. These Sims become Uncomfortable near anything dirty.

traits:trait_StovesAndGrillsMaster.label: Stoves and Grills Master
traits:trait_StovesAndGrillsMaster.description: Stoves and Grills Masters have a chance to create Impeccable quality consumables that use stoves and grills!

traits:trait_TrueMaster.label: A True Master
traits:trait_TrueMaster.description: A True Master not only excels at Mind Control Powers, they also have greater stores of Vampire Energy to call upon.

traits:trait_TheMaster.label: I am the Master
traits:trait_TheMaster.description: I am the Master grants supernatural control. Command Powers used on Vampire Offspring always succeed.

traits:trait_RegainedHumanity.label: Regained Humanity
traits:trait_RegainedHumanity.description: Vampires with Regained Humanity seem kinder and safer. Sims are more likely to give permission to Drink from them to these Vampires.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_Unfeeling.label: Insensitive
traits:trait_LifeSkills_Unfeeling.description: Insensitive Sims are able to Question other Sims' negative emotions. They can also Instigate other Sims. Insensitive Sims will have a higher chance of failing socially when talking to Sims with bad emotions.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_E.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_E.description: It's good to be a Picky Eater. Keep all those nasty culinary concoctions away from the Sim. They will prefer to eat their favorite Quick Meal.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_BadManners.label: Bad Manners
traits:trait_LifeSkills_BadManners.description: Sims with Bad Manners can try to be Friendly, but will always fail using certain socials. They will often use gross manners, swear a lot, and never want to do the dishes.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_Mediator.label: Mediator
traits:trait_LifeSkills_Mediator.description: Mediator Sims have a higher chance at successfully apologizing to other Sims and can Mediate the Forums. They can also mend differences with Sims they have not been friendly with for a long time.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_Compassionate.label: Compassionate
traits:trait_LifeSkills_Compassionate.description: Compassionate Sims can help other Sims relieve their negative emotions. They can also empathize with them by Sharing Emotional Burdens. However, these Sims get stressed when being Mean.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_C.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_C.description: It's good to be a Picky Eater. Keep all those nasty culinary concoctions away from the Sim. They will prefer to eat their favorite Quick Meal.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_UncontrolledEmot.label: Uncontrolled Emotions
traits:trait_LifeSkills_UncontrolledEmot.description: Sims with Uncontrolled Emotions won't be able to relieve their negative emotions as fast as other Sims. When they have strong negative emotions, they may have an emotional meltdown.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Bear.label: I'm a Bear!
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Bear.description: Be the Bear! This child will accept nothing less than dressing as an amazing fruit-themed ruler of the forest. It will feel unbearable to wear any other outfits.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Loud.label: Loud
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Loud.description: This Sim is letting the world hear his voice! This Sim yells, makes noise on instruments, and will listen to music as loud as possible. Earplugs are advised for other family members.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_A.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_A.description: It's good to be a Picky Eater. Keep all those nasty culinary concoctions away from the Sim. They will prefer to eat their favorite Quick Meal.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_GoodManners.label: Good Manners
traits:trait_LifeSkills_GoodManners.description: Sims with Good Manners won't want to do any gross manners interactions, at least not in front of anyone. They also have a new Polite Introduction and can gain friendly relationships faster. Good Mannered Sims can also Offer Gratitude to the Host of a house they are visiting.

traits:trait_SuperParent_RoleModel.label: Role Model
traits:trait_SuperParent_RoleModel.description: Gives bonus Character Value scoring when near Toddlers, Children, or Teens.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_MeanStreak.label: Mean Streak
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_MeanStreak.description: It is time to be Mean just because. This Sim is feeling nasty and will relish the chance to be Mean to other Sims.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_Irresponsible.label: Irresponsible
traits:trait_LifeSkills_Irresponsible.description: Irresponsible Sims are uncomfortable at work, but ignoring bills and slacking off brings them joy. They may also encounter new situations when at work.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_Argumentative.label: Argumentative
traits:trait_LifeSkills_Argumentative.description: Argumentative Sims don't always start conversations on the right foot with Sims they don't like. Successfully apologizing is harder and they do try to assert their correctness more often than not.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_Responsible.label: Responsible
traits:trait_LifeSkills_Responsible.description: Responsible Sims perform better at their jobs and can teach children and teens how to be responsible.

traits:trait_LifeSkills_EmotionalControl.label: Emotional Control
traits:trait_LifeSkills_EmotionalControl.description: Sims who have the Emotional Control Trait can relieve negative moods by jogging, listening to certain music, blogging on the computer, or playing an instrument. In general, their negative emotions will go away faster than other Sims.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Rebellious.label: Rebellious
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Rebellious.description: Growing up means rebelling against the old fuddy duddy's rules. This Sim will argue with their parents more often, swear, and procrastinate when doing homework.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_D.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_D.description: It's good to be a Picky Eater. Keep all those nasty culinary concoctions away from the Sim. They will prefer to eat their favorite Quick Meal.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Distant.label: Distant
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Distant.description: This teen has become distant. Being near and interacting with family has started to stress them out. The world just doesn't understand them.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_B.label: Picky Eater
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_PickyEater_B.description: It's good to be a Picky Eater. Keep all those nasty culinary concoctions away from the Sim. They will prefer to eat their favorite Quick Meal.

traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Clingy.label: Clingy
traits:trait_ChildhoodPhase_Clingy.description: This Sim feels safest when interacting with their caregiver. There is no reason to interact with others when you have such an amazing person in your life. Forcing this Sim to interact with others will stress them out.

traits:trait_ArchaeologyScholar_MuseumPa.label: Museum Patron
traits:trait_ArchaeologyScholar_MuseumPa.description: These Sims are lovers of all things ancient. They will be especially confident at museums, and even more flirty while on dates there. They also have the unique ability to donate artifacts to the Simsonian Musuem.

traits:trait_JungleExplorer_TreasureHunt.label: Treasure Hunter
traits:trait_JungleExplorer_TreasureHunt.description: Treasure Hunters have a sharp eye and will occasionally find treasure and relics in Treasure Chests that other Sims miss.

traits:trait_HeroOfStrangerville.label: Hero of StrangerVille
traits:trait_HeroOfStrangerville.description: As the Hero of StrangerVille you will receive fan mail as well as being able to retell the tale of how you defeated the source of the infection.

traits:trait_Paranoid.label: Paranoid
traits:trait_Paranoid.description: Paranoid Sims feel that danger is around every corner, and that people are always talking about them. Paranoid Sims feel a sense of security while hanging out in basements.

traits:trait_Curses_NightStalker.label: Curse of the Night Wraith
traits:trait_Curses_NightStalker.description: A Spectral Stalker is hunting you. But where are they now?! Good luck trying to sleep.

traits:trait_Curses_PunchableFace.label: Curse of Unwarranted Hostility
traits:trait_Curses_PunchableFace.description: For some reason everyone just wants to be mean to you and even start fights with you.

traits:trait_Curses_HexOfDuelist.label: Curse of the Duelist
traits:trait_Curses_HexOfDuelist.description: Be prepared to get into more duels! It's going to be a lot harder to win, and rewards won't be as good.

traits:trait_Curses_FountainOfMagic.label: Curse of Uncontrollable Charge
traits:trait_Curses_FountainOfMagic.description: You now draw too much Magical Energy. All gains are increased.

traits:trait_Curses_TouchyFeely.label: Curse of Awkward Embraces
traits:trait_Curses_TouchyFeely.description: You're just really into hugging and touching others now. It's too hard to resist. Awkward.

traits:trait_Occult_WitchOccult_Bloodlin.label: Ancient Bloodline
traits:trait_Occult_WitchOccult_Bloodlin.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had a Strong or Ancient Bloodline trait. Sims with the Ancient Bloodline trait gain an additional talent point at each Spellcaster rank to spend towards perks. They also gain Spellcaster experience faster and reduce the chance of overloading by 50%.

traits:trait_Curses_Repulsiveness.label: Curse of Repulsiveness
traits:trait_Curses_Repulsiveness.description: What a horrifying visage! This will cause terror and disgust in all nearby Sims. Socializing will be much harder.

traits:trait_Curses_SweatyStench.label: Curse of Uncleansable Stench
traits:trait_Curses_SweatyStench.description: You are eternally drenched in the smelliest of gym sweat constantly. Showering does nothing!

traits:trait_Cauldron_Potion_Immortality.label: Immortal
traits:trait_Cauldron_Potion_Immortality.description: {0.SimFirstName} is immune from dying of old age.

traits:trait_Curses_InfectiousLaughter.label: Curse of Infectious Laughter
traits:trait_Curses_InfectiousLaughter.description: Sometimes you just can't stop laughing; even in inappropriate situations and often times spread it to others.

traits:trait_Nature_MasterMixer.label: Master Mixer
traits:trait_Nature_MasterMixer.description: A Master Mixer rarely fails when using potions on themselves.

traits:trait_Occult_WitchOccult_Bloodlin.label: Strong Bloodline
traits:trait_Occult_WitchOccult_Bloodlin.description: At least one of this Sim's parents had a Weak Bloodline trait. Sims with the Strong Bloodline trait gain an additional talent point at each Spellcaster rank to spend towards perks. They also gain Spellcaster experience faster and reduce the chance of overloading by 20%.

traits:trait_Curses_WildMagic.label: Curse of Scrambled Spells
traits:trait_Curses_WildMagic.description: You're losing control of your magic. Casting will sometimes have random powerful results.

traits:trait_Knowledge_SlingerOfSpells.label: Slinger of Spells
traits:trait_Knowledge_SlingerOfSpells.description: A Slinger of Spells generates much less charge when casting spells.

traits:trait_Occult_WitchOccult_Bloodlin.label: Weak Bloodline
traits:trait_Occult_WitchOccult_Bloodlin.description: This Sim's parents had no Bloodline traits. Sims with the Weak Bloodline trait gain an additional talent point at each Spellcaster rank to spend towards perks. They also gain Spellcaster experience faster and reduce the chance of overloading by 10%.

traits:trait_HeroicPresence.label: Heroic Presence
traits:trait_HeroicPresence.description: Heroic Sims gain Charisma more easily, and can also inspire other Sims with their presence.

traits:trait_PreparedVoyager.label: Prepared Voyager
traits:trait_PreparedVoyager.description: Sims who are Prepared Voyager's fill up their needs slightly when traveling.

traits:trait_SleightofHand.label: Sleight of Hand
traits:trait_SleightofHand.description: Sims with a Sleight of Hand can Pickpocket other Sims and will never get caught cheating at Sabacc.

traits:trait_SupremeAuthority.label: Supreme Authority
traits:trait_SupremeAuthority.description: Sims with Supreme Authority have an edge during fights and can show their might, encouraging other Sims to back down from hostile socials with them. These Sims are also less likely to die from anger.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_InitiationBo.label: Lunar Confidant
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_InitiationBo.description: These Sims get an initial relationship boost when introducing themselves to werewolves (positive or negative, depending on how they act!)

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Frisky
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Something has awoken within this Sim! Frisky Werewolves can sometimes get a little hot under the collar when their beast within is looking for some company. Fury gains increase while feeling Flirty.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Carnivore
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: This Sim has always had an appreciation for food, unfortunately this has a different meaning for Werewolves. This Sim must adhere to a very strict diet of fresh meat, very fresh meat.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Mark of the Wolf
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Symbols depicting a wolf, engraved on the Werewolf's heart by the light of the moon. With this mark, both natural Fury gains and Social decays are reduced.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_DormantWolf.label: Dormant Wolf
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_DormantWolf.description: The wolf sleeps soundly within {0.SimFirstName}. What would it take to awaken?

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.label: Lunar Link
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.description: Sims with a Lunar Link retain the special benefits of the Lunar Cycle they once felt as Werewolves, and can still Howl just like old times!

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Grumpy Wolf
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: This Sim might need a little extra rest in order to stay... balanced. Just don't poke a sleeping wolf.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Prideful
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: This Sim feels a special pride about being a Werewolf, and doesn't appreciate being made to feel otherwise. Aside from gaining Fury while embarrassed or uncomfortable, they also might take things a little too personally.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Wracked With Guilt
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Sometimes the weight of this Werewolf curse is too much to bear. Not only do these Sims gain extra Fury while sad, they also might feel a sliver of remorse for their actions.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Big Bad Wolf
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: The inner demon within is unleashed. Not only will this Sim gain additional Fury while angry, but will also need to fight other Sims in order to keep aggression down. If this wolf asks to come inside, best to say "Not by the hairs on my chinny chin chin!"

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Territorial
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: These Sims have an unusually high desire to "claim what's theirs," so to speak. This Sim will gain Fury if around another Werewolf's "boundaries." You see where this is going, right? right?

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Must Be Clean
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: This Sim gains Fury with poor Hygiene, and has a newfound appreciation for tongue-baths. Being a Werewolf is weird like that.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Feels Outcasted
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: This Sim gains Fury when feeling ignored or otherwise low on Social. You just like... wouldn't understand.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Sensitive Hearing
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: These Werewolf enhanced ears means the world can be a terrible cacophony sometimes... Things like the TV, loud radio, instruments, and other noise cause Fury to rise in this Sim.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Night Wolf
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Night Wolves prefer sleeping during the day, and gain Fury when deviating from a nocturnal sleep cycle.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Mark of the Forest
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Symbols depicting a forest, engraved on the Werewolf's heart by the light of the moon. With this mark, both natural Fury gains and Fun decays are reduced.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.label: Threatening Presence
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.description: Sims with a Threatening Presence inspire more fear in those around them, sometimes to the point of fainting. And Greg? Well, to them, he might as well be a cute puppy.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.label: Refined Lupine
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.description: Refined Lupines turn their noses up at the thought of losing control of their Fury, passively generating less of it over time.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.label: Chomp Champion
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.description: Sims turned into werewolves by Chomp Champions won't negatively react to being turned, and they'll want to join the Chomp Champion's pack too!

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_WerewolfAlly.label: Werewolf Ally
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_WerewolfAlly.description: These Sims have a special kinship with Werewolves, and aren't as alarmed by their Werewolfy antics.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Mark of the Night
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Symbols depicting a night sky, engraved on the Werewolf's heart by the light of the moon. With this mark, both natural Fury gains and Energy decays are reduced.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.label: Fanged Friend
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_AspirationTr.description: Fanged Friends get an additional boost to their relationships with both Werewolves and non-Werewolf Sims.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Restless Animal
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Restless Animals feel too constrained while indoors, and gain extra Fury without anything fun to do.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Survival Instincts
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: These Sims seem to have an extra sense for danger, gaining additional Fury while Scared or Tense, and try extra hard to keep themselves physically safe.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_GreaterWolfB.label: Greater Wolf Blood
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_GreaterWolfB.description: The moon has blessed {0.SimFirstName} with a Greater Wolf Blood, enhancing their Werewolf growth. Talk about high expectations!

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Hungry Like The Wolf
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: These Sims are more ravenous than they’ve ever been and gain Fury while hungry. This Sim might also be subject to sometimes extreme and sudden cravings.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Easily Excitable
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Oh! What's that? Is there fun happening over there?! This Sim now gains Fury while feeling playful, and while watching TV or playing videogames too! Like a hypersonic puppy about to hit critical mass.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Anti-Capitalist Canine
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Ever since the beast awakened, doubts about societal norms have begun to stir. This Sim now rejects the daily grind, and will gain extra Fury if forced to partake in this endless, crushing, rat-race.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Hates Being Wet
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Shower? Just don't. Rain? Just don't. This Sim loathes water and will gain extra Fury when wet.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Wolf Brain
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: These Sims have trouble with intellectual or logical pursuits when their wolf brain is constantly calling.

traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.label: Mark of the Hunt
traits:trait_OccultWerewolf_Temperaments.description: Symbols depicting the hunt, engraved on the Werewolf's heart by the light of the moon. With this mark, both natural Fury gains and Hunger decays are reduced.

traits:trait_SacredKnittingKnowledge.label: Sacred Knitting Knowledge
traits:trait_SacredKnittingKnowledge.description: Sims with this trait gain enhanced benefits to teaching other Sims how to knit. Sims are also immune to the foul magic of the Sweater Curse, and can dispel afflicted Sims from its snarly grasp. Lastly, Sims have the ability to craft unique knitted items, like a very special companion from a strange land, or The Forbidden Sweater which, honestly, is forbidden for a reason...

traits:trait_Freelancer_Career_Paranorma.label: Paranormal Investigator
