traits:trait_Freelancer_Career_Paranorma.description: This Sim is a certified Paranormal Investigator, issued by the Claude René Duplantier Guidry. Sims with this license are eligible to join the Federal Bureau of Spooky Investigation as a freelance investigator.

traits:trait_FastFastidious.label: Fast & Fastidious
traits:trait_FastFastidious.description: Sims don't get negative moodlets or lose fun while cleaning. Sim will clean at a more rapid pace and is more likely to become focused when cleaning, and for maximal cleaning efficiency, Fast & Fastidious Sims can use the "Power Clean" and "Power Vacuum" interactions.

traits:trait_FilthDweller.label: Filth Dweller
traits:trait_FilthDweller.description: This Sim no longer receives negative moodlets from living in dusty or messy environments. They loathe cleaning and love filth, and will receive Happy moodlets while in Dirty or Filthy houses. Additionally, they gain the ability to bond with and befriend Filth Fiends!

traits:trait_BoothBoss.label: Booth Boss
traits:trait_BoothBoss.description: Booth Bosses can set set higher markups and are more successful at Convincing Customers to Buy while using Food Stands and Sales Tables.

traits:trait_BatchCook.label: Batch Cook
traits:trait_BatchCook.description: Sims with this trait get duplicates of any recipe they cook with Prepped Ingredients.

traits:trait_Attuned.label: Attuned
traits:trait_Attuned.description: Attuned Sims have great insights into the mysteries of crystals. The jewelry they wear will remain charged for longer, and they can absorb energy from charged crystals.

traits:trait_ForeverFull.label: Forever Full
traits:trait_ForeverFull.description: Forever Full Sims never need to eat!

traits:trait_Infant_Cautious.label: Cautious
traits:trait_Infant_Cautious.description: These Sims appreciate the familiar but are slow to warm up to new experiences, locations, and Sims.

traits:trait_Loyal.label: Loyal
traits:trait_Loyal.description: Loyal sims value their relationships and fully commit to them, whether they are friendship, romance or even work! They avoid lying and cheating because their loved ones’ trust is very important to them.

traits:trait_ForeverFresh.label: Forever Fresh
traits:trait_ForeverFresh.description: Forever Fresh Sims never need to shower or bathe!

traits:trait_Infant_Intense.label: Intense
traits:trait_Infant_Intense.description: These Sims have big emotions and are easily entertained, but they are also more difficult to calm when in a bad mood.

traits:trait_FTUE_CareerMinded_initial.label: Career-Minded
traits:trait_FTUE_CareerMinded_initial.description: Career-Minded Sims get a leg-up in their chosen profession with performance boosts that help them get promoted faster.

traits:trait_Fear_Ghosts.label: Fear of Ghosts
traits:trait_Fear_Ghosts.description: {0.SimFirstName} won't want to remain near Ghosts for too long and might start believing Ghosts could be anywhere even when alone.

traits:trait_Toddler_Wild.label: Wild
traits:trait_Toddler_Wild.description: Spirited and full of Energy. These Toddlers love to explore and get Energized. They earn Movement skill slightly faster. They get Sad if they haven't been outside in a while.

traits:trait_Toddler_Angelic.label: Angelic
traits:trait_Toddler_Angelic.description: Idyllic, easygoing Toddlers. They are never defiant and they don't throw a tantrum. They can easily talk to strangers.

traits:trait_NewInTown_InspiredExplorer.label: Inspired Explorer
traits:trait_NewInTown_InspiredExplorer.description: Inspired Explorers build relationships and gain skills faster while outside their home neighborhood.

traits:trait_HighFlyer.label: Highflier
traits:trait_HighFlyer.description: Highfliers excel in careers by building skills and getting promoted at a faster rate!

traits:trait_Fear_Swimming.label: Fear of Swimming
traits:trait_Fear_Swimming.description: {0.SimFirstName} will be too scared of swimming in the water and run out immediately if he somehow ends up in the water.

traits:trait_Fear_Unfulfilled.label: Fear of Unfulfilled Dreams
traits:trait_Fear_Unfulfilled.description: {0.SimFirstName} feels unfulfilled and dissatisfied with how life is going. {0.SimFirstName} will occasionally become upset with his life direction.

traits:trait_Reward_Infant_Unhappy.label: Unhappy Infant
traits:trait_Reward_Infant_Unhappy.description: {0.SimFirstName} had an unfortunate start to life. As a result, expect {0.SimPronounObjective} to be a little more headstrong and defiant.

traits:trait_Fear_BeingJudged.label: Fear of Being Judged
traits:trait_Fear_BeingJudged.description: Those judgmental eyes feel like they are staring right at {0.SimFirstName}!

traits:trait_Fear_Fire.label: Fear of Fire
traits:trait_Fear_Fire.description: {0.SimFirstName} will want to run away and hide from fire and has an increased chance of starting fires accidentally.

traits:trait_Grouch.label: Grouch
traits:trait_Grouch.description: These Sims raise their Mischief skill faster by playing pranks and bothering others with their surprises.

traits:trait_MeltMaster.label: Melt Master
traits:trait_MeltMaster.description:
Melt Masters have devoted enough of their love and bodies to grilled cheese to truly become Gurus of Gruyere.

They can summon Grilled Cheese Sandwiches and Paint Grilled Cheese Paintings.

traits:trait_HOS_EV009Reward.label: Heart on Your Sleeve
traits:trait_HOS_EV009Reward.description: These Sims are driven by strong emotions, whose honesty reveal internal conflicts. They quickly form bonds with Loyal and similar Sims, but develop negative relationships faster with Mean or Evil Sims.

traits:trait_JungleExplorer_TreasureHunt.label: Mystical Sensing
traits:trait_JungleExplorer_TreasureHunt.description: Mystical Sensors are able to use energy to locate treasure and relics in Treasure Chests that other Sims miss.

traits:trait_Toddler_Inquisitive.label: Inquisitive
traits:trait_Toddler_Inquisitive.description: Curious explorers. These Toddlers gain Thinking skill slightly faster. They are happiest when learning something, and sad if they haven't learned anything lately.

traits:trait_Toddler_Silly.label: Silly
traits:trait_Toddler_Silly.description: Goofy and curious. These Toddlers love to tell jokes and get Playful. They earn Imagination skill slightly faster.

traits:trait_NeedsNoOne.label: Needs No One
traits:trait_NeedsNoOne.description: Sims that Need No One never need to socialize.

traits:trait_ActiveImagination.label: Active Imagination
traits:trait_ActiveImagination.description: These Sims gain boosts from imaginative activities gaining creative Skills faster but may get overwhelmed at times.

traits:trait_NightOwl_CrystalHelmet.label: Night Owl
traits:trait_NightOwl_CrystalHelmet.description: Night Owls build extra skill at night.

traits:trait_Fear_BeingCheatedOn.label: Fear of Being Cheated On
traits:trait_Fear_BeingCheatedOn.description: {0.SimFirstName} needs to talk with his partner and soon. Otherwise, {0.SimFirstName}'s relationship will continue to have problems unless he finds a way to deal with it.

traits:trait_NosyNeighbor.label: Confidante
traits:trait_NosyNeighbor.description: Confidantes are able to easily avoid boring conversations and are more successful in getting to know others.

traits:trait_Toddler_Independent.label: Independent
traits:trait_Toddler_Independent.description: These Toddlers love their freedom, and don't like to take orders from caregivers. They gain extra skill when they are left alone, and need less Attention than other Toddlers.

traits:trait_Infant_Wiggly.label: Wiggly
traits:trait_Infant_Wiggly.description: These Sims are always on the go and want to play and move about; however, they often struggle to fall asleep or pay attention for extended periods of time.

traits:trait_Reward_Infant_Happy.label: Happy Infant
traits:trait_Reward_Infant_Happy.description: Although not perfect, {0.SimFirstName} was quite a happy Infant! {0.SimFirstName} will tend to build positive relationships with Sims around {0.SimPronounObjective}.

traits:trait_Brave.label: Brave
traits:trait_Brave.description: Sims with this trait aren't as easily frightened. Brave Sims regain their composure faster than most Sims, and don't mind being near supernatural beings such as Ghosts or Skeletons. Brave Sims also stay Confident longer than most Sims!

traits:trait_Toddler_Clingy.label: Clingy
traits:trait_Toddler_Clingy.description: These shy Toddlers avoid Sims outside the household and get sad if left behind. They gain extra skill when taught. And they recover faster from bad moods when Comforted.

traits:trait_Top_Notch_Toddler.label: Top-Notch Toddler
traits:trait_Top_Notch_Toddler.description: {0.SimFirstName} got such a strong jump on skills as a toddler, they improve all other skills extra fast.

traits:trait_SeldomSleepy.label: Seldom Sleepy
traits:trait_SeldomSleepy.description: Seldom Sleepy Sims need less sleep than other Sims.

traits:trait_Fear_Magic.label: Fear of Magic
traits:trait_Fear_Magic.description: {0.SimFirstName} has been frightened by magic. Having another negative experience could escalate this fear into paranoia. Talking to others about debunking magic will solve this fear.

traits:trait_Kleptomaniac.label: Kleptomaniac
traits:trait_Kleptomaniac.description: These Sims don't mind "borrowing" things from others with a simple swipe, but will get Tense when they have not swiped anything in a while.

traits:trait_Happy_Toddler.label: Happy Toddler
traits:trait_Happy_Toddler.description: {0.SimFirstName} got a good jump on skills as a toddler. This helps them gain all skills a bit faster.

traits:trait_Toddler_Fussy.label: Fussy
traits:trait_Toddler_Fussy.description: Tiny trouble-makers who love to Cry, cause trouble, and Throw Fits.  But being noticed makes them Happy and helps them overcome negative Moodlets.

traits:trait_Jealous.label: Jealous
traits:trait_Jealous.description: These Sims get Jealous more easily than other Sims. They gain a boost of Confidence from being around their significant other, but get Tense if they haven't seen them recently.

traits:trait_Fear_BeingBurgled.label: Fear of Being Burgled
traits:trait_Fear_BeingBurgled.description: {0.SimFirstName} is nervous around burglars. {0.SimPronounSubjective|xxUpper} will avoid interacting with the burglar and try to run away.

traits:trait_Infant_Sensitive.label: Sensitive
traits:trait_Infant_Sensitive.description: These Sims are prone to diaper rash, are often picky with food, and can more easily become overstimulated by too much play and social interaction; however, they also rest more peacefully through the night when soothed.

traits:trait_Infant_Sunny.label: Sunny
traits:trait_Infant_Sunny.description: These Sims are bursting with smiles and giggles and enjoy engaging with other Sims, but they do require more social attention.

traits:trait_EV008_Merciless.label: Merciless
traits:trait_EV008_Merciless.description: Sims with this trait level up Mischief faster and are more effective against their enemies in fights, pranks, and video games. They can also declare a truce, if needed.

traits:trait_Toddler_Charmer.label: Charmer
traits:trait_Toddler_Charmer.description: These Toddlers love to socialize. They earn Communication skill faster, and don't suffer Stranger Danger from strangers. They can Share the Love with other Sims.

traits:trait_PracticeMakesPerfect.label: Practice Makes Perfect
traits:trait_PracticeMakesPerfect.description: These Sims learn skills faster, even if they are a little slower at first.

traits:trait_ColdHearted.label: Twisted Heart
traits:trait_ColdHearted.description: If you could see this Sim's heart, you might recoil in disgust. But {0.SimFirstName} would never let you see it, and that suits him just fine. {0.SimFirstName} gains bonus Social from Mean and Mischief socials, while shrugging off Sad and Embarrassed Moods much faster than other Sims.

traits:trait_Reward_Infant_TopNotch.label: Top Notch Infant
traits:trait_Reward_Infant_TopNotch.description: {0.SimFirstName} is Top-Notch! This infant has been loved and well cared for, which will help them maintain a positive outlook on life!

traits:trait_Fear_Death.label: Fear of Death
traits:trait_Fear_Death.description: {0.SimFirstName} will avoid participating in risky behaviors and will be too afraid to interact with the Grim Reaper.

traits:trait_Fear_Dark.label: Fear of the Dark
traits:trait_Fear_Dark.description: {0.SimFirstName} will be afraid during the nighttime and may struggle to stay asleep! Any little bump in the night will wake him up.

traits:trait_Infant_Calm.label: Calm
traits:trait_Infant_Calm.description: These Sims like to watch the world, are less likely to cry or become angry, and don't grow tired of activities as easily as other infants; however, they are less likely to explore the world on their own.

traits:trait_Fear_Cowplant.label: Fear of Cowplants
traits:trait_Fear_Cowplant.description: One bite from a Cowplant and it could all be over! {0.SimFirstName} would prefer to keep away from Cowplants for now. The potted plant in the corner looks like it's up to no good.

traits:trait_Fear_DeadEndJob.label: Fear of Dead-end Job
traits:trait_Fear_DeadEndJob.description: {0.SimFirstName} is questioning if there is a future with his career. {0.SimFirstName}'s job performance will suffer and he will return from work sad.

traits:trait_Fear_Failure.label: Fear of Failure
traits:trait_Fear_Failure.description: {0.SimFirstName} will start to question whether or not he is capable and have difficulty creating quality objects and struggle at work.

traits:trait_Fear_CrowdedPlaces.label: Fear of Crowded Places
traits:trait_Fear_CrowdedPlaces.description: There are too many Sims around right now! {0.SimFirstName} will be tense if around too many Sims on the same lot.

traits:challenge_Kindness_Ambassador.label: Kindness Ambassador
traits:challenge_Kindness_Ambassador.description: Kindness Ambassadors have stronger friendships and fewer negative Emotions.

traits:trait_Doctor_SicknessResistant.label: Sickness Resistance
traits:trait_Doctor_SicknessResistant.description: Resilient Immunity, Sims will have a lower chance of getting sick and will recover from sickness faster.

traits:trait_FakeGenius.label: Temporary Genius
traits:trait_FakeGenius.description: {0.SimFirstName} has become a Temporary Genius. These Sims are more Focused for mental pursuits, which they require to remain Happy... If only it was permanent.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Ran a Club as a Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim ran their own Club and made it the best they could! As an Adult, they'll be better at Mentoring other Sims by helping them gain Skills more quickly.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Born for Politics
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim showed a flair for politics and got really good at organizing, persuading, and dreaming of a better future. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Politician Career.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Thoughtful Child
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim took the time to invest in other Sims and really care for them. As an Adult, when they have relationships, they'll last longer—even without as much upkeep. That's the value of being thoughtful!

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Pet Friend
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time engaging with pets and learned early on how special animal friendships can be! As an Adult, they will build Friendship more quickly with animals and train pets more quickly.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Was a Best Friend
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim tried to be the Best Friend they could be to a group of Sims! As an Adult, they'll be more successful when using Friendly Socials on other Sims.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Aspiring Child Star
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim aspired to become famous and tried to make it happen! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Actor Career and gain an extra Fame Point. (Get Famous)

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Lil' Techie
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim loved robots and tried to learn everything they could about technology! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Tech Guru and Engineering Careers.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Childhood Environmentalist
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim really wanted to save the planet and took their first steps in doing so! As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Civil Designer Career, as well as in the Conservationist Career. (Island Living)

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Horse Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim really loved Horses. They even won a Horse Competition! A total Horse Kid. As an Adult, they'll build relationships with Horses more easily and their Horses will also advance in their Horse Skills more quickly.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Spy Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was always watching, listening, and secretly gathering clues. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Secret Agent Career.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Childhood Grief Survivor
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim experienced Grief after a Death and had to work their way through it. It was hard work, but they came out with a new perspective on life. As an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Undertaker Career, and they are more resistant to acquiring a Fear of Death.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Morbidly Curious as a Child
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was fascinated by death, cemeteries, and the macabre! A little creepy, but now as an Adult, they'll advance more quickly in the Reaper Career.

traits:wellness_SelfCareExpertise.label: Self-Care Expertise
traits:wellness_SelfCareExpertise.description: {0.SimFirstName} has developed an expertise for all things Wellness! Clients will now cough up way more money for his services!

traits:wellness_SpaMembership.label: Spa Membership
traits:wellness_SpaMembership.description: These Sims somehow came into possession of a Spa Membership. Nobody is really sure where it came from, how to cancel it, or who keeps paying for it each month. But one thing is for certain, all fees at Spas are waived! Nice!

traits:trait_HighMaintenance.label: High Maintenance
traits:trait_HighMaintenance.description: These Sims require extra work to keep in good condition. Their problems sometimes appear trivial, and may even appear out of the blue. These struggles can be remedied through mindful habits, which puts them in a state of catharsis.

traits:wellness_ClearPerspective.label: Clear Perspective
traits:wellness_ClearPerspective.description: {0.SimFirstName} has a clear head on his shoulders! {0.SimFirstName} is now able to have a brief respite from the harshness of reality and re-contextualize things. Like how it's all sort of meaningless... but in a good way!

traits:wellness_CalmingAura.label: Calming Aura
traits:wellness_CalmingAura.description: {0.SimFirstName}'s mastery over Wellness allows him to emanate a soothing glow! Use this newfound ability to calm Sims around him, and to look awesome.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Rebelled against Authority
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim bucked against authority and rules! As an Adult, they care a little less about what others think. They will be less Embarrassed when they become Embarrassed.

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Played Doctor as a Kid
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim spent a lot of time playing doctor and was interested in learning about health! As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Logic Skill, as well as in the Doctor career. (Get To Work)

traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.label: Naturally Disciplined
traits:trait_Reward_ChildhoodInspiration.description: As a Child, this Sim was all about structure, self-control, and discipline. As an Adult, they will advance more quickly in the Military Career.

aspirations:Star_Wars_Track_Prelude.description: On the world of Batuu there is a growing conflict. This Sim is out to explore Black Spire Outpost and understand whether they should stand with the Resistance or the First Order.

aspirations:Star_Wars_Track_Scoundrel.label: Galactic Privateer
aspirations:Star_Wars_Track_Scoundrel.description: This Sim isn't about choosing sides, they're happy just mingling among the smugglers, and bounty hunters on the fringe planet of Batuu. Earning a few extra credits along the way is just a bonus, no matter how they get them.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Miniature_Schauzer.label: Miniature Schnauzer
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Miniature_Schauzer.description: Usually easy to train, Miniature Schnauzers tend to be excellent watchdogs with a good territorial instinct, but more inclined toward barking than biting.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_American_Foxhound.label: Foxhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_American_Foxhound.description: A foxhound is a type of large hunting hound bred for strong hunting instincts, great energy, and, like all scent hounds, a keen sense of smell.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Basenji.label: Basenji
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Basenji.description: The Basenji is alert, energetic, curious and reserved with strangers. The Basenji tends to become emotionally attached to a single human. Basenjis may not get along with non-canine pets.

breeds:breed_Cat_Turkish_Angora.label: Turkish Angora
breeds:breed_Cat_Turkish_Angora.description: Turkish Angora cats are playful, intelligent, athletic and involved. They bond with humans, but often select a particular member of the family to be their constant companion. They are in turn, very protective of their person.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Chesapeake_Bay_Ret.label: Chesapeake Bay Retriever
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Chesapeake_Bay_Ret.description: The quintessential Chesapeake Bay Retriever has a bright and happy disposition, intelligence, quiet good sense, and an affectionate protective nature. Some can be quite vocal when happy, and some will 'smile' by baring their front teeth in a peculiar grin.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_French_Bulldog.label: French Bulldog
breeds:breed_SmallDog_French_Bulldog.description: The French Bulldog, like many other companion dog breeds, requires close contact with humans. They have fairly minimal exercise needs, but do require at least daily short walks. The French Bulldog is sometimes called "Frog dog" or a "Clown dog".

breeds:breed_LargeDog_GreatDane.label: Great Dane
breeds:breed_LargeDog_GreatDane.description: The Great Dane is a large German breed of domestic dog known for its giant size. The German name of the breed is Deutsche Dogge, or German Mastiff. The French name is Dogue Allemand. The Great Dane is one of the tallest dog breeds. Jill will change this.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Borzoi.label: Borzoi
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Borzoi.description: The borzoi is a quiet, but athletic and independent dog. Most borzois are almost silent, barking only very rarely. They do not have strong territorial drives and cannot be relied on to raise the alarm upon sighting a human intruder.

breeds:breed_Cat_Scottish_Fold.label: Scottish Fold
breeds:breed_Cat_Scottish_Fold.description: The Scottish Fold is a breed of domestic cat with a natural dominant-gene mutation that affects cartilage throughout the body, causing the ears to "fold", bending forward and down towards the front of their head, which gives the cat what is often described as an "owl-like" appearance.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_German_Pointer.label: German Pointer
breeds:breed_LargeDog_German_Pointer.description: The German Shorthaired Pointer was developed to be a dog suited for family life as well as a versatile hunter. Therefore their temperament is that of an intelligent, bold, boisterous, eccentric, and characteristically affectionate dog that is cooperative and easily trained.

breeds:breed_Cat_Savannah.label: Savannah
breeds:breed_Cat_Savannah.description: Some Savannahs are reported to be very social and friendly with new people and other cats and dogs, while others may run and hide or revert to hissing and growling when seeing a stranger. Exposure to other people and pets is most likely the key factor in sociability as Savannah kittens grow up.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Papillon.label: Papillon
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Papillon.description: The temperament of a papillon is a happy, friendly, adventurous dog. They are not shy or aggressive. Papillon's make excellent family dogs but should be watched around little children, as should any dog, due to a small child's lack of understanding of a dog's behavior and the likelihood that they will do something to upset the dog.

breeds:breed_Cat_Russian_Blue.label: Russian Blue
breeds:breed_Cat_Russian_Blue.description: The Russian Blue is a cat breed that comes in colors varying from a light shimmering silver to a darker, slate grey. They develop close bonds with their owners and are sought out as pets due to their personalities, beauty and coat.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_GoldenRetriever.label: Golden Retriever
breeds:breed_LargeDog_GoldenRetriever.description: The Golden Retriever is a large-sized breed of dog bred as gun dogs to retrieve shot waterfowl such as ducks and upland game birds during hunting and shooting parties, and were named 'retriever' because of their ability to retrieve shot game undamaged. Jill will change this and likely remove references to guns and things that they shoot.

breeds:breed_Cat_LaPerm.label: LaPerm
breeds:breed_Cat_LaPerm.description: The LaPerm is in many ways a cat of moderation with no extremes and is still true to its original type. It does however have an unusual coat.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Australian_Cattle_.label: Australian Cattle Dog
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Australian_Cattle_.description: Like many working dogs, the Australian Cattle Dog has high energy levels, an active mind, and a level of independence. The Australian Cattle Dog is a sturdy, muscular, compact dog that gives the impression of agility and strength.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Shih_Tzu.label: Shih Tzu
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Shih_Tzu.description: Although a Shih Tzu's temperament varies from dog to dog, the breed has a personality and temperament that is loyal, affectionate, outgoing, and alert. Training and proper socializing must start at a young age for the Shih Tzu to obey basic commands, for the Shih Tzu is prone to stubbornness when it comes to training.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Rhodesian_Ridgebac.label: Rhodesian Ridgeback
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Rhodesian_Ridgebac.description: Rhodesian ridgebacks are loyal, intelligent, and somewhat aloof to strangers. This breed requires positive, reward-based training, good socialization and consistency; it is often not the best choice for inexperienced dog owners.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Newfoundland.label: Newfoundland
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Newfoundland.description: The Newfoundlands have webbed feet and a water-resistant coat. Known for its calm and docile nature and its strength. They are highly loyal and make ideal working dogs. It is for this reason that this breed is known as "the gentle giant".

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Alaskan_Malamute.label: Alaskan Malamute
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Alaskan_Malamute.description: Alaskan Malamutes are still in use as sled dogs for personal travel, hauling freight, or helping move light objects; some, however, are used for the recreational pursuit of sledding, also known as mushing, as well as for skijoring, bikejoring, carting, and canicross.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_German_Shepherd.label: German Shepherd
breeds:breed_LargeDog_German_Shepherd.description: The German Shepherd (German: Deutscher Schäferhund, German pronunciation: [ˈʃɛːfɐˌhʊnt]) is a breed of medium to large-sized working dog that originated in Germany. The breed's officially recognized name is German Shepherd Dog in the English language, sometimes abbreviated as GSD and was also formerly known as the Alsatian in Britain. Jill will change this wikipedia sourced text.

breeds:breed_Cat_Kurilian_Bobtail.label: Kurilian Bobtail
breeds:breed_Cat_Kurilian_Bobtail.description: In the wild, this cat is an excellent fisher and hunter, which may explain why the Kurilian loves to play in water. The Kurilian's wild look is not reflected in the temperament of the breed. It is known for its clever and gentle nature.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Welsh_Springer_Spa.label: Welsh Springer Spaniel
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Welsh_Springer_Spa.description: The Welsh Springer Spaniel is active, loyal, and affectionate. They may meet strangers barking when in their territory, or act aloof, cautious or wary. The breed is well known for being friendly and demonstrative to all members of the family, especially children, and accepting other pets of the household with a friendly, playful attitude.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Shiba_Inu.label: Shiba Inu
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Shiba_Inu.description: The Shiba is a relatively fastidious breed and feels the need to maintain itself in a clean state. They can often be seen licking their paws and legs, much like a cat. They generally go out of their way to keep their coats clean.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Airedale_Terrier.label: Airedale Terrier
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Airedale_Terrier.description: The Airedale can be used as a working dog and also as a hunting dog. Airedales exhibit some herding characteristics as well, and have a propensity to chase animals. They have no problem working with cattle and livestock.

breeds:breed_Cat_Sphynx.label: Sphynx
breeds:breed_Cat_Sphynx.description: Sphynxes are known for their extroverted behavior. They display a high level of energy, intelligence, curiosity, and affection for their owners.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Red_And_Whit.label: Irish Red and White Setter
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Red_And_Whit.description: The Irish Red and White setter can be the most devoted and affectionate of dogs making them ideal all-round family dogs. They are extremely intelligent and respond well to proper training but they do need to have plenty to occupy them.

breeds:breed_Cat_Norwegian_Forest.label: Norwegian Forest
breeds:breed_Cat_Norwegian_Forest.description: Norwegian Forest cats have a quiet voice but can develop a loud voice if kept in a house with a dog. They are friendly, intelligent, and generally good with people. The Norwegian Forest cat has a lot of energy and can be very demanding of attention.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_English_Springer_S.label: English Springer Spaniel
breeds:breed_LargeDog_English_Springer_S.description: The typical Spaniel is friendly, eager to please, quick to learn and willing to obey. In the right circumstances they can be an affectionate and easy-going family dog.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Schipperke.label: Schipperke
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Schipperke.description: Known for a stubborn, mischievous, and headstrong temperament, it also chases small animals. The Schipperke is sometimes referred to as the "little black fox", the "Tasmanian black devil", or the "little black devil". They are naturally curious and high-energy dogs and require ample exercise and supervision.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Giant_Schnauzer.label: Giant Schnauzer
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Giant_Schnauzer.description: Giant Schnauzers are usually a quiet breed. Due to its breeding, the Giant Schnauzer is inherently suspicious of strangers and can be very territorial. Once introduced, it is usually accepting of novel people or situations.

breeds:breed_Cat_Siamese.label: Siamese
breeds:breed_Cat_Siamese.description: Siamese are usually very affectionate and intelligent cats, renowned for their social nature. Many enjoy being with people and are sometimes described as "extroverts". Often they bond strongly to a single person. Some Siamese are extremely vocal, with a loud, low-pitched voice—known as "Meezer", from which they get one of their nicknames.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Otterhound.label: Otterhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Otterhound.description: The Otterhound is a large, rough-coated hound with an imposing head. Originally bred for hunting, it has great strength and a strong body with long striding steps. This makes it able to perform prolonged hard work.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Jack_Russel_Terrie.label: Jack Russell Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Jack_Russel_Terrie.description: Jack Russells are first and foremost a working terrier. Originally bred to bolt fox from their dens during hunts, they are used on numerous ground-dwelling quarry such as groundhog, badger, and red and grey fox.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Miniature_Pinscher.label: Miniature Pinscher
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Miniature_Pinscher.description: Miniature Pinschers are for experienced dog owners. The Miniature Pinscher is an assertive, outgoing, active and independent breed. Miniature pinschers are energetic and need a fenced in yard to run in; they make great agility dogs.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Bichon_Frise.label: Bichon Frise
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Bichon_Frise.description: The Bichon Frise loves human company and demands much of your attention. They are generally very sociable and do well with an owner that takes them along on outings.

breeds:breed_Cat_Abyssinian.label: Abyssinian
breeds:breed_Cat_Abyssinian.description: The Abyssinian is a breed of domestic short-haired cat with a distinctive "ticked" tabby coat, in which individual hairs are banded with different colors.

breeds:breed_Cat_Devon_Rex.label: Devon Rex
breeds:breed_Cat_Devon_Rex.description: The Devon Rex is a breed of cat with a curly, very soft short coat similar to that of the Cornish Rex. They are often associated with being one of the most hypoallergenic cats available because of their type of coat. However, they are technically not hypoallergenic.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Doberman_Pinscher.label: Doberman Pinscher
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Doberman_Pinscher.description: Although they are considered to be working dogs, Doberman Pinschers are often stereotyped as being ferocious and aggressive. As a personal protection dog, the Doberman was originally bred for these traits.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Scottish_Terrier.label: Scottish Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Scottish_Terrier.description: Scotties are territorial, alert, quick moving and feisty, perhaps even more so than other terrier breeds. The breed is known to be independent and self-assured, playful, intelligent and has been nicknamed the 'Diehard' because of its rugged nature and endless determination.

breeds:breed_Cat_Mixed.label: Mixed Breed
breeds:breed_Cat_Mixed.description: A tame feline descended from multiple/unknown breeds, often propagating without any intervention, record-keeping or selective reproduction. Commonly known as Domestic or Tomcats.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Setter.label: Irish Setter
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Setter.description: Irish Setters get along well with children, other dogs, and will enthusiastically greet visitors. Even though they do well with household pets, small animals may pose a problem for this breed, as they are a hunting breed.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_English_Foxhound.label: English Foxhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_English_Foxhound.description: The English Foxhound is a pack hound, therefore, it gets along well with other dogs and enjoys human companionship. It gets along with horses, children, and other pets, as it is a gentle, social, and tolerant breed.

breeds:breed_Cat_Tuxedo.label: Tuxedo
breeds:breed_Cat_Tuxedo.description: A bicolor cat or piebald cat is a cat with white fur combined with fur of some other color, for example black or tabby.

breeds:breed_Cat_Colorpoint_Shorthair.label: Colorpoint Shorthair
breeds:breed_Cat_Colorpoint_Shorthair.description: The Colorpoint Shorthair is a highly intelligent, playful, and people-friendly breed. They are extremely affectionate and outgoing and enjoy lounging around and playing with people, causing them to also be described as "extroverts". They can also be very sensitive with nervous temperaments, which do not adapt well to changes of environment or to strangers.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Labrador_Retriever.label: Labrador Retriever
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Labrador_Retriever.description: Labradors have a reputation as a very even-tempered breed and an excellent family dog. This includes a good reputation with children of all ages and other animals.

breeds:breed_Cat_Birman.label: Birman
breeds:breed_Cat_Birman.description: The Birman, also called the "Sacred Cat of Burma",[1] is a domestic cat breed. The Birman is a long-haired, color-pointed cat distinguished by a silky coat, deep blue eyes, and contrasting white "gloves" or "socks" on each paw.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Collie.label: Collie
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Collie.description: The collie is a medium-sized, fairly lightly built dog, with a pointed snout. Many types have a distinctive white pattern over the shoulders. Collies are very active and agile, and most types of collies have a very strong herding instinct.

breeds:breed_Cat_Black_Cat.label: Black Cat
breeds:breed_Cat_Black_Cat.description: The folklore surrounding black cats varies from culture to culture. Some see them as a symbol of prosperity, while others see them as a symbol of luck; either good or bad.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Samoyed.label: Samoyed
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Samoyed.description: Samoyeds' friendly disposition makes them poor guard dogs; an aggressive Samoyed is rare. The breed is characterized by an alert and happy expression which has earned the nicknames "Sammie smile" and "smiley dog".

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Maltese.label: Maltese
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Maltese.description: The Havanese is a toy dog. It is smart and can be easily trained. It is best to train this dog at a young age, because some habits will stick as they become older.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Staffordshire_Bull.label: Staffordshire Bull Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Staffordshire_Bull.description: Although individual differences in personality exist, common traits exist throughout the Staffords. Due to its breeding, and history, the Staffordshire Bull Terrier is known for its character of fearlessness and loyalty. This, coupled with its affection for its friends, its off-duty quietness and trustworthy stability, make it a foremost all-purpose dog.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Husky.label: Husky
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Husky.description: Husky is a general name for a sled-type of dog used in northern regions, differentiated from other sled-dog types by their fast pulling style. They are an ever-changing cross-breed of the fastest dogs.

breeds:breed_Cat_German_Rex.label: German Rex
breeds:breed_Cat_German_Rex.description: The German Rex is a medium-sized breed with slender legs of a medium length.It is considered a very friendly cat and quickly bonds with its owner. It is lively, playful, and intelligent.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Field_Spaniel.label: Field Spaniel
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Field_Spaniel.description: The Field Spaniel can be a good family dog while it has a job to do. They are suitable for dog agility and hunting. Without some sort of purpose, the dog can often try to amuse itself and cause mischief.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Wirefox_Terrier.label: Wire Fox Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Wirefox_Terrier.description: Two of the wire fox terrier's most distinctive traits are its energy and intelligence. It has a low threshold for boredom and requires stimulation, exercise and attention. The wire fox terrier is a companion animal that requires near-constant attention.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Weimaraner.label: Weimaraner
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Weimaraner.description: The Weimaraner is a large dog that was originally bred for hunting in the early 19th century. Early Weimaraners were used by royalty for hunting large game such as boar, bear, and deer. Jill will change this.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Keeshond.label: Keeshond
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Keeshond.description: Keeshonden tend to be very playful, with quick reflexes and strong jumping ability. They are eager to please and very quick learners, which means they are also quick to learn things their humans did not intend to teach them.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_BorderCollie.label: Border Collie
breeds:breed_LargeDog_BorderCollie.description: Considered highly intelligent, extremely energetic, acrobatic and athletic, Border Collies frequently compete with great success in sheepdog trials and dog sports.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Curly_Coated_Retri.label: Curly Coated Retriever
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Curly_Coated_Retri.description: The Curly Coated Retriever was originally developed as a gun dog and their temperament and conformation reflect this purpose. Curlies are still used in many countries as bird hunting companions, including in both upland and waterfowl hunting.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Ibizan.label: Ibizan Hound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Ibizan.description: Ibizan Hounds are "escapologists": they are able to jump incredible heights from a standstill, so they need very tall fences. They also have been known to climb, and many can escape from crates, open baby gates and even locks.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Boston_Terrier.label: Boston Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Boston_Terrier.description: The Boston Terrier is a gentle breed that typically has a strong, happy-go-lucky, and friendly personality with a merry sense of humour. Bostons are generally eager to please their owner and can be easily trained.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Pointer.label: Pointer
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Pointer.description: Pointers are even-tempered, congenial dogs, and despite their large size, make good house pets so long as they get sufficient exercise due to their extremely high energy levels. Pointers are intelligent, affectionate, clean and intensely loyal.

breeds:breed_Cat_Maine_Coon.label: MaineCoon
breeds:breed_Cat_Maine_Coon.description: The Maine Coon is a large and sociable cat, hence its nickname, "the gentle giant." It is characterized by a prominent ruff along its chest, robust bone structure, rectangular body shape, a silky flowing coat, and a long, bushy tail.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Smooth_Fox_Terrier.label: Smooth Fox Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Smooth_Fox_Terrier.description: The Smooth Fox Terrier is a highly energetic dog, and thus not recommended for first time dog owners. As the breed was originally bred to go after small animals they also have a high prey instinct, they are very friendly dogs and don't mind strangers.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_English_Cocker_Spa.label: English Cocker Spaniel
breeds:breed_SmallDog_English_Cocker_Spa.description: Cockers are compassionate, determined, kind, intelligent, athletic, alert and resilient and make great family pets. The breed does not like being alone, and will bond strongly to an individual person in a family, usually the one who feeds it.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Akita.label: Akita
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Akita.description: The Akita is a powerful, independent and dominant breed, commonly aloof with strangers but affectionate with family members.

breeds:breed_Cat_Chartreux.label: Chartreux
breeds:breed_Cat_Chartreux.description: Chartreux cats are also known for their "smile": due to the structure of their heads and their tapered muzzles, they often appear to be smiling. Chartreux are exceptional hunters and are highly prized by farmers.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Schnauzer.label: Schnauzer
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Schnauzer.description: Schnauzer comes from the German word for "snout" and means colloquially "moustache", because of the dog's distinctively bearded snout. Although the schnauzer is considered a terrier-type dog, they do not have the typical terrier temperament.

breeds:breed_Cat_American_Bobtail.label: American Bobtail
breeds:breed_Cat_American_Bobtail.description: The American Bobtail is an uncommon breed of domestic cat which was developed in the late 1960s. It is most notable for its stubby "bobbed" tail about one-third to one-half the length of a normal cat's tail.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Cavalier_King_Char.label: King Charles Spaniel
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Cavalier_King_Char.description: The breed is highly affectionate, playful, extremely patient and eager to please. As such, dogs of the breed are good with children and other dogs. Cavaliers are not shy about socialising with much larger dogs.

breeds:breed_Cat_Shorthair_Tabby.label: Tabby
breeds:breed_Cat_Shorthair_Tabby.description: A tabby is any domestic cat that has a coat featuring distinctive stripes, dots, lines or swirling patterns, usually together with a mark resembling an 'M' on its forehead. Tabbies are sometimes erroneously assumed to be a cat breed. Jill will change this.

breeds:breed_Cat_Javanese.label: Javanese
breeds:breed_Cat_Javanese.description: Javanese are noted as an intelligent cat that tends to vocalize, though often for no apparent reason. They are notably fond of play, jumping and human contact and allegedly depressed if regularly not entertained by humans or other pets. They are reportedly good mouse hunters.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Toy_Fox_Terrier.label: Toy Fox Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Toy_Fox_Terrier.description: Toy Fox Terriers, like many active and intelligent breeds, can learn to respond to a number of words. Toy Fox Terriers were used commonly in circus shows by clowns, and they are said to make great companions for owners with a good sense of humor.

breeds:breed_Cat_Ragdoll.label: Ragdoll
breeds:breed_Cat_Ragdoll.description: The extreme docility of some individuals has led to the myth that Ragdolls are pain resistant. Some breeders in Britain have tried to breed away from the limpness owing to concerns that extreme docility "might not be in the best interests of the cat".

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Vizsla.label: Vizsla
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Vizsla.description: Vizslas are very high energy, gentle-mannered, loyal, caring, and highly affectionate. They quickly form close bonds with their owners, children and even strangers. Often they are referred to as "velcro" dogs because of their loyalty and affection.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Brittany.label: Brittany
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Brittany.description: The Brittany was originally bred as a hunting dog and noted for being easy to train and sweet-natured. The breed is generally more sensitive to correction than other hunters, and harsh corrections are often unnecessary.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Havanese.label: Havanese
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Havanese.description: The Havanese is a toy dog. It is smart and can be easily trained. It is best to train this dog at a young age, because some habits will stick as they become older.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Poodle.label: Poodle
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Poodle.description: The poodle is a group of formal dog breeds, the Standard Poodle, Miniature Poodle and Toy Poodle. The Fédération Cynologique Internationale (FCI) recognizes four sizes of one breed: standard, medium, miniature, and toy. Poodles exist in many coat colors. The origins of the poodles are still discussed. Jill will change this.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_American_Eskimo.label: American Eskimo
breeds:breed_LargeDog_American_Eskimo.description: The American Eskimo is an affectionate, loving dog. The breed is easy to train and they are excellent with children because of the dog's high intelligence and its willingness to please.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Mastiff.label: Mastiff
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Mastiff.description: Mastiff type means a large molosser dog. The term "mastiff type" has been used synonymously with the term "molosser". For example, the bulldog breeds, the Great Dane, the mountain dogs, the pit bulls and even smaller dogs such as the Boston terrier, may be considered "mastiff types" in this broad sense.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Italian_Greyhound.label: Italian Greyhound
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Italian_Greyhound.description: The Italian Greyhound makes a good companion dog and enjoys the company of people. However, the breed's slim build and short coat make them somewhat fragile, and injury can result from rough or careless play with children.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Yorkshire_Terrier.label: Yorkshire Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Yorkshire_Terrier.description: The ideal Yorkshire Terrier character or "personality" is described with a "carriage very upright" and "conveying an important air." Though small, the Yorkshire Terrier is active, very overprotective, curious, and fond of attention.

breeds:breed_Cat_Havana_Brown.label: Havana Brown
breeds:breed_Cat_Havana_Brown.description: The Havana Brown is an intelligent cat that often uses its paws both to examine objects and to communicate with its owners. Curiosity brings them to the door as visitors arrive rather than preferring to be hidden as many cats will do.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Puggle.label: Puggle
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Puggle.description: Puggles are great family dogs, they love to be around kids and are very friendly. They have characteristics of beagles, meaning they love to sniff for things and are excellent jumpers.

breeds:breed_Cat_Egyptian_Mau.label: Egyptian Mau
breeds:breed_Cat_Egyptian_Mau.description: Egyptian Maus are a small- to medium-sized short-haired cat breed. Along with the Bahraini Dilmun cat, they are one of the few naturally spotted breeds of domesticated cat. The spots of the Mau occur on only the tips of the hairs of its coat.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Portuguese_Water_D.label: Portuguese Water Dog
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Portuguese_Water_D.description: Portuguese Water dogs make excellent companions.They are loving, independent, and intelligent and are easily trained in obedience and agility skills. Once introduced, they are generally friendly to strangers, and enjoy being petted, which, due to their soft, fluffy coats, is a favour that human beings willingly grant them.

breeds:breed_Cat_Persian.label: Persian
breeds:breed_Cat_Persian.description: The Persian cat is a long-haired breed of cat characterized by its round face and short muzzle. In Britain, it is sometimes called the Longhair or Persian Longhair. It is also known as the Shirazi cat or Iranian cat, particularly in the Middle East. Jill will change this.

breeds:breed_Cat_Bengal.label: Bengal
breeds:breed_Cat_Bengal.description: The Bengal is a domestic cat breed developed to look like exotic jungle cats such as leopards, ocelots, margays and clouded leopards. Bengal cats were developed by the selective breeding of domestic cats and hybrids of the asian leopard cat.

breeds:breed_Cat_Himalayan.label: Himalayan
breeds:breed_Cat_Himalayan.description: These cats are sweet-tempered, intelligent, and generally very social and good companions. Because of their heritage from the Siamese cats, they tend to be more active than Persians.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Bloodhound.label: Bloodhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Bloodhound.description: This breed is gentle, and is tireless when following a scent. Because of its strong tracking instinct, it can be willful and somewhat difficult to obedience train and handle on a leash.

breeds:breed_Cat_British_Longhair.label: British Longhair
breeds:breed_Cat_British_Longhair.description: The British Longhair is a longer-haired development from the longstanding British Shorthair breed. In the mid-20th century, British Shorthairs were interbred with imported long-haired varieties with an aim to producing more stout and round-faced stock, while retaining the short coat

breeds:breed_Cat_Korat.label: Korat
breeds:breed_Cat_Korat.description: The Korat is a natural breed, and one of the oldest stable cat breeds. Known colloquially as the "good luck cat". Traditionally, they are given in pairs to newlyweds or people who are highly esteemed, for good luck. Until recently, Korats were not sold, but only given as gifts.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Chihuahua.label: Chihuahua
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Chihuahua.description: How a Chihuahua turns out depends mightily on the genetic temperament of his parents and grandparents. Chihuahuas can be easily provoked to attack, and are therefore generally unsuitable for homes with small children. The breed tends to be fiercely loyal to one particular person and in some cases may become over protective of the person, especially around other people or animals.

breeds:breed_Cat_Manx.label: Manx
breeds:breed_Cat_Manx.description: The Manx is considered a social and gregarious cat, and very attached to humans, but also shy of strangers. The breed is said to be highly intelligent, playful, and in its behaviour reminiscent of dogs.

breeds:breed_Cat_Oriental.label: Oriental Longhair
breeds:breed_Cat_Oriental.description: The oriental longhair is a really active cat that likes to play a lot. If the owner does not have the time to do so, it will find a toy to play on its own. This breed enjoys jumping and does it really well, without breaking any objects due to its agility and elegance.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Pharaoh_Hound.label: Pharaoh Hound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Pharaoh_Hound.description: Pharaoh Hounds have no link with Ancient Egypt. However, a popular myth holds that the breed is descended from the Tesem, one of the ancient Egyptian hunting dogs. Some believe that there are similarities between the breed and images of dogs found on the walls of ancient Egyptian tombs.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Bernese_Mountain_D.label: Bernese Mountain Dog
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Bernese_Mountain_D.description: Bernese are outdoor dogs at heart, though well-behaved in the house; they need activity and exercise, but do not have a great deal of endurance. They can move with amazing bursts of speed for their size when motivated.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Old_English_Sheepd.label: Old English Sheepdog
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Old_English_Sheepd.description: The breed standards describe the ideal Old English Sheepdog as never being nervous or aggressive. The Old English Sheepdog comes from the very old pastoral type dogs but no records were kept of the dogs, and everything about the earliest types is guesswork.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_AustralianShepherd.label: Australian Shepherd
breeds:breed_LargeDog_AustralianShepherd.description: The breed is typically highly energetic, requiring a great deal of exercise and attention. An Australian shepherd enjoys working, whether it is learning and practicing tricks, competing in dog agility, or engaging in any other physically and mentally involving activity.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Redbone_Coonhound.label: Redbone Coonhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Redbone_Coonhound.description: The Redbone Coonhound is affectionate, gentle, and should have a strong desire to please its owner.The breed is known for its distinctive "drawling" bark, also known as a bay. Hunters who use the breed follow the sound of the voice as the dogs track quarry.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Bull_Terrier.label: Bull Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Bull_Terrier.description: Bull Terriers can be both independent and stubborn and for this reason are not considered suitable for an inexperienced dog owner. A Bull terrier has an even temperament and is amenable to discipline.

breeds:breed_Cat_American_Wirehair.label: American Wirehair
breeds:breed_Cat_American_Wirehair.description: American Wirehairs are similar to American Shorthairs, with the exception of a springy, wiry coat, including ear fur, and whiskers. This coat is similar to the wire coats of some dog breeds, such as terriers. Their fur requires little grooming, although lighter cats may require sunblock.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_English_Setter.label: English Setter
breeds:breed_LargeDog_English_Setter.description: A gentle but at times strong-willed, mischievous gun dog, the English Setter was bred for a mix of endurance and athleticism, it is used to hunt for game such as quail, pheasant, and grouse.

breeds:breed_Cat_Oriental_Shorthair.label: Oriental Shorthair
breeds:breed_Cat_Oriental_Shorthair.description: Orientals are social, intelligent, and many are rather vocal. They often remain playful into adulthood, with many enjoying playing fetch. Despite their slender appearance, they are athletic and can leap into high places.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Pitbull.label: Pit Bull
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Pitbull.description: Pit bulls were created by breeding bulldogs and terriers together to produce a dog that combined the gameness and agility of the terrier with the strength of the bulldog.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Siberian_Husky.label: Siberian Husky
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Siberian_Husky.description: The original Siberian Huskies were bred by the Chukchi people — whose hunter-gatherer culture relied on their help. It is an active, energetic, resilient breed, whose ancestors lived in the extremely cold and harsh environment of the Siberian Arctic.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Dalmatian.label: Dalmatian
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Dalmatian.description: Dalmatian serves as a firehouse mascot and is sometimes used to educate the public in fire safety, but in the days of horse-drawn fire carts, they provided a valuable service, having a natural affinity to horses.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Golden_Doodle.label: Goldendoodle
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Golden_Doodle.description: A Goldendoodle is a cross-breed obtained by breeding a golden retriever with a poodle. The original purpose of the cross was to attempt to develop guide dogs suitable for visually impaired individuals with allergies.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Black_And_Tan_Coon.label: Black and Tan Coonhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Black_And_Tan_Coon.description: The Black and Tan Coonhound makes a suitable pet: it is mellow, amiable, calm, and unobtrusive indoors; outdoors, its strong hunting instinct takes over and it can be difficult to turn it from tracking after it starts trailing.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Polish_Lowland_She.label: Polish Lowland Sheepdog
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Polish_Lowland_She.description: Polish Lowland Sheepdogs are stable and self-confident. They have an excellent memory and can be well trained, but may dominate a weak-willed owner.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Greyhound.label: Greyhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Greyhound.description: The Greyhound is a breed of dog, a sighthound which has been bred for coursing game and Greyhound racing. Since the rise in large-scale adoption of retired racing Greyhounds, it has seen a resurgence in popularity as a family pet. Jill will change this wikipedia sourced text

breeds:breed_Cat_Siberian.label: Siberian
breeds:breed_Cat_Siberian.description: Known to be an exceptionally agile jumper, the Siberian is a strong and powerfully built cat, with strong hindquarters and large, well rounded paws and an equally impressive large full tail.

breeds:breed_Cat_Bombay.label: Bombay Cat
breeds:breed_Cat_Bombay.description: The Bombay cat breed is a type of short-haired cats developed by breeding sable Burmese and black American Shorthair cats, to produce a cat of mostly Burmese type, but with a sleek, panther-like black coat.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Bulldog.label: Bulldog
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Bulldog.description: The Bulldog is a breed with characteristically wide head and shoulders along with a pronounced mandibular prognathism. There are generally thick folds of skin on a Bulldog's brow; round, black, wide-set eyes; a short muzzle with characteristic folds called a rope or nose roll above the nose; hanging skin under the neck; drooping lips and pointed teeth, and an underbite with an upturned jaw.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Whippet.label: Whippet
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Whippet.description: Whippets are quiet and not prone to barking, but require regular exercise. They are generally gentle dogs and may be content to spend much of the day resting.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Standard_Schnauzer.label: Standard Schnauzer
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Standard_Schnauzer.description: Distinguished by their long beards and eyebrows, Standard Schnauzers are always pepper and salt or less commonly black in color, with a stiff and wiry hair coat on the body similar to that of other wirehaired breeds.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Rottweiler.label: Rottweiler
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Rottweiler.description: Rottweilers are a powerful breed with well-developed genetic herding and guarding instincts. Potentially dangerous behaviour in Rottweilers usually results from irresponsible ownership, abuse, neglect, or lack of socialisation and training.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Afghan_Hound.label: Afghan Hound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Afghan_Hound.description: The temperament of the typical Afghan Hound can be aloof and dignified, but happy and clownish when it's playing. This breed, as is the case with many sighthounds, has a high prey drive and may not get along with small animals.

breeds:breed_Cat_Somali.label: Somali
breeds:breed_Cat_Somali.description: The Somalis are recognized for their bushy tails, large almond eyes, and large pointed ears, earning the breed its nickname of "Fox Cat." Their ticked coats, containing between four and twenty colors on each hair, are very fine in texture, making their coats softer to the touch.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Terrier.label: Irish Terrier
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Terrier.description: Irish Terriers are active dogs and need and enjoy consistent mental and physical challenges. Full of life, but not hyperactive; it should be able to relax inside the house and be roused to full activity level quickly.

breeds:breed_Cat_Japanese_Bobtail.label: Japanese Bobtail
breeds:breed_Cat_Japanese_Bobtail.description: The Japanese Bobtail is a breed of domestic cat with an unusual "bobbed" tail more closely resembling the tail of a rabbit than that of other cats.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Cocker_Spaniel.label: Cocker Spaniel
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Cocker_Spaniel.description: Cocker Spaniels were originally bred as hunting dogs with the term cocker deriving from their use to hunt the Eurasian woodcock.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Pug.label: Pug
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Pug.description: The breed is often described by the Latin phrase multum in parvo, or "much in little" or "a lot of dog in a small space", alluding to the Pug's remarkable and charming personality, despite its small size.

breeds:breed_Cat_Calico.label: Calico
breeds:breed_Cat_Calico.description: Calico cats are domestic cats with a spotted or particolored coat that is predominantly white, with patches of two other colors.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Wolfhound.label: Irish Wolfhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Irish_Wolfhound.description: Irish wolfhounds have a varied range of personalities and are most often noted for their personal quirks and individualism. An Irish wolfhound, however, is rarely mindless, and despite its large size is rarely found to be destructive in the house or boisterous.

breeds:breed_Cat_Burmese.label: Burmese
breeds:breed_Cat_Burmese.description: Originally, all Burmese cats were dark brown (sable), but are now available in a wide variety of colours; formal recognition of these also varies by standard. Both versions of the breed are known for their uniquely social and playful temperament and persistent vocalisation.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Chow_Chow.label: Chow Chow
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Chow_Chow.description: Chow Chows tend to display discernment of strangers and can become fiercely protective of their owners and property. For these reasons, some owners have attributed a cat-like personality to the Chow Chow.

breeds:breed_Cat_Tonkinese.label: Tonkinese
breeds:breed_Cat_Tonkinese.description: Tonkinese are intelligent, active, vocal and generally people-oriented cats, playful and interested in everything going on around them; however, this also means they are easily susceptible to becoming lonesome or bored.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Boxer.label: Boxer
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Boxer.description: Boxers were originally bred to be medium-size guard dogs. Today, although they are a part of the AKC’s Working Group, they mostly find homes as loving family companions. Jill will change this later.

breeds:breed_Cat_Balinese.label: Balinese
breeds:breed_Cat_Balinese.description: The Balinese is a long-haired breed of domestic cat with Siamese-style point coloration and sapphire-blue eyes. The Balinese is also known as the purebred long-haired Siamese, since it originated as a natural mutation of that breed, and hence is essentially the same cat with a medium-length silky coat and a distinctively plumed tail.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Saint_Bernard.label: Saint Bernard
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Saint_Bernard.description: The St. Bernard or St Bernard is a breed of very large working dog from the western Alps in Switzerland, Italy and France, originally bred at the Great and Little St Bernard Pass for rescue. Jill will change this.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Bluetick_Coonhound.label: Bluetick Coonhound
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Bluetick_Coonhound.description: Bluetick Coonhounds are bred to be hunting dogs. They are athletic, hardy, and need a full-time job or activity such as hunting, obedience, or agility to stay happy. They can be challenging to train and they should be monitored around cats or other small animals.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Pekingese.label: Pekingese
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Pekingese.description: The Pekingese breed is over 2000 years old and has hardly changed in all that time. The Pekingese's flat face and large eyes are some of the breeds most obvious characteristics. The body is compact and low to the ground.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_West_Highland_Whit.label: West Highland White Terrier
breeds:breed_SmallDog_West_Highland_Whit.description: The temperament of the West Highland White Terrier can vary greatly, with some being friendly towards children, whilst others prefer solitude. It will not tolerate rough handling such as a child pulling on its ears, and can be both food- and toy-possessive.

breeds:breed_Cat_Singapura.label: Singapura
breeds:breed_Cat_Singapura.description: The Singapura is one of the smallest breeds of cats, noted for its large eyes and ears, brown ticked coat and blunt tail.

breeds:breed_Cat_Ocicat.label: Ocicat
breeds:breed_Cat_Ocicat.description: Ocicats are friendly and sociable and are not often shy around strangers. This makes them good family pets, and most can also get along well with animals of other species. Their temperament is similar to that of a dog and are often referred to as a "dog in a cat's body".

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Mixed.label: Mixed Breed
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Mixed.description: A domesticated canine descended from multiple breeds, often propagating without any intervention, record-keeping or selective reproduction. Commonly known as Mutts.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Shetland_Sheepdog.label: Shetland Sheepdog
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Shetland_Sheepdog.description: The general appearance of the Sheltie is that of a miniature Rough Collie. They are a small, double coated, working dog, agile and sturdy.

breeds:breed_Cat_British_Shorthair.label: British Shorthair
breeds:breed_Cat_British_Shorthair.description: The British Shorthair is the pedigreed version of the traditional British domestic cat, with a distinctively chunky body, dense coat and broad face. Jill will change this wikipedia sourced text.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Pomeranian.label: Pomeranian
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Pomeranian.description: Pomeranians are typically friendly, playful and lively but can be aggressive to other dogs and try to prove themselves. Pomeranians are alert and aware of changes in their environment, and barking at new stimuli can develop into a habit of barking excessively in any situation.

breeds:breed_SmallDog_Lhasa_Apso.label: Lhasa Apso
breeds:breed_SmallDog_Lhasa_Apso.description: Having been bred as an indoor monastery sentinel dog by Tibetan Buddhist monks, Lhasa Apsos are alert with a keen sense of hearing. The ideal Lhasa temperament is to be wary of strangers while being loyal to those closest to them.

breeds:breed_LargeDog_Mixed.label: Mixed Breed
breeds:breed_LargeDog_Mixed.description: A domesticated canine descended from multiple breeds, often propagating without any intervention, record-keeping or selective reproduction. Commonly known as Mutts.
