skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Progra.label: Programming
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Progra.description:
Almost like speaking a second language in today's world, programming is becoming more and more essential. Get ahead by learning to make machines do your bidding!

Programming is done on the computer. Increasing this skill will allow Sims to create Plugins, Games, Mods, and Mobile Phone Apps. Sims will also be able to Hack on the Computer!

Programming can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Computer.

skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Mental.label: Mental
skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Mental.description:
The minds of children may be physically smaller, but they are also less cluttered with junk, like fun facts about llamas or algebra. Kids that can hone their mental muscle early may find themselves more easily able to grasp more complex logic later in life.

Mental Skill is built on the science table and chessboard. Increasing this skill will unlock new Science Table Potions, Computer Interactions, and Socials!

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Rocket.label: Rocket Science
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Rocket.description:
There are those who'd rather keep their feet on the ground, their eyes looking down. Not you! Throw off the shackles of what-is and take on the challenge of what-can-be. Build, upgrade, and fly where no Sim has gone before with the Rocket Science Skill.

The Rocket Science Skill is built using the rocket ship. Increasing this skill will increase build speed and unlock new Upgrades on the Rocket Ship.

Rocket Science can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Rocketship.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Piano.label: Piano
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Piano.description:
When ivories need tickling and aural senses need soothing, a pianist is the only Sim that can help. Practice, practice, practice that Piano Skill and while you may never be a rock star, you'll be played in elevators forever.

Piano Skill is improved on the Piano, and can be mentored from said object at Skill level 5.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Handin.label: Handiness
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Handin.description:
Do it yourself! That's the motto of a handy Sim. Handy Sims aren't afraid to repair things when they break, can upgrade regular household objects, and may even dabble with a bit of woodworking.

Handiness is built by repairing and upgrading objects, or using the woodworking table. Increasing this skill unlocks new craftables on the Woodworking Table and improves Sims' ability to Repair and Upgrade objects.

Handiness can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Woodworking Table or when Sims are upgrading or repairing various objects.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_VideoG.label: Video Gaming
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_VideoG.description:
Being good at video games used to only be good for bragging rights against your siblings, but in this brave new world, video game prowess can actually make money and bring fame! What wacky times we live in.

Video Gaming Skill is improved via the computer, motion game system, and tablet. Increasing this skill will unlock new Video Gaming Socials as well as new Interactions on the Computer.

Video Gaming can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Computer, Gaming Mat, Arcade Machine (Get Together), or Video Game Console (City Living).

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Comedy.label: Comedy
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Comedy.description:
As soon as one realizes that everything is a joke, being a comedian is the only thing that makes sense.

Comedy skill is useful when talking with other Sims and with the microphone stand. Increasing this skill will unlock new Joke Socials, Comedy Routines, and the ability to Improvise Routines on a Microphone.

Comedy can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Microphone.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Barten.label: Mixology
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Barten.description:
Mixing drinks and making small talk seems easy enough, but the right proportions of juices and the right amount of chatter is a subtle skill.

Mixologists primarily use the Bar. Increasing this skill will unlock the ability to make new Drinks, Bar Tricks, and Mixology Socials!

Mixology can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Bar.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Charis.label: Charisma
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Charis.description:
When in a conversation, Charisma skill can be your best friend. Whether making friends, romancing, or calming down strangers, the charismatic Sim knows how to proceed.

Charisma can be worked on in the mirror or in conversations with other Sims. Increasing this skill will unlock new Socials as well as new Social Media Interactions on the Computer.

Charisma can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Mirror or Podium (City Living).

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Fishin.label: Fishing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Fishin.description:
Most Sims with this skill aren't shy to admit that they're hooked on fishing. Others who say otherwise are just koi.

The fishing skill is improved via fishing, more fishing, and reading about fishing. Increasing this skill will unlock Fishing with Bait and increases the likelihood of catching bigger and better fish.

Fishing can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Fishing Sign.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Garden.label: Gardening
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Garden.description:
How does your garden grow? It can bloom with flowers and fruits galore, but such an endeavor takes time and effort, and more than a bit of Gardening Skill.

Gardening Skill is built by working with plants, seeds, and planters. Increasing this skill will allow Sims to be more efficient when Gardening as well as unlock new Gardening Interactions and Socials.

Gardening can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Gardening Plant.

skills:skill_Fitness.label: Fitness
skills:skill_Fitness.description:
While all Sims want to stay healthy, fitness-minded Sims frequently go above and beyond the call of duty to keep their bodies in tip-top shape.

Fitness can be worked on via the Treadmill, Workout Machine, or Punching bag. Increasing this Skill will unlock new Workout Interactions and Socials.

Fitness can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Treadmill, Workout Machine, or Punching Bag.

skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Social.label: Social
skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Social.description:
Learning to talk is the first step in every child's journey to becoming a social creature. For those children who decide to focus on Social Skill, friendships are sure to come easier to them throughout life.

Social Skill can be developed on the dollhouse and stuffed animal. Increasing this skill will unlock Sim.tv on the Computer, Doll Interactions, and Socials!

skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Motor.label: Motor
skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Motor.description:
Motor Skill is essential for all children, but beyond simply enabling them to walk, run, and jump, Motor Skill can be focused on to build early muscles and prepare for a lifetime of fitness.

 Motor Skill can be built on monkey bars and jungle gyms.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Gourme.label: Gourmet Cooking
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Gourme.description:
Ready to take your culinary creations to new heights? The Gourmet Cooking skill can help deliver some fancy foods to your mouth and your guests.

Gourmet Cooking is developed through cooking gourmet foods on the fridge, stove, and countertop. Increasing this skill will unlock new Gourmet Cooking Tricks, Moodlets, and Recipes.

Gourmet Cooking can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Fridge, Stove, or Oven.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Violin.label: Violin
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Violin.description:
Whether a haunting dirge or a lively dance, the violin can evoke a myriad of emotions. Work up from unpleasant screeching to dulcet chords with the Violin Skill.

Violin Skill is improved via the Violin. Increasing this skill will unlock new Songs and Interactions on the Violin, including the ability to Write Songs and Serenade Sims.

Violin can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Violin.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Mischi.label: Mischief
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Mischi.description:
Mischief-oriented Sims tend to be sly devils, delighting at tricking, pranking, and otherwise mocking their fellow Sims. Life's a party, and a Mischief Sim is out to crash it.

Mischief is mainly tied to social interactions and the voodoo doll. Increasing this skill will unlock new Mischievous Socials on Sims as well as Mischievous Interactions on the Voodoo Doll, Computer, Tablet, and Phone.

Mischief can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Computer or Tablet.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Homest.label: Cooking
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Homest.description:
Anyone can cook, but Sims who are epicurious will benefit from spending a little extra time and attention in the kitchen.

Cooking skill is built primarily by cooking with the fridge, stove, and counter. Increasing this skill will unlock new Cooking Tricks, Moodlets, and Recipes.

Homestyle Cooking can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Fridge, Stove, or Oven.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Painti.label: Painting
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Painti.description:
The art of putting brush to canvas and creating something that can evoke an emotional response is not easy. For those Sims that explore the Painting Skill, colorful creations—and maybe some big sales—lie in their future.

Painting is primarily tied to the Easel and Digital Sketchpad. Increasing this skill will unlock new Painting Genres and Sizes!

Painting can be mentored at Skill level 5 from an Easel, Digital Sketchpad, or Mural (City Living).

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Logic.label: Logic
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Logic.description:
A practiced mind can be a wonderful thing, and Sims who focus on Logic want to hone their minds until they're sharper than a llamacorn's horn.

Logic is built on the Chess Table, Telescope, Microscope, and Science Table (Children only). Increasing this skill will unlock new Interactions on the Microscope, Observatory, and various Collectibles.

Logic can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Chess Table, Small Telescope, Microscope, or Science Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Creativity.label: Creativity
skills:statistic_Skill_Child_Creativity.description:
Using imagination is one of the hallmarks of childhood, and developing that imagination can pay big dividends in the future.

The Creativity skill can be developed on the activity table as a child sim and an easel as an adult. Increasing this skill will unlock new Activity Table Drawings, Dollhouse Interactions, and Socials!

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Writin.label: Writing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Writin.description:
Putting pen to paper (or more likely, fingers to keys) is no easy task. The blank page can be one of the most daunting foes, but writers take on the challenge of finding a way to put emotions into words day after day.

Writing is primarily done on the computer. Increasing this skill will unlock new Writing Interactions on the Computer as well as the ability to Publish and Self-Publish books!

Writing can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Computer.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Guitar.label: Guitar
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Guitar.description:
Guitar: the one instrument that defies class, genre, and boundaries. A guitar can be a good fit for a romantic evening, a casual get-together, or a sold-out performance.

Use the guitar to improve Guitar Skill. Increasing this skill will unlock new Songs and Interactions on the Guitar, including the ability to Write Songs and Serenade Sims.

Guitar can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Guitar.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Dancin.label: Dancing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Dancin.description:
Sims with this skill can never resist the urge to bust a move. They love to move and are always ready to hit the dance floor.

Dancing can be improved by shaking it on the dance floor, moving along to the music of a DJ booth or stereo, and even by practicing in a mirror. Improving the Dancing Skill unlocks new dance moves for your Sim to use.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_DJMixi.label: DJ Mixing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_DJMixi.description:
Anyone can scratch a record, but only Sims with the DJ Skill are always ready to drop a beat. They can play on the DJ Booth, create mixtapes, and entertain a crowd.

DJ Skill is gained by practicing on a DJ Booth or by playing for a crowd. Increasing this skill unlocks new genres and interactions on the DJ Booth.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Singin.label: Singing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Singin.description:
While any Sim can sing, can they sing well? Sims with Singing skill love to belt it, no matter where they are at.

Sims love to sing using the Karaoke Machine, but they can also sing using instruments or the Microphone. Skilled singers will unlock more songs, have the ability to Sing in Shower, and Serenade other Sims. Highly skilled singers can write lyrics on instruments and even license lyrics to earn a few more Simoleons!

Singing can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Microphone.

skills:statistic_Skill_DogTraining.label: Pet Training
skills:statistic_Skill_DogTraining.description: Dogs being able to perform tricks is a basic expectation. Once trained, the dog can perform the trick on command.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Veteri.label: Veterinarian
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Veteri.description:
It takes a steady hand, compassionate heart, and good knowledge of animal medical anatomy to be a great veterinarian.

Examine and Treat pets at your Vet Clinic to increase this skill!

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Flower.label: Flower Arranging
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Flower.description:
Arranging flowers in intricate ways takes some mad floral skills. Develop these skills to not only create beautiful organic creations, but also create feelings in Sims they might not even understand themselves.

Flower Arranging Skill is built by using Violets are Blue Flower Arranging Table. Increasing this skill will allow Sims to create different types of arrangements with different flowers. High-skilled Sims will also be able to Scent arrangements with flowers, allowing Sims to have an emotional response to the arrangements.

Flower Arranging can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Flower Arranging Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Acting.label: Acting
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Acting.description:
The ability to bring a character to life, to tell a story, and to move Sims to tears is a genuine art. To these artists, life is the canvas.

Acting skill is built by practicing in a mirror or in front of a microphone. As this skill increases, Sims will be able to perform scenes in public, and for tips to make extra Simoleons.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_MediaP.label: Media Production
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_MediaP.description:
A Sim with Media Production Skill is well-versed in current technology, as it applies to producing music and videos. These Sims stream and upload content to share to the world or make some Simoleons on the side.

Media Production Skill can be built using the Mix Master Music Production Station, The More Views Video Station, or either Streaming Drone.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Resear.label: Research & Debate
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Resear.description:
Research & Debate is all about learning information and then utilizing it—whether that be in a debate or through social influence.

This skill can be improved and used with the Research Archive Machine to Research varying topics, and the Mirror or Podium Set to Practice Debating.

Research & Debate can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Mirror or Podium Set.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Roboti.label: Robotics
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Roboti.description:
Technology should help make a Sims life better. By creating robots to do chores, protect, and entertain the masses Sims are freed up to do... other Sims specific things!

Robotics Skill is built by Tinkering at the Robotics Workstation and repairing Utili-Bots and Servos. Increasing this skill unlocks new craftables on the Robotics Workstation.

Robotics can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Robotics Workstation.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_JuiceF.label: Juice Fizzing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_JuiceF.description: Sims with this skill have a natural curiosity for the art of the fizz. Whether it's a hobby or a side hustle, experimentation is key. These Sims can be found trying different ingredients and processes to hone their craft.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Fabric.label: Fabrication
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Fabric.description:
Why buy brand name when you can make it yourself? Recycle old stuff that would be thrown out otherwise and use the Bits and Pieces to make something all your own!

Fabrication Skill is built by using the Fabricator and by creating candles at the Candle Making Table. Increasing this skill unlocks new recipes to explore!

Fabrication can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Farbricator or Candle Making Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Snowbo.label: Snowboarding
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Snowbo.description:
Feel like getting tricky? {0.SimFirstName} can level up his Snowboarding Skill for a rush like no other!

Snowboarding is built by practicing runs on the slopes or reading about Snowboarding. Leveling up grants access to harder slopes, more tricks, or becoming Snow Bros with other skilled Sims.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Skiing.label: Skiing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Skiing.description:
Sims with the Skiing Skill live for the feeling of the crisp wind in their face and gliding smoothly down the slopes.

Skiing Skill is built by practicing runs on the slope or can be done at home on the computer by "Researching the Art of Skiing". Leveling up in Skill unlocks new slope Interactions, Tricks, Outfits, Skis, Solo Interactions, and Socials.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_RockCl.label: Rock Climbing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_RockCl.description: Adventurous Sims love the challenge of scaling mountain cliffs, and getting better at this physical skill will unlock new ways to climb as well as allow access to new areas and vistas. Rock Climbing Skill is built up by tackling Climbing Routes as well as researching climbing techniques with Skill Books and the Computer.

skills:statistic_Skill_CrossStitch.label: Cross-stitch
skills:statistic_Skill_CrossStitch.description:
Nothing says love and patience like a carefully stitched piece of art! Cross-stitch pieces are perfect for decorations, selling, or as a gift for the little critter hanging around your garden. Choose from three different size hoops and get stitching!  Just beware of resting stitch face!

Your Sim can learn new patterns with each level up but maybe talking to a few folks in town will give his some inspiration. Some of the small critters might even give his something new to stitch, but only if you give them something nice in return!

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Entrep.label: Entrepreneur
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Entrep.description: Want to take your idea on a journey from spark to small business to a business empire? Build your Entrepreneur skill by progressing your Side Hustles and excelling in Odd Jobs and Freelance Careers!

skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Temperament.label: Temperament
skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Temperament.description:
Horses with high Temperament Skill buck less often when being ridden and get along more easily with Sims and other Horses. They also perform better at certain Community Jobs and the Western Pleasure, Show Jumping, and Ultimate Horse Championship competitions.

A Horse's Temperament Skill is built when a Sim cares for and socializes with that Horse. Skill can also be acquired by sending a Horse for training using the Community Board.

skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Endurance.label: Endurance
skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Endurance.description:
Endurance is all about how resilient a Horse is! A horse with high Skill in Endurance will become Fatigued less often, do better at certain Community Jobs and the Endurance Race, Show Jumping, and Ultimate Horse Championship competitions.

Endurance Skill is built by going for rides. Skill can also be acquired by sending a Horse for training using the Community Board.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Equest.label: Horse Riding
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Equest.description:
Horse Riding can be a recreational activity, a mode of travel, or a means for winning Competitions. The Skill reflects the riding Sim's capabilities rather than the Horse's abilities.

The best way to learn this Skill is to mount up and get riding! All of a Sim's time spent riding improves their Horse Riding Skill, whether out for a leisurely ride or training the Horse's Agility, Jumping, or Endurance Skills.

skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Jumping.label: Jumping
skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Jumping.description:
Horses with high Jumping Skill love to reach for new heights! They are better at using Horse Jumps, completing certain Community Jobs, and performing in the Show Jumping, Endurance Racing, and Ultimate Horse Championship competitions.

A Horse's Jumping Skill is built by training with a Horse Jump but it can also be gained by sending a Horse for training using the Community Board.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_RanchN.label: Nectar Making
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_RanchN.description:
Nectar Making combines the subtle art of extracting essential flavors from a wide variety of ingredients with the not-so-subtle art of smashing those ingredients to a pulp.

Nectar Making can be improved by crafting bottles at the Nectar Maker. Improving the Nectar Making Skill increases how quickly Sims can craft Nectar, and unlocks access to new recipes.

skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Agility.label: Agility
skills:statistic_Skill_Horse_Agility.description:
Agility affects how quickly and easily a Horse can move! Horses with high Agility are better at using Horse Barrels, completing certain Community Jobs, and performing in the Barrel Racing, Western Pleasure, and Ultimate Horse Championship competitions.

A Horse's Agility Skill is built by training with Horse Barrels. Skill can also be acquired by sending a Horse for training using the Community Board.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Romanc.label: Romance
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Romanc.description:
Anyone can be romantic, but soon these Sims will exude romance. Romance Sims will find that they succeed more often in matters of the heart.

Romance Skill can be improved through most romantic or flirty interactions, including new ones that they gain with this skill.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Thanat.label: Thanatology
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Thanat.description:
Dip your toe into the Baleful Bog of knowledge by studying death and loss. Sims enticed by this grim calling will eventually be able to partake in the vocalization of a dying tongue or the creation of a soulful treat meant to boost a Sim's motivations. It's really a skill to die for!

The Thanatology Skill is increased by Reading Skill books, Reading Theories on a Computer, or Progressing in the Deathly Career.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Potter.label: Pottery
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Potter.description:
From blobs of clay to beautiful masterpieces! Those with the Pottery skill make their own ceramic creations that can enhance a home or be sold to eager customers! 

Pottery skill can be gained from molding a Lump of Clay, making ceramics at the Pottery Wheel or glazing them at the Pottery Kiln. Increasing this skill will unlock new ceramic designs the Sim can explore!

Pottery can be mentored at Skill level 5 from the Pottery Wheel or Pottery Kiln.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Tattoo.label: Tattooing
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Tattoo.description:
The art of Tattooing allows Sims to adorn the bodies of others with beautiful ink, while making a pretty Simoleon along the way. Tattoos can even be a permanent dedication to a loved one (at least until they pay for Tattoo Removal).

Tattooing can be learned by using a Tattoo Table or a Digital Sketchpad. Increasing this skill unlocks new Tattoo Designs, higher Tattooing service profits, and additional Tattooing interactions.

Tattooing can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Tattoo Table or Digital Sketchpad.

skills:statistic_Skill_NLS.label: Natural Living
skills:statistic_Skill_NLS.description:
Embrace the bohemian life with this Skill that erases the boundary between "in here" and "out there." Sims can start by sleeping outdoors, doing basic Foraging, and bathing in rivers, lakes, oceans, and even ponds. With practice, Sims unlock ways to solve any and all their Needs naturally. High-skilled Sims may choose to live without a bed, kitchen, bathroom, or even any house at all. Natural Living is more than just surviving, it's thriving—whether travelling out in the world or bedding down on the grass in your own beautiful garden!

Natural Living is improved best by first hand practice outdoors but can also be studied at the Computer or by reading a Natural Living Skill Book.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Apothe.label: Apothecary
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Apothe.description:
Turn commonplace harvestables into fantastic Apothecary Elixirs that cure a variety of Ailments and enhance life.

The Apothecary Skill can be improved by crafting at the Apothecary Table, Researching at the Computer, or Reading Skill Books. Increasing this skill unlocks new craftables on the Apothecary Table, as well as new social interactions.

Apothecary can be mentored at Skill level 5 from the Apothecary Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_All_Ages_Minor_En.label: Entomology
skills:statistic_Skill_All_Ages_Minor_En.description: Master the Entomology Skill by learning how to catch and examine butterflies and moths in their natural habitats. Gain hands-on experience in nurturing these insects through incubation, observing their fascinating life cycles. Progressing in this Skill will unlock advanced techniques to raise new generations of butterflies and moths, enhancing your expertise in their care and conservation.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Swords.label: Swordsmanship
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Swords.description:
A skill perfect for Sims that want to challenge others to Duels and earn rewards through their prowess with a sword!

Swordsmanship can be improved via Training at the Practice Dummy, Duels with other Sims, or by participating in Swordsmanship Tournaments from the Gazebos in Ondarion. Increasing this Skill will unlock new Duel interactions, Swords at the Blacksmith in the workshop in Ondarion and unlock different Swordsmanship Tournament levels.

Swordsmanship can be mentored at the Practice Dummy.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Herbal.label: Herbalism
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Herbal.description:
How can a nature lover best take advantage of the gifts of the forest? Rare and wondrous Herbs aren't just leafy greens, but precious ingredients!
The Herbalism skill is built by Identifying Herbs after collecting them and Brewing Remedies on the Grill or Stove.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Wellne.label: Wellness
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Wellne.description:
A Sim that acquires wellness is a Sim that can regulate their moods and sensations as they sway through the gales of life's enduring dilemmas.

Wellness is primarily increased through Meditation, Yoga, and Massages. Increasing this skill will unlock new Yoga poses, massage types, and some transcendent meditation techniques!

skills:statistic_Skill_Hidden_VampireLor.label: Vampire Lore
skills:statistic_Skill_Hidden_VampireLor.description:
Sims with a thirst for knowledge will sink their teeth into these books. Sims would be batty to pass up on the helpful tips contained within. 

Vampire Lore skill is improved by researching into Vampires on the computer or reading unlocked Vampire Tomes.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_PipeOr.label: Pipe Organ
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_PipeOr.description:
The Pipe Organ is the instrument for the pianist who wants to crank it up to 11. Notable as the largest instrument in the world. This is sure to make a impression at your next jam session. 

Use the Pipe Organ to improve Pipe Organ Skill. Increasing this skill will unlock new Songs and Interactions on the Pipe Organ, including the ability to Write Songs. The Skill can be mentored from a Pipe Organ at Skill Level 5.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Parent.label: Parenting
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Parent.description:
A skilled parent knows when to influence, when to encourage, and when to discipline children. They know the best way to clean a kid up and how to solve their needs. 

Parenting skill is built by caring for children, talking to other parents, and researching on the computer. Increasing this skill will unlock new ways to parent children and solve their motives.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_LocalC.label: Selvadoradian Culture
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_LocalC.description:
Sims who are passionate about the Selvadoradian culture immerse themselves in it. They are less likely to make awkward comments and are more likely to nail those tricky dance moves.

Selvadoradian Culture Skill is built by socializing with the locals in Selvadorada, tasting the local cuisine, and interacting with local vendors.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Archae.label: Archaeology
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Archae.description:
Some Sims are driven by the search for knowledge and treasures lost to time. Spending a little bit of time in the dirt can be very rewarding.

Archaeology Skill is built by digging up, authenticating, and studying ancient artifacts. Increasing this skill unlocks new interactions on the Archaeology Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_Bowling.label: Bowling
skills:statistic_Skill_Bowling.description:
Some would call Bowling a minor skill, but they'd only be technically correct. While it may only have five levels of advancement, Sims who put in the work to skill up will look undeniably cool. They'll acquire additional bowling balls as they go, and you may just bowl a Perfect Llama game of all strikes someday.

Bowling Skill is improved via... well... bowling. Get to it!

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Knitti.label: Knitting
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Knitti.description:
Get comfortable and turn on some tunes, because it's time to knit! Use your talents to dress your family, decorate your house, or make some Simoleons on the side. No wrong answers here, just get to stitching! 

Knitting is primarily tied to the Yarn Basket. Your Sim must have a Yarn Basket in their inventory to start knitting. Increasing this skill will unlock new Knitting recipes, both clothing and objects!

Knitting can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Yarn Basket.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Medium.label: Medium
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Medium.description:
Hone your spiritual power! Sims embarking on this journey will eventually be able to do things like summon the dead, or host their own Séance with other Sims. 

The Medium Skill is increased by using interactions on the Séance Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Gemolo.label: Gemology
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Gemolo.description:
While every Sim may appreciate a shiny gem, those with Gemology skill learn to create their own gem-based creations for wearing, gifting, or turning a little profit.

Gemology is built primarily by crafting on the Gemology Table, supplemented by finding metals and crystals. Increasing this skill will unlock new jewelry designs and gemstone cuts, as well as increase the number of metals and crystals a Sim finds!

Gemology can be Mentored at Skill level 5 from a Gemology Table.

skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Thinking.label: Thinking
skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Thinking.description: Thinking Skill helps toddlers throw fewer tantrums and be more capable of taking care of themselves. It reduces defiance, and helps to solve needs. Thinking Skill is improved by being curious, or by playing with Flash Cards, Nesting Blocks, or the Tablet.

skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Imaginati.label: Imagination
skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Imaginati.description: Toddlers with Imagination play in their own world. Imagination skill teaches Toddlers to read and create fantastical worlds with their toys. Gain Imagination skill by playing with Toys and Dolls, listening to music, or looking at Toddler Books.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Diving.label: Diving
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMinor_Diving.description:
For Sims who wish they could fly through the air (and look super cool while doing it) diving is the ideal water sport!

Diving can be practiced at both tall and short diving boards placed beside pools. Increasing this skill will unlock new, more complex dives to perform.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Photog.label: Photography
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Photog.description: From a phone to a fancy camera. Sims who are skilled in Photography will have greater success as they hone their skills by taking lots of pictures, upgrading their equipment, experimenting with picture settings and using the In a Flash Photo Studio.

skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Potty.label: Potty
skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Potty.description:
Toilet training makes dirty diapers a thing of the past.

Potty skill teaches toddlers to use the Potty Chair. Improve it by having an adult Train the toddler.

skills:statistic_Skill_Archery.label: Archery
skills:statistic_Skill_Archery.description:
Hitting bullseyes isn't as simple as nocking arrows and sending them flying! It can take hours of practice with a bow to be the best archer around.

The Archery Skill can be improved by practicing at an Archery Target or participating in Archery Competitions. Improved Archery Skill means more bullseyes, better competition performance, and cooler bows. It also unlocks new interactions, catching fish via Bowfishing, and some sweet archery-related accessories in Create a Sim.

Archery can be mentored from Skill level 4 at an Archery Target.

skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Communica.label: Communication
skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Communica.description:
Talking is a huge step for any Toddler.

Communication skill teaches Toddlers advanced socials. Improve it by talking with others, and studying advanced Flash Cards.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Paperc.label: Papercraft
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Paperc.description:
The art of making two- or three-dimensional objects and designs using paper. Creations are made in a variety of ways, which can include cutting, folding, bending, stitching, layering, or gluing. Sims can gift their papercrafts to other Sims or proudly display them around the house.

This Skill can be developed using a Papercraft Kit. Increasing this Skill will unlock new paper creations and paper colors.

Papercrafting can be mentored at Skill level 5 from the Papercraft Kit.

skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Movement.label: Movement
skills:statistic_Skill_Toddler_Movement.description:
Toddlers who focus on Movement really get around.

Movement skill helps Toddlers walk faster, run, climb stairs, and dance, dance, dance. Improve it by walking around, building with Nesting Blocks, dancing, or via Play wrestling with adults.

skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Baking.label: Baking
skills:statistic_Skill_AdultMajor_Baking.description:
Baking is science in action. You can't just throw random ingredients into a bowl like some chef. You have to have a plan. Fortunately, the plan involves large helpings of sugar. Increasing your baking skill will unlock new Baked Goods for your Oven and Cupcake Factory.

Baking can be mentored at Skill level 5 from a Fridge, Oven, or Cupcake Machine.

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Babysitter.label: Babysitter
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Babysitter.description: Get paid to play with kids—and keep them safe and all that. You get to be in charge....

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Barista.label: Barista
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Barista.description: If you love hanging out at the coffee house and already know all the fancy drink names, why not get paid for it?
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Barista.careerDetails: Barista: Coffee Stain Remover → Bean Blender → Latte Artiste

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_FastFood.label: Fast Food Employee
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_FastFood.description: Earn a little spending money serving food to people you know. And wiping up after them, for a while.
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_FastFood.careerDetails: Fast Food Employee: Table Cleaner → Fry Cook → Food Service Cashier

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Lifeguard.label: Lifeguard
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Lifeguard.description: Sunscreen, whistles, and the occasional shark are all part of everyday life as a Lifeguard. Love swimming, safety, and yelling at rambunctious children trying to drown each other? This is the part-time career for you!
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Lifeguard.careerDetails: Lifeguard: CPR Dummy Stand-In → Wave Watcher → Prolific Whistler

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_ManualLabo.label: Manual Laborer
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_ManualLabo.description: Do you find muscles appealing? How about money? Pursue a part-time career as a Manual Laborer and you can create, get paid, and become buff (all at the same time)!
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_ManualLabo.careerDetails: Manual Laborer: Lawn Mower → Landscaper → Backhoe Operator

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Retail.label: Retail Employee
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Retail.description: Set your sights on the future by launching your career in sales. From creating displays to disarming customers, you’re on your way to perks, discounts and sweet Simoleons.
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Retail.careerDetails: Retail Employee: Shelf Stocker → Sales Floor Clerk → Customer Support

careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Simsfluen.label: Simfluencer
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Simsfluen.description:
Got a webcam? Got a hint of personality? Be a Simfluencer and big companies will search you out to help shill their latest wares.

To start making reviews, find Lifestyle objects such as Chess Board, Painting Easel, etc.

careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_StreamerS.label: Video Game Streamer
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_StreamerS.description: Playing video games for fun and profit! Be a Video Game Streamer where slick moves and comedy basics combine and you are the star of the (virtual) show!
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_StreamerS.careerDetails: Video Game Streamer: Casual Streamer → Speedrunner → Pro-Gamer

careers:career_Adult_Active_ActorCareer.label: Actor
careers:career_Adult_Active_ActorCareer.description: The spotlight calls, the cameras are focused, and you are ready for your closeup. It is up to you to breathe energy into the words of the script and really make the characters come alive.
careers:career_Adult_Active_ActorCareer.careerDetails: Actor: Uncredited Extra → Background Actor → Commercial Spokesperson → Guest Star → Supporting Actor → Sitcom Star → Rising Star → Seasoned Thespian → Superstar → Silver Screen Icon

careers:career_Adult_Active_Doctor.label: Doctor
careers:career_Adult_Active_Doctor.description: Who doesn’t want to be held responsible for another Sim’s health and well-being? A Doctor who can advance in the medical ranks will find themselves rewarded with objects like a Standing Surgical Light and a Full-Sized Skeleton to brighten up the home nursery. To make the deal extra sweet, you’ll be able to unlock your very own Hospital Scrubs and Patient Gowns so you can play Doctor at home!
careers:career_Adult_Active_Doctor.careerDetails: Doctor: Medical Intern → Orderly → Medical Assistant → Medical Technologist → Assistant Nurse → R.N. → Doctor - General Practitioner → Medical Specialist → Surgeon → Chief of Staff

careers:career_Adult_Active_Scientist.label: Scientist
careers:career_Adult_Active_Scientist.description: Calling all brains! Are you the nerdy type who aspires to one day wear tin foil on your head and decorate your studio with huge bubbly tanks? A Scientist who proves they’ve got the gray matter to change the world as we know it can unlock new outfits like the UFO hunter or objects like a swanky Chemistry Lab for concocting new inventions and serums.
careers:career_Adult_Active_Scientist.careerDetails: Scientist: Lab Technician → Apprentice Inventor → Junior Tinkerer → Serum Sequencer → Technological Innovator → Ufologist → Laboratory Leader → Pioneer of New Technologies → Mad Scientist → Extraterrestrial Explorer

careers:career_Adult_Astronaut.label: Astronaut
careers:career_Adult_Astronaut.description: Who doesn't dream of going to space?  Become an astronaut and the galaxy will be your playground.
careers:career_Adult_Astronaut.careerDetails:
Astronaut: Intern → Module Cleaner → Technician → Command Center Lead → Low-Orbit Specialist → Space Cadet → Astronaut

Space Ranger: Planet Patrol → Sheriff of the Stars → Space Ranger

Interstellar Smuggler: Moon Mercenary → Alien Goods Trader → Interstellar Smuggler

careers:career_Adult_Athletic.label: Athlete
careers:career_Adult_Athletic.description: An athlete requires physical strength, speed, endurance, and intelligence. Start a career where enthusiastic fans will shout your name, wear your jersey, and remember your feats forever.
careers:career_Adult_Athletic.careerDetails:
Athlete: Waterperson → Locker Room Attendant → Team Mascot → Dance Team Captain

Professional Athlete: Minor Leaguer → Rookie → Starter → All-Star → MVP → Hall of Famer

Bodybuilder: Personal Trainer → Professional Bodybuilder → Champion Bodybuilder → Trainer to the Stars → Celebrity Bodybuilder → Mr. Solar System

careers:career_Adult_Business.label: Business
careers:career_Adult_Business.description: Synergy! Efficiency! Planfulness! If the mere sound of these industry buzzwords gets you buzzing, then a career in business might just be the right fit for you!
careers:career_Adult_Business.careerDetails:
Business: Mailroom Technician → Office Assistant → Assistant to the Manager → Assistant Manager → Regional Manager → Senior Manager

Investor: Futures Trader → Hedge Fund Manager → Corporate Raider → Angel Investor

careers:career_Adult_Criminal.label: Criminal
careers:career_Adult_Criminal.description: Not every Sim wants to play by the rules. You can make tons of Simoleons and have fun, too, as an outlaw.

careers:career_Adult_Culinary.label: Culinary
careers:career_Adult_Culinary.description: Anyone can make dinner or mix a drink at home. The Culinary career is for those who want to take it to another level and make money doing it.
careers:career_Adult_Culinary.careerDetails:
Culinary: Assistant Dishwasher → Head Dishwasher → Caterer → Mixologist → Line Cook

Chef: Head Caterer → Pastry Chef → Sous Chef → Executive Chef → Celebrity Chef

Mixologist: Head Mixologist → Juice Boss → Chief Drink Operator → Drinkmaster → Celebrity Mixologist

careers:career_Adult_Entertainer.label: Entertainer
careers:career_Adult_Entertainer.description: You've wanted your name in lights from the time you could spell it, maybe even before. Answer your calling and claim your fame as a professional entertainer, either making the audience laugh with you or melting their hearts with your melodies.
careers:career_Adult_Entertainer.careerDetails:
Entertainer: Amateur Entertainer → Open Mic Seeker → C-Lister → Opening Act

Musician: Jingle Jammer → Serious Musician → Professional Pianist → Symphonic String Player → Instrumental Wonder → Concert Virtuoso

Comedian: Jokesmith → Solid Storyteller → Rising Comedian → Roast Master → Stand Up Star → Show Stopper

careers:career_Adult_Freelancer_Artist.label: Freelance Artist
careers:career_Adult_Freelancer_Artist.description:
Trade: Freelance Artist

Can a digital painting make you cry? Right now, no one knows. This is partly because many would consider the very idea frivolous. But it's also because whoever successfully answers this question must first have answered several others.

Why do we cry? Why do we laugh, or love, or smile? What are the touchstones of our emotions?

Until now, the people who asked such questions tended not to be the same people who created digital art. Instead, they were writers, filmmakers, painters, musicians. They were, in the traditional sense, artists.

We're about to change that tradition. The name of our agency is Electrified Artists.

careers:career_Adult_Painter.label: Painter
careers:career_Adult_Painter.description: Create your own world with a few strokes of a brush! Make a place for yourself in the art world with hyperreal masterpieces or abstract works of unsettling beauty.
careers:career_Adult_Painter.careerDetails:
Painter: Palette Cleaner → Art Book Collator → Hungry Artist → Watercolor Dabbler → Canvas Creator → Imaginative Imagist

Master of the Real: Artist en Residence → Professional Painter → Illustrious Illustrator → Master of the Real

Patron of the Arts: Color Theory Critic → Fine-Art Aficionado → Composition Curator → Patron of the Arts

careers:career_Adult_ParkWorker.label: Park Worker
careers:career_Adult_ParkWorker.description: Not your typical 9-to-5. Out here, shifts can stretch across days, and every task helps keep the camp running. Whether you're scrubbing cabins or guiding curious campers, your days (and nights) will be spent deep in Miceli Park, turning wilderness into something that feels like home! Miceli Park is a tougher post than Camp Gibbi Gibbi. It’s secluded and rugged, and reached only by those brave enough to take the trail less traveled beyond the Ranger Station.
careers:career_Adult_ParkWorker.careerDetails:
Park Worker: Cabin Cleaner → Event Helper → Cabin Leader → Activity Instructor → Group Counselor → Wilderness Safety Guide → Event Coordinator

Park Ranger: Assistant Park Ranger → Ranger Survivalist → Chief Ranger

Park Counselor: Assistant Counselor → Camp Counselor → Head Counselor

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Diver.label: Diver
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Diver.description: Grab your snorkel and get to work! Being a diver is all about exploring the depths of the ocean floor.
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Diver.careerDetails: Diver: Snorkel Guide → Scuba Instructor → Sunken Treasure Hunter

careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Fisherman.label: Fisherman
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Fisherman.description: Relax by the water and let the fish come to you. It's all about how you catch'em (hook, line, and sinker) when you're a Fisherman!
careers:career_Adult_PartTime_Fisherman.careerDetails: Fisherman: Goldfish Hunter → River Wrangler → Deep Sea Fishing Master

careers:career_Adult_SecretAgent.label: Secret Agent
careers:career_Adult_SecretAgent.description: Live life unnoticed as a covert operative. From infiltrating enemy headquarters to the art of interrogation, the more you learn, the less you’ll be known.
careers:career_Adult_SecretAgent.careerDetails:
Secret Agent: Agency Clerk → Intelligence Researcher → Agent Handler → Field Agent → Lead Detective → Government Agent → Secret Agent

Diamond Agent: Spy Captain → Shadow Agent → Double Diamond Agent

Villain: Double Agent → [Redacted] → Supreme Villain → Triple Agent

careers:career_Adult_StyleInfluencer.label: Style Influencer
careers:career_Adult_StyleInfluencer.description: By identifying the right colors, the trendy patterns, the unseen ensemble pairings, and identifying the right person to act as a vehicle for such insight, the Style Influencer can twist the world towards a more cohesive end.
careers:career_Adult_StyleInfluencer.careerDetails:
Style Influencer: Rag Reviewer → Consignment Commentator → Wearable Wordsmith → Ensemble Author → Culture Columnist

Trend Setter: Posh Profiler → Fashion Figure → Best-Self-Helper → It Sim → Icon O'Class

Stylist: Dedicated Dresser → Textile Tactician → Wardrobe Wiz → Make-Over Miracle Worker → Persona Re-Imager

careers:career_Adult_TechGuru.label: Tech Guru
careers:career_Adult_TechGuru.description: Who needs college with programming skills like yours? Opportunity is out there, ripe for the picking, and you and your big brain are ready to pluck away.
careers:career_Adult_TechGuru.careerDetails:

Start-up Entrepreneur: The Next Big Thing? → Independent Consultant → Dot-Com Pioneer → Start-up Genius

careers:career_Adult_Writer.label: Writer
careers:career_Adult_Writer.description: Get paid to express your ideas with beautiful turns of phrase, and words—wonderful words!
careers:career_Adult_Writer.careerDetails:
Writer: Writer's Assistant → Blogger → Freelance Article Writer → Advice Columnist → Regular Contributor

Author: Short Story Writer → Novelist → Fan Favorite → Bestselling Author → Creator of Worlds

careers:career_Noble.label: Noble
careers:career_Noble.description: Crown and Court are calling, it's time to debut! Noble Sims will take on the responsibility of ruling a Kingdom and influencing the lives of Sims all throughout the realm.
careers:career_Noble.careerDetails: Noble: Noble Newcomer → Honorable Herald → Charismatic Courtier → Charming Chamberlain → Influential Liege → Admirable Aristocrat → Opulent Overseer → Distinguished Dignitary → Respected Regent → Kingdom Leader

careers:career_Volunteer_DramaClub.label: Drama Club
careers:career_Volunteer_DramaClub.description: Join Drama Club! As a Drama Club member, you'll perform in local plays and eventually hone those fine acting skills. Crying on demand is useful in plays as well as getting out of things! Impress your classmates and parents with your ability to become virtually anyone! Just make sure you don't do anything embarrassing on stage, because those memories will last a lifetime...
careers:career_Volunteer_DramaClub.careerDetails: Drama Club: Stage Beginner → Line Learner → Practical Performer → Junior Artiste

careers:career_Volunteer_E-Sports.label: E-Sports Competitor
careers:career_Volunteer_E-Sports.description: Put your gaming skills to the test and become part of an E-Sports competitive team! You can meet with your teammates, or play from the comfort of your own room. Once you've proven your worth, you'll be able to participate in University-held matches every weekend. So, come join the action! You already play videogames all day anyway, right?
careers:career_Volunteer_E-Sports.careerDetails: E-Sports Competitor: Practice Squad Member → Alternate → Teammate → Captain

careers:career_Volunteer_Scouting.label: Scout
careers:career_Volunteer_Scouting.description: Hey whippersnapper, do you have what it takes to be a Scout? Whip out that compass and volunteer today! As a virtuous Scout, you’ll do fun activities with your troop and learn what it takes to be an upright member of your community.
careers:career_Volunteer_Scouting.careerDetails: Scout: Llama Scout → Griffon Scout → Unicorn Scout → Pegasus Scout → Llamacorn Scout

careers:careers_Adult_Active_Reaper.label: Reaper
careers:careers_Adult_Active_Reaper.description: The time is nigh to don a robe and become a Reaper! As Grim's employee, you'll be able to climb his triangular ladder and gain rewards like Discussing Deathly Business and owning a Timeless Hourglass. Scry your way to the top and earn being Grim's Right Hand while unlocking a truly Grim-worthy outfit as you spread Death's Touch wherever you go.
careers:careers_Adult_Active_Reaper.careerDetails: Reaper: Grimtern → Restceptionist → Dust-to-Dust Buster → Collections Agent → Soul Slayer → Spirit Expert (Extraction & Resolution) → Nether-Tether → D.N.R. (Death's Negotiation Reporter) → Graveling → Reaper

careers:careers_Adult_Activist.label: Politician
careers:careers_Adult_Activist.description: Join a life of public service! From protesting against the unjust, to gathering donations for good causes, or even collecting the occasional bribe as a "means to an end", Politics is always interesting.
careers:careers_Adult_Activist.careerDetails:
Politician: Unruly Activist → Campaign Intern → Social Justice Worker → Community Organizer

Politician: Civil Servant → Public Official → Councilperson → Representative → Elder Statesperson → National Leader

Charity Organizer: Friendly Lobbyist → Fundraising Specialist → Charity Organizer → Non-Profit Director → Leader of the Cause → Charity Icon

careers:careers_Adult_CivilDesigner.label: Civil Designer
careers:careers_Adult_CivilDesigner.description: As a Civil Designer, get involved in planning and designing solutions to all kinds of environmental problems, and chat to your fellow Sims about how to make their world a better place to live.
careers:careers_Adult_CivilDesigner.careerDetails:
Civil Designer: Junior Draftsperson → Architectural Apprentice → Construction Technician

Green Technician: Installation Intern → Design Guru → Machine Modifier → Eco-tech Scientist → Device Savant → Expert Fabricator → Master Inventor

careers:careers_Adult_Conservationist.label: Conservationist
careers:careers_Adult_Conservationist.description: You've watched every nature documentary out there, and you know just how much the planet is in danger. From educating the public to performing research expeditions, you want to truly make a difference. Change won't happen overnight, but keep at it and your hard work can lead to thriving ecosystems!
careers:careers_Adult_Conservationist.careerDetails:

Environmental Manager: Conservation Regulator → Sustainability Specialist → Environmental Ambassador → Chief Sustainability Officer

Marine Biologist: Ocean Observer → Fisheries Specialist → Aquatic Ecologist → Master of Marine Affairs

careers:careers_Adult_CorporateWorker.label: Salaryperson
careers:careers_Adult_CorporateWorker.description: Dedicating your life to the Farseer Data Corporation and putting its needs above all else is just the first step for a Salaryperson. Stability, respect, and endless hours of work are in your future. Advance to be a Supervisor or a Expert in your field all while enjoying morning commutes and evening Karaoke.
careers:careers_Adult_CorporateWorker.careerDetails:
Salaryperson: New Hire → Pencil Pusher → Competent Clerk → Office Doyen

Expert: Data Wrangler → Calculus Adept → Spreadsheet Specialist → Master of the Cells → Formula Virtuoso → Cloud Data Guru

Supervisor: Valued Employee → Team Leader → Skilled Supervisor → Prime Planner → Group Oracle → Head of the Department

careers:careers_Adult_Critic.label: Critic
careers:careers_Adult_Critic.description: Everyone has an opinion. But not everyone is paid to have it! Sims who feel they have superior judgement can enter the Critic Career. Whether it’s the foods or the arts, your Sim will have something to say about it, and others WILL listen.
careers:careers_Adult_Critic.careerDetails:
Critic: Paper Deliverer → Story Researcher → Beat Reporter

Food Critic: Chow Chaser → Food Stall Frequenter → Restaurant Rater → Local Gourmand → Expert Epicurean → Kitchen's Worst Nightmare → Curator of the Finest Flavors

careers:careers_Adult_Education.label: Education
careers:careers_Adult_Education.description: Shape tomorrow's minds with a career in Education. Though, at times, challenging, there are few jobs quite as rewarding.
careers:careers_Adult_Education.careerDetails:
Education: Substitute Teacher → Teaching Assistant → Teacher → Mentor Teacher → Department Head

Administrator: Student Services Officer → Dean of Admissions → Director of Academics → Vice-Chancellor → Head Chancellor

Professor: Intrepid Instructor → Lead Lecturer → Adjunct Professor → Tenured Professor → Master Educator

careers:careers_Adult_Engineer.label: Engineer
careers:careers_Adult_Engineer.description: There are many problems in the world that require modern and creative solutions. Take your love of technology and pursue a career in engineering to solve the world's problems with computers and mechanical gadgetry!
careers:careers_Adult_Engineer.careerDetails:
Engineer: Support Technician → Engineering Intern → Apprentice of Algorithms → Cog in the Machine → Engineering Technician → Expert Engineer

Computer Engineer: Constructor of Computers → Processors of Processors → Computer Connoisseur → PC Prodigy

Mechanical Engineer: Maker of Mechanisms → Artisan of Apparatuses → Mechanical Genius → Master of Machines

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Freelance Fashion Photographer
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description: Freelance Fashion Photographers take on different gigs to take photos for client’s fashion, advertising, and research needs. Develop photography skills and a good reputation to be selected to work with Style Influencers who represent all the best brands.
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.careerDetails: Freelance Fashion Photographer: Freelance Fashion Photographer

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Freelance Crafter
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description:
Trade: Freelance Crafter

Do you regularly buy things from the store and think to yourself, "I could make something better"? Consider a career as a Freelance Crafter where you can produce goods with that often missing homemade charm.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Paranormal Investigator
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description: Paranormal Investigators are the ones who are called when things go bump in the night. While the job requires you to work through the night, there is a lot of freedom in the type of work to do. Harder gigs mean better rewards, but who knows... it might get pretty spooky there.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Freelance Programmer
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description:
Trade: Freelance Programmer

Want in on a little secret? You don't have to be an expert about computers to be a great freelancer! All you need is a PC, a search engine, and the iron will to deal with "ideas people". Still, it helps to be an expert.

careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.label: Freelance Writer
careers:careers_Adult_Freelancer_Agency_.description:
Trade: Freelance Writer

When people see us in the street, they point and exclaim "Them's Fighting Words!" Okay they don't. Perhaps someday. We handle jobs ranging from proofreading to ghost writing for famous people. Grab a keyboard, boot up your favorite word processor, and join us!

careers:careers_Adult_Gardener.label: Gardener
careers:careers_Adult_Gardener.description: You've always had a green thumb, but now you think you can earn some green with it. You'll start by doing a lot of planting and gardening, but keep at it, and you can find success in the science, or art, in doing so.
careers:careers_Adult_Gardener.careerDetails:
Gardener: Dirt-Digger → Soil-Sifter → Seed-Scatterer → Leaf-Cutter

Botanist: Plant Nerd → Stem Researcher → Sap-Splicer → Flower Fellow → Bouquet Biologist → PhD of Pollen

Floral Designer: Petal-Placer → Stem Cutter → Anther Artist → Floral Organizer → Leafy Luminary → Visionary of Vases

careers:careers_Adult_InteriorDecorator.label: Interior Decorator
careers:careers_Adult_InteriorDecorator.description:
Being an Interior Decorator is about two things:Having a good eye for designBuilding relationships with Clients.
Having people skills and some artistic vision will lead to a bright future and possible recognition. You may start small with some simple home renovations, but eventually with enough hard work, bigger Clients and buildings could get you the recognition you deserve!
careers:careers_Adult_InteriorDecorator.careerDetails: Interior Decorator: Interior Color Consultant → Interior Design Technician → Space Manager → Decorating Consultant → Building Space Planner → Home Organizer → Home decorator → Business Interior Designer → Interior Designer → Certified Interior Designer

careers:careers_Adult_Law.label: Law
careers:careers_Adult_Law.description: Sims who pursue a career in law are in a unique position to help others with their legal problems, champion causes, and further the public good (or not). That fancy paycheck doesn't hurt either!
careers:careers_Adult_Law.careerDetails:
Law: Process Server → File Clerk → Legal Secretary → Paralegal → Budding Barrister → Adept Attorney → Promising Prosecutor

Judge: Gavel Smasher → Honorable Arbitrator → Chief of Justice

Private Attorney: Lead Litigator → Legal Eagle → Preeminent Partner

careers:careers_Adult_Military.label: Military
careers:careers_Adult_Military.description: Physical fitness and discipline will be the keys to success in the Military career. Rising through the ranks will not come easy unless you can demonstrate your physical prowess as well as your ability to recruit and be a leader. Will you pursue the path of a Grand Marshal, or will you follow a more secretive path to uncover what others might be hiding?
careers:careers_Adult_Military.careerDetails:
Military: Raw Recruit → Private Fourth Class → Lacking Corporal → Sergeant Minor → Warrant Officer

Officer: Fourth Lieutenant → Courageous Captain → Lieutenant Colonel → Brigadier → Grand Marshal

Covert Operator: Evidence Eraser → Conspiracy Squelcher → Clandestine Investigator → [REDACTED] → Sim-In-Black

careers:careers_Adult_Mortician.label: Undertaker
careers:careers_Adult_Mortician.description: Service both the living and the dead by undertaking this position! From grave digging to embalming, Sims who pursue a career in the funeral industry ensure all Sims are able to move on in peace. Specializing in this before-afterlife care prepares you for difficult moments like, Discussing End of Life services or Contemplating Existence. Six feet in you may be rewarded with a Plague Mask, a Murphy Membrane Bust, or a Corpus Commendation Plaque to honor your achievements.
careers:careers_Adult_Mortician.careerDetails:
Undertaker: Grave Digger → Body Guard → Grave Keeper → Removal Service Staff

Funeral Director: Administrative Assistant → Grief Counselor → Burial Consultant → Services Manager → Assistant Director → Funeral Director

careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Handypers.label: Handyperson
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Handypers.description: If you know which end of a wrench is which, this is the career for you! Under the watchful gaze of the Property Owner, bodge and fix up things to your heart's (and cash flow's) delight!
careers:careers_Adult_PartTime_Handypers.careerDetails: Handyperson: Able Tinkerer → Hotshot Helper → Prime Fixer-Upper

careers:careers_Adult_RomanceConsultant.label: Romance Consultant
careers:careers_Adult_RomanceConsultant.description: Are you a natural at interpreting feelings, a sucker for romance, and interested in helping others find their happily ever after? You may be destined to become a Romance Consultant!
careers:careers_Adult_RomanceConsultant.careerDetails:
Romance Consultant: Romance Newbie → Passion Assistant → Love Mediator → Romance Practitioner → Emotional Health Counselor → Love Language Expert → Romantic Health Specialist

Relationship Counselor: Intimate Relationship Coach → Qualified Relationship Professional → Licensed Clinical Romance Counselor

Matchmaker: Love Connection Specialist → Relationship Compatibility Expert → Certified Dating Specialist

careers:careers_Adult_SocialMedia.label: Social Media
careers:careers_Adult_SocialMedia.description:
What’s trending? Where’s the best food in town? Who’s the most interesting celebrity?
Start a career in Social Media to be the person that answers these questions for their followers. Blog and check-in at venues to keep followers coming back for more.
careers:careers_Adult_SocialMedia.careerDetails:
Social Media: Media Intern → Engagement Monkey → Clickbait Writer

Internet Personality: Simstagram Searcher → Cat Video Creator → Niche Broadcaster → Meme Maker → Online A-Lister → Reality Show Contestant → Internet Superstar

Public Relations: Public Relations Coordinator → Community Manager → Press Agent → Account Executive → Director of Communications → Vice President of Public Relations → Spin Doctor

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_CheerTe.label: Cheer Team Member
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_CheerTe.description: Go Copperdale Flying Womp Womps! Join the competitive cheerleading team to level up on fitness and learn some amazing cheer moves. Practice with your squad and compete at the cheer competition once a week. You'll need a cheer mat to get started but reach cheer captain to earn a golden cheer mat, team flag, and trophy.
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_CheerTe.careerDetails: Cheer Team Member: Cheerleading Fresh Recruit → Cheerleading Teammate → Cheerleading Captain

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_ChessTe.label: Chess Team Member
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_ChessTe.description: Join the High School Chess team! Put your logic skills to the test by joining this activity and meeting teammates that you can enhance your chess playing skills with. By joining this activity, you'll be able to request a High School Science Fair where you'll get to participate in a chess puzzle with other guests. Build your way up to captain where you can earn a special chess table, a team flag, and a trophy!
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_ChessTe.careerDetails: Chess Team Member: Chess Team Fresh Recruit → Chess Teammate → Chess Team Captain

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Compute.label: Computer Team Member
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Compute.description: Get out that RGB keyboard and join the High School Computer Team! Work on your coding experience by practicing programming on a computer. If you join this activity, you'll be able to request a Science Fair where you'll get to participate in a Game Jam and compete against guests! Make your way up in the team to reach captain level where you can earn a golden laptop, team flag, and trophy!
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Compute.careerDetails: Computer Team Member: Computer Team Fresh Recruit → Computer Programming Teammate → Computer Team Captain

careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Footbal.label: Football Team Member
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Footbal.description: Join the football team and level up on fitness! You'll be able to practice football throwing and catching performance that you can show off at the Sports Day festival. Along with football practice, you'll be able to reach captain level position and earn a golden football, team flag, and trophy!
careers:careers_Volunteer_HSTeam_Footbal.careerDetails: Football Team Member: Football Team Fresh Recruit → Football Teammate → Football Team Captain

careers:careers_Volunteer_SoccerTeam.label: Soccer Team Player
careers:careers_Volunteer_SoccerTeam.description: Interested in playing university soccer? Want the 'team' experience? The cool uniform? The impressive soccer skills? Sign up today! Instead of watching games on Friday and Saturday—you'll be playing them!
careers:careers_Volunteer_SoccerTeam.careerDetails: Soccer Team Player: Trainee → Bench Warmer → Starter → Playmaker

careers:detectiveCareer_1.label: Detective
careers:detectiveCareer_1.description: Do you want to be the type of cop who’s never really off-duty? If so, this job’s for you and we’ve got the rewards to support that unhealthy lifestyle! Unlock outfits like your Police Uniform to wear as pajamas. Teach your teen a valuable lesson for that C+ by dressing them in Prisoner Coveralls and transforming their bedroom into a virtual jail cell complete with Prison Bar Walls and a decorative Security Camera. As a bonus, you can keep an eye on them with your very own One-Way Mirror.
careers:detectiveCareer_1.careerDetails: Detective: Cadet → Officer → Corporal → Detective → Senior Detective → Sergeant → Lieutenant → Captain → Colonel → Chief

careers:workFromHomeCareer_Naturopath.label: Naturopath
careers:workFromHomeCareer_Naturopath.description: A Naturopath draws on deep wells of knowledge, from Crafting Elixirs to Foraging, to help other Sims feel their best. If you're drawn to healing and balance, this career is for you! Unlock 3 career outfits, new socials such as Educate about Balance, additional work interactions including the ability to see ailing Sims at the home lot, traits, and decor objects—such as Everdew Wisdom Frame Pack—that are perfect for any home office.
careers:workFromHomeCareer_Naturopath.careerDetails:
Naturopath: Naturopath Intern → Apothecary Apprentice → Natural Living Novice → Holistic Care Trainee → Client Care Generalist

Apothe-curist: In-House Forager → Horticulturalist → Elixir Specialist → Phytotherapist → Master Apothecary

Lifestyle Coaching: Skills Class Coordinator → Foraging Field Guide → Natural Living Instructor → Balance Counselor → Certified Lifestyle Coach

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Beetle.label: Death by Beetles
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Beetle.description: Death came for this Sim through a well-mixed bug drink. The haunted house now serves as a fitting final resting place.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Overheat.label: Death by Overheating
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Overheat.description: This Sim died from prolonged exposure to high temperatures.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Laugher.label: Death by Laughter
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Laugher.description: This Sim died from a fit of the giggles that continues to pop up now and then.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Steam.label: Death by Steam
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Steam.description: This Sim died from excessive steam exposure and is constantly hot and dehydrated.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Fire.label: Death by Fire
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Fire.description: A fire claimed this Sim's life, and now, the flames linger as a ghostly presence.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_ClimbingRoute.label: Death by Falling from Heights
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_ClimbingRoute.description: This Sim has found death via a fall from heights.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.label: Death by Killer Chicken
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.description: Consider this the price paid for being nasty to a chicken.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MurphyBed.label: Death by Being Crushed by a Murphy Bed
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MurphyBed.description: This Sim has found death via a vengeful Murphy Bed.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_BrokenHeart.label: Death by Broken Heart
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_BrokenHeart.description: This Sim experienced the chaos that love can bring and died from a broken heart.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Frozen.label: Death by Freezing
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Frozen.description: This Sim died from excessive exposure to freezing temperatures.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Cowplant.label: Death by Cow Plant
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Cowplant.description: This Sim was eaten by a Cow Plant, and still feels a bit oddly towards plants.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_EmotionalStarvat.label: Death by Emotional Starvation
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_EmotionalStarvat.description: This Sim emotionally starved to death, and the emotional pangs have followed into the afterlife.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_DeathFlower.label: Death by Flowers
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_DeathFlower.description: This Sim's life ended with a Death Scented Flower Arrangement. The irresistible gift led to a fatal outcome.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Hunger.label: Death by Hunger
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Hunger.description: This Sim starved to death, and the hunger pangs have followed into the afterlife.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_VendingMachine.label: Death by Vending Machine
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_VendingMachine.description: This Sim couldn't handle the crushing force of the vending machine and died as a result.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MotherPlant.label: Consumed by the Mother
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MotherPlant.description: This Sim has been consumed by the Mother Plant and will forever reap her benefits of zero Need Decay.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_WitchOverload.label: Death by Spellcaster Overload
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_WitchOverload.description: Overload Ghosts are valid targets for Magical interactions including duels, training, and more.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Anger.label: Death by Anger
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Anger.description: This Sim perished from apoplexy, leaving a lingering rage behind.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MoldSystem.label: Death by Mold
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_MoldSystem.description: This Sim is the embodiment, or rather "disembodiment" of fungi after succumbing to mold. Some say they've absorbed moldy powers, but will they use it for good?

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.label: Death by Killer Rabbit
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_AnimalObjects_Ki.description: This Sim provoked a killer rabbit and paid the ultimate price.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_PetCrow.label: Death by Murder of Crows
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_PetCrow.description: This Sim chose to tangle with the talons of the Crow Collective and came out a little less alive as a result.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Flies.label: Death by Being Swarmed by Flies
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Flies.description: This Sim has found death via an angry swarm of Flies.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Embarrassment.label: Death by Embarrassment
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Embarrassment.description: This Sim was mortified, and died of embarrassment. Literally.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_SecretPassageway.label: Death by Cuckoo Malfunction
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_SecretPassageway.description: Curiosity clocked out! This Sim met their end tinkering with a troublesome cuckoo clock.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Rodent_Disease.label: Death by Rabid Rodent Fever
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Rodent_Disease.description:
This Sim succumbed to Rabid Rodent Fever, and spreads fear of pestilence and disease in the afterlife.
In Live Mode, this Sim will be doomed to wear a giant, ghostly rat costume permanently!

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Lightning.label: Death by Lightning
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Lightning.description: This Sim was struck by lightning one time too many.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_OldAge.label: Death by Old Age
deathCauses:trait_ghost_OldAge.description: No need for sorrow, this is the result of a long, long life.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Poison.label: Death by Poison
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Poison.description: This Sim died as a result of being poisoned.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Vampire_Sun.label: Death by Sunlight
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Vampire_Sun.description: This Sim died from over-exposure to those harmful UV rays!

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Drown.label: Death by Drowning
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Drown.description: This Sim drowned in a body of water and now has a fear of all water.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_Electrocution.label: Death by Electrocution
deathCauses:trait_ghost_Electrocution.description: This Sim met a shocking end due to a fatal electrocution.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Pufferfish.label: Death by Pufferfish
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Pufferfish.description: This Sim took their life in their mouth and ate a highly toxic fish.

deathCauses:trait_ghost_ElderExhaustion.label: Death by Overexertion
deathCauses:trait_ghost_ElderExhaustion.description: Apparently it is possible to overdo it. This Sim did it to death.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_UrbanMyth_EP12De.label: Death by Urban Myth
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_UrbanMyth_EP12De.description: This Sim fell victim to an Urban Myth, dismissing the rumors until it was too late. While others might attribute the death to fear, only few know the real cause.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_StinkBomb.label: Death by Stink Capsule
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_StinkBomb.description: This Sim met an untimely end in a Stink Capsule explosion. The overwhelming fumes caused a fatal outcome. What a pungent way to go.

deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Meteorite.label: Death by Meteorite
deathCauses:trait_Ghost_Meteorite.description: This Sim was struck by a newly discovered rogue meteorite, which resulted in much scientific excitement and a small case of death.
